```tsx
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, MATCH_ANSWER_REASON_LABELS, ORDER_RULES, SEAL_DRAFTS, UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS, type CaseView, type HeldUpload, type MatchRecord, type RestoreGap, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { answerReasonNeeded, confirmDecision, decisionParamsOf, matchSealFacts, newDraft, previewOf, programStatementOf, restrictsOnMatch, sealDraftFor } from "../src/compose";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS, CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES, CUSTODY_WORDS, MODERATION_MESSAGES, RECOVERY_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { CustodyLines } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { marksOf } from "../src/screens/Queue";
import { RestoreScreen, type RestoreScreenProps } from "../src/screens/Restore";
import { endsOffered, holdEndParams, stateLine, UploadBlock, uploadReleaseParams, UploadsView, type UploadsActions } from "../src/screens/Uploads";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { CASE_FROZEN, CASE_POST, IMAGE_ONE, IMAGE_TWO, LOOKALIKE, NO_STANDING, SOURCES, decision, frozenCase, item, overview, postCase, queueRow } from "./case-fixtures";
import { HOSTILE } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * Known material on the console (3d design, sections 8.1 to 8.4, 8.6 to 8.8; Task 7), server-rendered: a match's record on
 * a case in its three kinds, with the source's strings framed; an image a match names, closed with no reveal control,
 * also after an answer without a seal; the queue's chip; the answer without a seal that asks for its reason; the
 * composer's [case.autoRecord] for a partly automated decision and [case.liftedMatch]; a program's seal with [case.autoR2]
 * and the statement its author was sent; Held uploads with neither end chosen; Home's lines; and [restore.holdEnd].
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;
const AT = "2026-10-19T09:15:00.000Z";
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z");
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const ITEM_MATCH = "9d0e1f2a-3b4c-4d5e-8f6a-7b8c9d0e1f2a";
const DECISION_SEAL = "0e1f2a3b-4c5d-4e6f-9a7b-8c9d0e1f2a3b";
const REFUSAL = "1f2a3b4c-5d6e-4f7a-8b8c-9d0e1f2a3b4c";
const LEAVE = "2a3b4c5d-6e7f-4a8b-9c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d";

/** A match's record with a third party's hostile strings: a bidirectional override, a look-alike label, a script address. */
const record = (more: Partial<MatchRecord> = {}): MatchRecord => ({
  source: HOSTILE.bidi,
  listVersion: LOOKALIKE.label,
  hashType: "sha256",
  matchKind: "exact",
  classification: HOSTILE.url,
  listed: true,
  acting: true,
  queriedAt: AT,
  ...more,
});

/** A post's case a match opened on its first image: an acting or near match cites R2 and freezes; a flag cites no rule. */
function matchCase(match: MatchRecord, more: Partial<CaseView> = {}): CaseView {
  const listed = match.listed;
  return (listed ? frozenCase : postCase)({
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_MATCH, source: SOURCES.program, explanation: null, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, ruleId: listed ? "R2" : null, csam: listed, suspect: listed, lane: listed ? 0 : 2 })],
    intakeSeq: 1,
    decisions: [],
    signals: [{ itemId: ITEM_MATCH, kind: "known_match", thresholdVersion: null, match }],
    matchedImages: [IMAGE_ONE],
    ...more,
  });
}

const caseProps: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};
const page = (view: CaseView) => html(<CaseScreenView {...caseProps} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} />);

describe("a match's record on a case (8.4)", () => {
  test("[case.match] as label and value, the source's three strings framed and escaped, never a hash value; [case.matchWeak] by the hash type", () => {
    const out = page(matchCase(record({ hashType: "md5" })));
    const shown = text(out);
    const M = AUTOMATION_WORDS.match;
    for (const label of [M.source, M.listVersion, M.hashType, M.matchKind, M.classification, M.queriedAt]) expect(shown).toContain(label);
    // Each string a source wrote stands in a frame "As the source returned it", and none is markup or a link.
    expect(shown.split(M.frame).length - 1).toBe(3);
    expect(out).not.toContain('href="javascript:');
    expect(shown).toContain(LOOKALIKE.label);
    expect(shown).toContain(bothTimes(AT));
    expect(shown).toContain(M.weak("md5")!);
    expect(M.weak("md5")).toBe("A file with the same MD5 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files.");
    expect(M.weak("sha1")).toBe("A file with the same SHA-1 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files.");
    expect(M.weak("pdq")).toBe("A perceptual hash describes how a picture looks. Two different pictures can have the same one, by accident or on purpose.");
    expect(M.weak("sha256")).toBeNull();
    expect(text(page(matchCase(record())))).not.toContain("can be made on purpose");
    expect(shown).toContain(M.what);
    expect(shown).toContain("Source: Found by a program");
  });

  test("the three kinds: acting with [case.matchActing] and 3c's banner; listed and not exact with [case.matchNear] and the banner; another class with [case.matchFlag] and no banner", () => {
    const M = AUTOMATION_WORDS.match;
    const acting = text(page(matchCase(record())));
    expect(acting).toContain(M.acting);
    expect(acting).not.toContain(M.near);
    const near = text(page(matchCase(record({ matchKind: "near", acting: false }))));
    expect(near).toContain(M.near);
    expect(near).not.toContain(M.acting);
    const flag = page(matchCase(record({ listed: false, acting: false, classification: "other-class" })));
    expect(text(flag)).toContain(M.flag);
    expect(flag).not.toContain("banner suspect");
    expect(page(matchCase(record()))).toContain("banner suspect");
    expect(page(matchCase(record({ matchKind: "near", acting: false })))).toContain("banner suspect");
  });

  test("[case.image.matched] in the place of a matched image, with no reveal control, before an answer and after an answer without a seal; the other image is offered as before", () => {
    const before = page(matchCase(record()));
    expect(text(before)).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched);
    expect(before).not.toContain("Show image");
    // After an answer without a seal the images are served to everyone again: the matched one stays closed to staff.
    const after = page(matchCase(record(), { imagesAllowed: true, suspicion: null, items: [item({ id: ITEM_MATCH, source: SOURCES.program, explanation: null, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE, ruleId: "R2", csam: true, suspect: true, outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: DECISION_SEAL })] }));
    expect(text(after)).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched);
    expect(after.split(">Show image<").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.image_matched).toBe(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched).toBe("Not opened: this image matched a list of known material. Nobody at korbat opens it, also after an answer without a seal.");
    void IMAGE_TWO;
  });

  test("a program's seal on a match: [case.auto] with the statement its author was sent, worded for a match, and [case.autoR2] while it is in force", () => {
    const sealing = decision({
      id: DECISION_SEAL,
      byProgram: true,
      staffHandle: null,
      source: "own_initiative",
      kind: "interim",
      ruleId: "R2",
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 4,
      suspect: true,
      decidedAt: AT,
      facts: null,
      reason: null,
      actions: [{ id: "3b4c5d6e-7f8a-4b9c-8d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e", kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] }, ...NO_STANDING }],
    });
    const view = matchCase(record({ source: "Example Hotline" }), { decisions: [sealing] });
    const shown = text(page(view));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR2);
    expect(shown).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.until.match);
    expect(shown).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askAdmin!);
    expect(statementParagraphs(programStatementOf(view, sealing))).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automated.notAssessed("csam", "exact"));
    const lifted = text(page(matchCase(record(), { decisions: [{ ...sealing, actions: sealing.actions.map((action) => ({ ...action, inForce: false })) }] })));
    expect(lifted).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR2);
  });
});

describe("the queue (8.3)", () => {
  test("[queue.matchFlag] after the program's chips; it moves nothing", () => {
    expect(marksOf(queueRow({ matchFlag: true }))).toEqual(["notice under Art. 16", AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueMatchFlag]);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueMatchFlag).toBe("A match that only flags");
    expect(marksOf(queueRow())).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueMatchFlag);
  });
});

describe("the composer on a case a match opened (8.4)", () => {
  const draftOf = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], more: Partial<ReturnType<typeof newDraft>> = {}) => ({ ...newDraft(parseCaseId(view.id)!, view, role), ...more });
  const composer = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], more: Partial<ReturnType<typeof newDraft>> = {}) => {
    const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft: draftOf(view, role, more), now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
    return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
  };
  const answer = { kind: "final" as const, outcome: "no_violation" as const, actions: [] };

  test("an answer without a seal on an acting match asks for one of the reasons, none chosen; a match that does not act, and a seal, ask for none", () => {
    const view = matchCase(record());
    expect(answerReasonNeeded(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, answer))).toBe(true);
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, answer);
    for (const label of Object.values(MATCH_ANSWER_REASON_LABELS)) expect(text(out)).toContain(label);
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/name="compose-match-reason"[^>]*checked/);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.answerReason.choose);
    expect(answerReasonNeeded(matchCase(record({ matchKind: "near", acting: false })), draftOf(view, ADMIN, answer))).toBe(false);
    expect(answerReasonNeeded(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] }))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the key signs the reason only where it is asked for, and a decision without it is refused before any request", async () => {
    const view = matchCase(record());
    const digests = { snapshot: "a".repeat(64), facts: "b".repeat(64), reason: "c".repeat(64), legalReference: null };
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, { ...answer, matchAnswerReason: "source_withdrew" }), digests).matchAnswerReason).toBe("source_withdrew");
    // Elsewhere the member is absent, so every other decision's params hash as they did before Task 7.
    const plain = postCase();
    expect("matchAnswerReason" in decisionParamsOf(plain, draftOf(plain, ADMIN, { kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] }), digests)).toBe(false);
    let asked = 0;
    const api = new Proxy({}, { get: () => () => (asked++, Promise.reject(new Error("no request may be sent"))) });
    const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api: api as never, credentials: { get: () => Promise.reject(new Error("no key")) } as never }, parseCaseId(view.id)!, view, { ...draftOf(view, ADMIN, answer), written: { facts: "The record is the source's word.", reason: "", legal_reference: "", review_reason: "" } });
    expect(outcome).toEqual({ error: AUTOMATION_WORDS.answerReason.choose, code: "incomplete" });
    expect(asked).toBe(0);
  });

  test("[case.autoRecord] gains its second sentence for an admin who restricts on a match's finding citing R2, and the preview is partly automated", () => {
    const view = matchCase(record({ source: "Example Hotline" }));
    const seal = { kind: "final" as const, outcome: "restricted" as const, ruleId: "R2" as const, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null }] };
    expect(restrictsOnMatch(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, seal))).toBe(true);
    expect(text(composer(view, ADMIN, seal))).toContain(`${AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecord} ${AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecordPartly}`);
    expect(text(composer(view, ADMIN, answer))).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoRecordPartly);
    const preview = previewOf(view, draftOf(view, ADMIN, seal), NOW);
    expect(preview).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "partially", signal: { kind: "known_match", source: "Example Hotline", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam" } });
    expect(statementParagraphs(preview).join(" ")).toContain("this decision rests on them in part");
    // A flag of another class is never partly automated: it cites no rule.
    const flag = matchCase(record({ listed: false, acting: false }));
    expect(restrictsOnMatch(flag, draftOf(flag, ADMIN, { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] }))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("[case.liftedMatch] in the place of 3c's sentence on a case that holds a match; the seal's facts draft is W.3's comparison about this post", () => {
    const view = matchCase(record({ source: "Example Hotline" }));
    const shown = text(composer(view, ADMIN, answer));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.liftedMatch);
    expect(shown).not.toContain("whoever is on duty opens the case's target the same day");
    expect(text(composer(frozenCase(), ADMIN, answer))).toContain("whoever is on duty opens the case's target the same day");
    const facts = matchSealFacts(view)!;
    expect(facts).toBe(
      "An automated comparison found that an image of this post has the same fingerprint as one that Example Hotline has classified as child sexual abuse material. korbat's staff do not open such an image, and korbat has not assessed it.",
    );
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.match_post).toContain("{comparison}");
    expect(sealDraftFor(view, "final").facts).toBe(facts);
    // A case with a person's report of such material keeps 3c's draft.
    expect(matchSealFacts(frozenCase({ signals: [] }))).toBeNull();
    void CASE_FROZEN;
  });
});

describe("Held uploads (8.6)", () => {
  const upload = (more: Partial<HeldUpload> = {}): HeldUpload => ({
    id: REFUSAL,
    refusedAt: AT,
    match: record(),
    otherRefusals: 2,
    uploaderGone: false,
    objection: null,
    objectedAt: null,
    endedAt: null,
    endAs: null,
    endReason: null,
    deletesAt: null,
    reported: false,
    quarantined: false,
    release: null,
    ...more,
  });
  const actions = (role: StaffMe["role"]): UploadsActions => ({ role, busy: null, errors: {}, onEnd: noop, onRelease: noop });
  const block = (more: Partial<HeldUpload> = {}, role: StaffMe["role"] = ADMIN) => html(<UploadBlock upload={upload(more)} actions={actions(role)} />);
  const W = CUSTODY_WORDS.uploads;

  test("a held refusal: its time, the match's record with [case.matchActing], [uploads.others], the state, and the two ends side by side with neither chosen nor focused", () => {
    const out = block();
    const shown = text(out);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.refusedAt(bothTimes(AT)));
    expect(shown).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.match.acting);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.others(2));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.state.open);
    expect(shown).toContain(`${W.report.label}: ${W.report.what}`);
    expect(shown).toContain(`${W.noReport.label}: ${W.noReport.what}`);
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/type="radio"[^>]*checked/);
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/autofocus/i);
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/<img|src=/);
    // The confirmation waits for a choice.
    expect(out).toMatch(/<button[^>]*disabled=""[^>]*>Confirm with your staff key/);
    // [uploads.unseen] names neither end: it says nothing of which to take.
    expect(W.unseen).not.toMatch(/"Report"|"No report"|Report[.]|No report/);
    expect(W.noReport.what).toContain(`${AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours} hours from now`);
  });

  test("[uploads.gone]; an objection after Report under the state line, framed; the end's reasons; the state lines; greyed for a moderator", () => {
    expect(text(block({ uploaderGone: true }))).toContain(W.gone);
    expect(W.gone).toContain(`up to ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days from the refusal`);
    const objected = block({ endAs: "report", endedAt: AT, reported: true, objection: HOSTILE.script, objectedAt: NOW.toISOString() });
    expect(text(objected)).toContain(W.state.report(bothTimes(AT), true, false));
    expect(text(objected)).toContain(W.objection.lead(bothTimes(NOW.toISOString())));
    expect(text(objected)).toContain(W.objection.by);
    expect(objected).not.toContain("<script>");
    const ended = upload({ endAs: "no_report", endReason: "counsel_no_duty", endedAt: AT, deletesAt: NOW.toISOString() });
    expect(stateLine(ended)).toBe(W.state.noReport(bothTimes(AT), UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS.counsel_no_duty, bothTimes(NOW.toISOString())));
    expect(text(block({}, MODERATOR))).toContain(W.adminOnly);
    expect(block({}, MODERATOR)).toMatch(/<fieldset disabled=""/);
  });

  test("which ends stay open, and what the key signs: neither end is a default and No report needs its reason", () => {
    expect(endsOffered(upload())).toEqual(["report", "no_report"]);
    expect(endsOffered(upload({ endAs: "report", endedAt: AT }))).toEqual(["no_report"]);
    expect(endsOffered(upload({ endAs: "no_report", endReason: "other", endedAt: AT, deletesAt: NOW.toISOString() }), NOW.getTime() - 1000)).toEqual(["report"]);
    expect(endsOffered(upload({ endAs: "no_report", endReason: "other", endedAt: AT, deletesAt: AT }), NOW.getTime())).toEqual([]);
    expect(holdEndParams(null, null)).toBeNull();
    expect(holdEndParams("no_report", null)).toBeNull();
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/automation-match.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY } from "@korbat/contracts";
import pino from "pino";
import { automatedStep, measureIn, sweepRound } from "../../src/moderation/automated";
import { retentionRound } from "../../src/moderation/retention";
import { insertMatchSignal, joinSignal } from "../../src/moderation/automated-repo";
import { recordIntakeIn, type IntakeGround } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { automationDeps, matchForTest, removeAutomation, signalForTest, signalRow, systemRowOf } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { MINORS, act, decisionRow, imagePost, imageStates, inForce, itemsOf, postFrozen, refusal, refusalDetail, removeFixtures } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ageCase, ageIntake, releaseItems } from "./retention-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

/** A program's finding under R2 as the step writes one for a listed match. */
const R2_GROUND: IntakeGround = {
  kind: "automated",
  channel: "system",
  reporterId: null,
  findingBy: null,
  contactId: null,
  ruleId: "R2",
  allegesIllegal: false,
  csam: false,
  category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R2,
  categoryKeyword: null,
  citedLaw: null,
  explanation: null,
  bonaFide: false,
  automatedProcessing: true,
};

// The step and a person's confirmed decisions run dozens of statements each: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

/**
 * LAB C as tests on the built code (3d design, sections 6.6, 6.7, 7.9, 7.11 and 12.3, O4; Task 7): the automatic seal
 * against the freeze, through the API's own statements, on the migration known_material. Each case of the lab's out-C.txt
 * is one test here with its code: C1 an acting match on one of a post's two images seals both while an admin decides and
 * freezes the post; C2 gate K keeps the frozen post's image rows against the API's role; C3 a person may still seal
 * while the automatic seal stands; C4 the other order, a program's seal after a person's, is already_protected (the
 * built code accepted it in the lab); C5 the fallback (AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS=off): the finding freezes and nothing is
 * sealed; C6 a moderator cannot answer the seal, and an admin's answer without a seal needs its reason (note 26) and ends
 * the seal and the freeze, unseen; C7 an admin's seal for good replaces the automatic one and is partly automated. With
 * gate K throughout, and E's strike_due answering false for a program's interim decision. A match that is not acting,
 * of either kind, seals nothing and is a finding (of R2, freezing) or a flag (no rule, freezing nothing).
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the automatic seal on a match (3d Task 7, LAB C)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let startedAt: string;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const media: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`);
    startedAt = row!.now;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await removeAutomation(migrateDb, startedAt, media);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A post with images by a new author, committed, whose first image the comparison matched: the step's outcome on it. */
  async function matched(images = 2, kind: "acting" | "near" | "other" = "acting", config: Parameters<typeof automationDeps>[2] = {}) {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const outcome = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test", ...config }), p.mediaIds[0]!, "known_match", 1, { kind });
    return { ...p, ...outcome };
  }

  test("C1: an acting match on one of two images seals both while an admin decides, lists the post with 2 images, and freezes it; the decision is the program's, fully automated, for no admin, never due a strike", async () => {
    const p = await matched(2);
    expect(p.handled).toBe("measure");
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(true);
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId: p.caseId! })).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
    const decision = await decisionRow(apiDb, p.decisionId!);
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: "interim", rule_id: "R2", suspect: true, automated_detection: true, automated_decision: "fully", needs_admin: false, decided_by: null, author_mail: "pending" });
    const [listed] = await apiDb.execute<{ images: number }>(
      sql`select s.images from seal_posts s join decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id where a.decision_id = ${p.decisionId!}::uuid and s.post_id = ${p.postId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(listed!.images).toBe(2);
    // The system's plain audit row names the decision and the signal; the params seal the post's images under R2.
    const audit = await systemRowOf(apiDb, p.decisionId!);
    expect(audit).toMatchObject({ actor_id: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "automated_decided", step_up: null, key_id: null });
    expect((audit!.metadata.params as { actions: unknown; ruleId: string }).actions).toEqual([{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }]);
    // The finding cites R2 in lane 0, suspect; the record names its case and is marked handled (review ruling 8).
    const signal = await signalRow(apiDb, p.signalId);
    const [item] = await itemsOf(apiDb, decision.case_id);
    expect(item).toMatchObject({ id: signal.intake_item_id, lane: 0, suspect: true, media_id: p.mediaIds[0] });
    const [record] = await apiDb.execute<{ case_id: string | null; handled: boolean; acting: boolean }>(sql`select case_id, handled_at is not null as handled, acting from media_matches where id = ${p.matchId!}::uuid`);
    expect(record).toEqual({ case_id: decision.case_id, handled: true, acting: true });
    // E's strike_due answers false for the program's interim decision: no strike rests on a program's measure.
    const [due] = await apiDb.execute<{ due: boolean }>(sql`select public.strike_due(${decision.case_id}::uuid, 'incompatible', 'R2', true, ${p.decisionId!}::uuid) as due`);
    expect(due!.due).toBe(false);
    // Its statement speaks of an exact match of a cryptographic hash, a measure by automated means, and an admin.
    const found = await decisionStatement(apiDb, p.decisionId!);
    expect(found!.statement).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "fully", signal: { kind: "known_match", source: "test", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam", viewed: null } });
    // A second entry for the same signal finds it handled and writes nothing.
    expect((await automatedStep(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" }), p.signalId)).handled).toBe("already");
  });

  test("C2: gate K while frozen: the API's role deletes none of the post's image rows", async () => {
    const p = await matched(2);
    const gone = await apiDb.execute(sql`delete from post_media where post_id = ${p.postId}::uuid returning id`);
    expect(gone.length).toBe(0);
    const [left] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from post_media where post_id = ${p.postId}::uuid`);
    expect(left!.n).toBe(2);
  });

  test("C3: a person may still seal while deciding on the case while the automatic seal stands: two seals in force", async () => {
    const p = await matched(2);
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    expect(typeof outcome).toBe("object");
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId: p.caseId! })).toEqual(["seal_media", "seal_media"]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("C4: the other order: a person's finding citing R2 and seal while deciding first, then an acting match: the program's seal is already_protected, its finding stands, its signal covered", async () => {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 2);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const finding = await world.moderation.forStaff.openFinding(admin.session, { target: { kind: "post", id: p.postId }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R2", category: MINORS });
    await world.moderation.settle();
    const sealed = await world.decideAs(admin, finding.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    expect(typeof sealed).toBe("object");
    const step = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" }), p.mediaIds[0]!, "known_match");
    expect(step.handled).toBe("covered");
    expect(step.decisionId).toBeNull();
    expect(step.caseId).toBe(finding.caseId);
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId: finding.caseId })).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
    expect((await signalRow(apiDb, step.signalId)).handled).toBe("covered");
  });

  test("C5: the fallback, AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS=off: the acting match's finding freezes the post and alerts, and nothing is sealed", async () => {
    const p = await matched(1, "acting", { AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS: "off" });
    expect([p.handled, p.decisionId]).toEqual(["finding", null]);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(true);
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId: p.caseId! })).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("C6: a moderator cannot answer the automatic seal; an admin's answer without a seal needs its reason, signed, and ends the seal and the freeze, unseen and not automated", async () => {
    const p = await matched(2);
    expect(await refusal(world.decideAs(moderator, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null }))).toBe("admin_required");
    // Without the reason note 26 asks for, and with one on another kind of decision, decision_holds (c) refuses at commit.
    const without = world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null });
    expect(await refusal(without)).toBe("invalid_decision");
    expect(await refusalDetail(world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, matchAnswerReason: null }))).toMatch(/^matchAnswerReason:/);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
    const answered = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, matchAnswerReason: "source_withdrew" });
    if (typeof answered === "string") throw new Error(answered);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible", "visible"]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(false);
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId: p.caseId! })).toEqual([]);
    const row = await decisionRow(apiDb, answered.decisionId);
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ unseen: true, suspect: true, automated_detection: true, automated_decision: "not_automated" });
    const [stored] = await apiDb.execute<{ reason: string | null }>(sql`select match_answer_reason as reason from decisions where id = ${answered.decisionId}::uuid`);
    expect(stored!.reason).toBe("source_withdrew");
    // The answer's statement: a person decided, unseen, on a program's finding of an exact match.
    const found = await decisionStatement(apiDb, answered.decisionId);
    expect(found!.statement).toMatchObject({ automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: { kind: "known_match", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam" } });
    // After the answer the images are public again, and the one function that serves staff an image still refuses them.
    expect(await world.moderation.deps.media.staffImage(p.mediaIds[0]!, "large")).toBe("matched");
  });

  test("C7: a moderator cannot seal for good; an admin's seal for good, unseen, replaces the automatic seal and is partly automated; the program's stays fully", async () => {
    const p = await matched(2);
    expect(await refusal(world.decideAs(moderator, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] }))).toBe("admin_required");
    const sealed = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    if (typeof sealed === "string") throw new Error(sealed);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { caseId: p.caseId! })).toEqual(["seal_media"]);
    const final = await decisionRow(apiDb, sealed.decisionId);
    expect(final).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", unseen: true, automated_detection: true, automated_decision: "partially", needs_admin: true });
    expect(await decisionRow(apiDb, p.decisionId!)).toMatchObject({ unseen: false, automated_detection: true, automated_decision: "fully", needs_admin: false });
    // A seal for good holds no reason: the reason belongs to an answer without a seal alone.
    const [stored] = await apiDb.execute<{ reason: string | null }>(sql`select match_answer_reason as reason from decisions where id = ${sealed.decisionId}::uuid`);
    expect(stored!.reason).toBeNull();
  });

  test("a near match of the listed class is a finding under R2 that freezes and seals nothing, whatever AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS says; its answer without a seal takes no reason", async () => {
    const p = await matched(1, "near");
    expect([p.handled, p.decisionId]).toEqual(["finding", null]);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(true);
    const [item] = await itemsOf(apiDb, p.caseId!);
    expect(item).toMatchObject({ lane: 0, suspect: true });
    const answered = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null });
    expect(typeof answered).toBe("object");
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(false);
    // A reason on an answer that needs none is refused as well.
    const q = await matched(1, "near");
    expect(await refusal(world.decideAs(admin, q.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, matchAnswerReason: "other" }))).toBe("invalid_decision");
  });

  test("a match of another class is a flag: no rule, lane 2, not suspect, nothing frozen or sealed, closed to staff all the same", async () => {
    const p = await matched(1, "other");
    expect([p.handled, p.decisionId]).toEqual(["finding", null]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, p.postId)).toBe(false);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
    const [item] = await itemsOf(apiDb, p.caseId!);
    expect(item).toMatchObject({ lane: 2, suspect: false });
    const [intake] = await apiDb.execute<{ rule_id: string | null; kind: string; category: string }>(
      sql`select n.rule_id, n.kind::text as kind, n.category from intakes n join intake_items i on i.intake_id = n.id where i.id = ${item!.id}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(intake).toEqual({ rule_id: null, kind: "automated", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE" });
    expect(await world.moderation.deps.media.staffImage(p.mediaIds[0]!, "large")).toBe("matched");
  });

  test("the database holds that a flag cannot seal: a program's seal whose signal names a record that is not acting is refused at commit, and a finding citing R2 for an unlisted record is refused by the signal's guard", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const deps = automationDeps(tx, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" });
      const live = [{ type: "post" as const, id: p.postId, position: 1, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }];
      // A near match of the listed class: its finding cites R2, and a seal written on it by hand, as an API under an
      // attacker's control would write one, is refused by decision_holds (b) at commit.
      const nearSignal = (await insertMatchSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, matchId: await matchForTest(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!, "near") }))!;
      const sealed = tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(sp, [p.authorId], "no key update");
        const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, sp, { ground: { ...R2_GROUND }, live });
        await joinSignal(sp, nearSignal, recorded.items[0]!.id);
        await measureIn(deps, sp, { caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, postId: p.postId, signalId: nearSignal, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, rule: "R2" });
        await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
      });
      expect(await refusal(sealed)).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const q = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const deps = automationDeps(tx, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" });
      // A match of another class: a finding citing R2 joined to its signal is refused by the guard of automated_signals.
      const flagSignal = (await insertMatchSignal(tx, { mediaId: q.mediaIds[0]!, matchId: await matchForTest(tx, q.mediaIds[0]!, "other") }))!;
      const joined = tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, sp, { ground: { ...R2_GROUND }, live: [{ type: "post", id: q.postId, position: 1, mediaId: q.mediaIds[0]! }] });
        await joinSignal(sp, flagSignal, recorded.items[0]!.id);
      });
      expect(await refusal(joined)).toMatch(/^42501 moderation_column/);
    });
  });

  test("6.7's case: an automatic seal answered without a seal, its intake made due and erased by 3c's retention job, then the sweep: the match opens no new intake", async () => {
    const p = await matched(1);
    const answered = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, matchAnswerReason: "source_withdrew" });
    if (typeof answered === "string") throw new Error(answered);
    const items = async () => (await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where target_id = ${p.postId}::uuid`))[0]!.n;
    const [first] = await apiDb.execute<{ intake_id: string }>(sql`select intake_id from intake_items where case_id = ${p.caseId!}::uuid limit 1`);
    // As the migrator: the answer released and the case and its intake two years old, so 3c's rules make the intake due.
    await releaseItems(migrateDb, first!.intake_id);
    await ageCase(migrateDb, p.caseId!, "2 years");
    await ageIntake(migrateDb, first!.intake_id, "2 years");
    await retentionRound({ apiDb, media: world.moderation.deps.media, log: pino({ level: "silent" }) });
    const before = await items();
    // The sweep reads the signals still waiting and the match records on posts that no signal took: this one was taken.
    await sweepRound(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" }));
    expect(await items()).toBe(before);
    const [record] = await apiDb.execute<{ handled: boolean }>(sql`select handled_at is not null as handled from media_matches where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
    expect(record!.handled).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update upload_refusals set refused_at = refused_at - interval '2 hours' where refused_at > now() - interval '1 hour'`);
    for (let i = 0; i < AUTOMATION_RULES.refusalsPerHour; i++) await uploaded(owner.id, MATCH_FIXTURES.acting);
    const before = events.length;

    expect(over.answer).toEqual({ id: over.id, status: "processing" });
    expect((await hashesOf(over.id))!.check_state).toBe("capped");
    expect(await refusalOf(over.id)).toBeNull();
    expect((await db.execute(sql`select 1 from media_matches where media_id = ${over.id}::uuid`)).length).toBe(0);
    expect(events.slice(before)).toEqual([{ kind: "capped" }]);
    // The upload file and the result stay for the next question; the sweeper neither finalizes nor fails it.
    expect(existsSync(h.files.uploads.upload(over.id))).toBe(true);
    await sweep(h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000), { reconcile: false });

    // Asked again within the hour: still capped. After it: refused and held.
    await matchRetryRound(h.deps, finalize);

    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update upload_refusals set refused_at = refused_at - interval '2 hours' where refused_at > now() - interval '1 hour'`);
    await matchRetryRound(h.deps, finalize);
    expect((await hashesOf(over.id))!.check_state).toBe("matched");
    expect(await refusalOf(over.id)).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("matcher_down: alert_steps() writes it daily once a check has been unchecked for matcherDownMinutes and none was answered since, with since, count and refusalsCapped", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // Every answered check is moved before the unchecked one, so none was answered since it.
      const owner = await h.established();
      const [image] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) values (${owner.id}::uuid, 'ready', 8, 8, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL') returning id`);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into media_hashes (media_id, sha256, sha1, md5, check_state) values (${image!.id}::uuid, ${Buffer.alloc(32)}::bytea, ${Buffer.alloc(20)}::bytea, ${Buffer.alloc(16)}::bytea, 'unchecked')`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update post_media set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${AUTOMATION_RULES.matcherDownMinutes + 1}::int) where id = ${image!.id}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update media_hashes set checked_at = now() - interval '2 days' where check_state in ('clear', 'matched')`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from alert_outbox where kind = 'matcher_down'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      const [alert] = await tx.execute<{ facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select facts from alert_outbox where kind = 'matcher_down'`);
      expect(alert).toBeDefined();
      expect(Object.keys(alert!.facts).sort()).toEqual(["count", "refusalsCapped", "since"]);
      expect(alert!.facts.count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      // Daily: a second round writes nothing.
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from alert_outbox where kind = 'matcher_down'`)).length).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  test("gate V: the one function that serves staff an image answers matched for an image an unerased match record names, on whatever case, and serves it again once the record is erased", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    adapter.flag = "unlisted";
    const flagged = await uploaded(owner.id, MATCH_FIXTURES.flag);
    adapter.flag = "near";
    const [post] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`insert into posts (author_id, body) values (${owner.id}::uuid, 'a post') returning id`);
    await db.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${post!.id}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'an image' where id = ${flagged.id}::uuid`);
    const cases = mediaForCases(h.deps);
    expect(await cases.staffImage(flagged.id, "large")).toBe("matched");
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`update media_matches set erased_at = now(), hash = null, classification = null where media_id = ${flagged.id}::uuid`);
      const [still] = await tx.execute<{ matched: boolean }>(sql`select exists (select 1 from media_matches x where x.media_id = ${flagged.id}::uuid and x.erased_at is null) as matched`);
      expect(still!.matched).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/moderation-uploads.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, MEDIA_SIZES, MediaStatusResponse, UploadResponse, type UploadHoldEndedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { MATCH_FIXTURES } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import type { AuthForModeration } from "../../src/auth";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { status } from "../../src/media/flows/status";
import { upload } from "../../src/media/flows/upload";
import { matchAdapterFrom, type TestMatchAdapter } from "../../src/media/match-adapter";
import { sweep } from "../../src/media/sweeper";
import { restoreView } from "../../src/moderation/gaps";
import { authorUpload, objectToUpload, refusalNotices } from "../../src/moderation/uploads";
import { ageCustodyForTest, planOf } from "./custody-fixtures";
import { bodyOf, mediaHarness, type MediaHarness } from "./media-harness";
import { closeDecisions, deciderWorld, suspendForTest, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { refusal, removeFixtures } from "./moderation-fixtures";

// Each test uploads, confirms with a key and dispatches: dozens of statements, slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * A refused upload after its refusal (3d design, sections 6.7, 7.12, 8.6, 8.10 and 9.5; 12.1 rows 6, 9, 17 and 18; Task
 * 7), on the test matcher and the acting byte-constant file: the uploader's notice and its one objection, also from a
 * suspended account and after an end as "Report"; the two ends of a hold under an admin's key, neither for a moderator,
 * with the hold on the image row, the hold on the address, the alert hold_ended_unreported, the delay of noReportHours
 * and the sweeper; the two notices through the dispatch step; upload-report, release-leave on the refusal and the
 * release, with the quarantine's destroy lines; Held uploads' list; and a lost end of a hold after a restore, closed by
 * an admin's end or replayed. Every mail goes to a recording auth interface.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: a refused upload after its refusal (3d Task 7)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let h: MediaHarness;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let startedAt: string;
  const owners: string[] = [];
  const refusals: string[] = [];
  const media: string[] = [];
  const gaps: string[] = [];
  const accountMails: { userId: string; template: string }[] = [];
  const staffMails: string[] = [];

  /** The auth module's interface as moderation calls it, recording every mail and taking each. */
  const auth = new Proxy({} as AuthForModeration, {
    get: (_target, member) => {
      if (typeof member !== "string" || member === "then") return undefined;
      if (member === "mailAccount") return async (userId: string, message: { template: string }) => (accountMails.push({ userId, template: message.template }), "sent");
      if (member === "mailStaff") return async (message: { template: string }) => (staffMails.push(message.template), 1);
      if (member === "overdueContacts") return async () => 0;
      return async () => undefined;
    },
  });
  const deps = () => ({ ...world.moderation.deps, auth });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    startedAt = (await migrateDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`))[0]!.now;
    h = await mediaHarness(apiDb, { match: matchAdapterFrom({ MEDIA_MATCH: "test", APP_SITE: "closed" }) as TestMatchAdapter });
    h.deps.matched.handler = async () => undefined;
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb, { auth });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    try {
      // The suspension's case and decisions, which suspendForTest made.
      await closeDecisions();
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where id = any(${`{${gaps.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      const notices = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select notification_id as id from public.upload_refusals where id = any(${`{${refusals.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and notification_id is not null`);
      const records = notices.map((row) => row.id);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set release_id = null where id = any(${`{${refusals.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${`{${media.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.release_notices where subject_id = any(${`{${refusals.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.releases where upload_refusal_id = any(${`{${refusals.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and replay_of is not null`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.releases where upload_refusal_id = any(${`{${refusals.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.release_leaves where notification_id = any(${`{${records.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, owners);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.authority_notifications where id = any(${`{${records.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('hold_ended_unreported', 'seal_released', 'moderation_urgent') and created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz`);
    } finally {
      h.cleanup();
      await world.close();
      await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  });

  const png = (bytes: Uint8Array) => ({ contentType: "image/png", contentLength: undefined, body: bodyOf(bytes) });
  /** An uploader whose upload of the acting file was refused: the refusal's id and the image's. */
  async function refused() {
    const owner = await h.established();
    owners.push(owner.id);
    const sent = UploadResponse.parse(await upload(h.deps, owner.id, png(MATCH_FIXTURES.acting)));
    h.worker.ready(sent.id, { width: 8, height: 8 });
    const answer = MediaStatusResponse.parse(await status(h.deps, owner.id, sent.id));
    if (answer.status !== "refused") throw new Error(`the acting file was not refused (${answer.status})`);
    refusals.push(answer.refusalId);
    media.push(sent.id);
    return { ownerId: owner.id, refusalId: answer.refusalId, mediaId: sent.id };
  }
  /** A whole confirmed end of a hold by this member's key. */
  async function endAs(member: RealStaff, refusalId: string, params: UploadHoldEndedParams) {
    const confirmed = await world.confirmAction(member, { action: "upload_hold_ended", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: refusalId }, params });
    return world.moderation.forStaff.endHold(member.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
  }
  const holdOf = async (mediaId: string) => (await migrateDb.execute<{ hold: string | null; erased: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until::text as hold, erased_at is not null as erased from post_media where id = ${mediaId}::uuid`))[0] ?? null;
  const addressOf = async (ownerId: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ released: boolean; reason: string | null }>(sql`select released_at is not null as released, release_reason as reason from auth.report_holds where user_id = ${ownerId}::uuid`))[0] ?? null;
  const cli = async (args: string[], input = "") => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! }, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input, "utf8"));
    return { code, text: lines.join(LF) };
  };

  test("the notice is its uploader's alone; one objection, also from a suspended account, and none twice (rows 6 and 9)", async () => {
    const r = await refused();
    const view = await authorUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ id: r.refusalId, source: "test", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam", objection: null, mayObject: true, endAs: null, released: null, reportKept: false });
    // Anyone else, and any id that names no refusal of theirs, reads as nothing.
    const other = await h.established();
    owners.push(other.id);
    expect(await refusal(authorUpload(deps(), other.id, r.refusalId))).toBe("not_found");
    expect(await refusal(objectToUpload(deps(), other.id, r.refusalId, { text: "not mine" }))).toBe("not_found");
    // The uploader is suspended under 3e: the objection stands all the same, as asking for a person does.
    await suspendForTest(apiDb, r.ownerId);
    const objected = await objectToUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId, { text: "This is a photo of my garden." });
    expect(objected).toMatchObject({ mayObject: false, objection: { text: "This is a photo of my garden." } });
    expect(await refusal(objectToUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId, { text: "again" }))).toBe("objection_not_open");
    // The refusal's notice goes out through the dispatch step, once.
    const due = new Date(Date.now() + 60_000);
    const before = accountMails.length;
    await refusalNotices(deps(), new Date(), due, 7, () => undefined);
    expect(accountMails.slice(before).filter((mail) => mail.userId === r.ownerId).map((mail) => mail.template)).toEqual(["upload_refused"]);
    await refusalNotices(deps(), new Date(), due, 7, () => undefined);
    expect(accountMails.filter((mail) => mail.userId === r.ownerId && mail.template === "upload_refused")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("Report and No report: an admin's key alone, neither by default; the image's hold, the address, the alert, an objection after Report, and the end that is no longer open (row 9)", async () => {
    const r = await refused();
    expect(await refusal(endAs(moderator, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null }))).toBe("admin_required");
    const reported = await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null });
    expect(reported).toMatchObject({ id: r.refusalId, endAs: "report", endReason: null, reported: false, deletesAt: null });
    expect((await holdOf(r.mediaId))!.hold).toBe("infinity");
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ actor: string; params: unknown; media: string; step_up: boolean }>(
      sql`select actor_id as actor, metadata -> 'params' as params, metadata ->> 'mediaId' as media, step_up is not null as step_up
            from public.audit_log where action = 'upload_hold_ended' and target_id = ${r.refusalId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(audit).toEqual({ actor: admin.id, params: { endAs: "report", reason: null }, media: r.mediaId, step_up: true });
    expect(await refusal(endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null }))).toBe("hold_not_open");
    // The uploader may object after Report, while korbat holds the file.
    expect((await objectToUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId, { text: "Please look again." })).objection?.text).toBe("Please look again.");

    // No report: the upload is deleted noReportHours from now, the address released, every staff account alerted.
    const mails = staffMails.length;
    const ended = await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "no_report", reason: "source_withdrew" });
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ endAs: "no_report", endReason: "source_withdrew" });
    const hours = (Date.parse(ended === "ended" || ended === "late" ? "" : ended.deletesAt!) - Date.now()) / 3_600_000;
    expect(hours).toBeGreaterThan(AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours - 0.1);
    expect(hours).toBeLessThanOrEqual(AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours);
    expect(await addressOf(r.ownerId)).toEqual({ released: true, reason: "declined" });
    await world.moderation.settle();
    const [alert] = await migrateDb.execute<{ facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select facts from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'hold_ended_unreported' and created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz order by created_at desc limit 1`);
    expect(Object.keys(alert!.facts).sort()).toEqual(["at", "deletesAt"]);
    expect(staffMails.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(mails);
    // Inside the delay an admin can still end it as Report: the hold is for good again and the address held again.
    const again = await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null });
    expect(again).toMatchObject({ endAs: "report" });
    expect((await holdOf(r.mediaId))!.hold).toBe("infinity");
    expect(await addressOf(r.ownerId)).toEqual({ released: false, reason: null });
    // No objection after an end as No report.
    await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "no_report", reason: "other" });
    expect((await authorUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId)).mayObject).toBe(false);
  });

  test("after No report the sweeper keeps the row for noReportHours and deletes it after; the uploader is told the hold was lifted, once (rows 9 and W.8)", async () => {
    const r = await refused();
    await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "no_report", reason: "counsel_no_duty" });
    // Within the delay the end is not told and the notice still shows the hold.
    expect((await authorUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId)).endAs).toBeNull();
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update post_media set created_at = now() - interval '3 days' where id = ${r.mediaId}::uuid`);
    await sweep(h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
    expect(await holdOf(r.mediaId)).not.toBeNull();
    await ageCustodyForTest(migrateDb, { refusal: r.refusalId }, `${AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours + 1} hours`);
    await sweep(h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
    expect(await holdOf(r.mediaId)).toBeNull();
    const view = await authorUpload(deps(), r.ownerId, r.refusalId);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ endAs: "no_report", endReason: "counsel_no_duty", mayObject: false });
    const before = accountMails.length;
    await refusalNotices(deps(), new Date(), new Date(Date.now() + 60_000), 7, () => undefined);
    expect(accountMails.slice(before).filter((mail) => mail.userId === r.ownerId).map((mail) => mail.template).sort()).toEqual(["upload_hold_lifted", "upload_refused"]);
    await refusalNotices(deps(), new Date(), new Date(Date.now() + 60_000), 7, () => undefined);
    expect(accountMails.filter((mail) => mail.userId === r.ownerId && mail.template === "upload_hold_lifted")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await refusal(endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null }))).toBe("hold_not_open");
  });

  test("upload-report, also for an account that is gone; release-leave on the refusal; the release on the leave, the plan's destroy lines, and no objection after it (rows 9 and 18)", async () => {
    const r = await refused();
    expect((await cli(["upload-report", r.refusalId, "--duty", "voluntary"])).text).toMatch(/hold_not_open: held upload .* did not end as Report/);
    // While the hold is open its files stay where they are; ended as Report they are due in the quarantine (row 15).
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [r.mediaId])).toEqual([]);
    await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null });
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [r.mediaId])).toEqual([`in ${r.mediaId}`]);
    // The uploader deletes the account: the record can still be opened, and says what the report can carry.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${r.ownerId}::uuid`);
    const opened = await cli(["upload-report", r.refusalId, "--duty", "voluntary"]);
    expect(opened.code).toBe(0);
    expect(opened.text).toMatch(/record [0-9a-f-]{36} opened for the held upload/);
    expect(opened.text).toContain("the uploader's account no longer exists");
    expect((await cli(["upload-report", r.refusalId, "--duty", "voluntary"])).text).toContain("has its record of a report already");
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select notification_id as id from upload_refusals where id = ${r.refusalId}::uuid`);
    const page = await world.moderation.forStaff.uploads();
    const listed = page.uploads.find((found) => found.id === r.refusalId)!;
    // `reported` says that the record of a report is opened (8.1); the release block says whether it was sent.
    expect(listed).toMatchObject({ endAs: "report", uploaderGone: true, reported: true, quarantined: false, release: { reported: false } });
    // No hash value (the hash type alone), no handle.
    expect(JSON.stringify(listed)).not.toMatch(/[0-9a-f]{32}|"hash"|handle/);
    // A leave cannot be recorded before the report is sent; then it can, on the refusal.
    const leave = ["release-leave", r.refusalId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "4 O 1/26", "--day", "2026-10-18", "--operator", "the operator"];
    expect((await cli(leave)).text).toContain("has no record of a report that was sent");
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'sent', sent_at = now(), authority = 'A test authority', channel = 'portal', sent_kinds = array['files'], not_kept_version = 1, closed_at = now() where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
    const recorded = await cli(leave);
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(0);
    expect(recorded.text).toContain("Held uploads screen");
    const facts = (await world.moderation.forStaff.uploads()).uploads.find((found) => found.id === r.refusalId)!.release!;
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ reported: true, quarantined: false, releasedAt: null });
    const params = { basis: "leave" as const, leaveId: facts.leave!.id, theirReference: "4 O 1/26" };
    const release = async (member: RealStaff) =>
      world.moderation.forStaff.releaseUpload(member.session, await world.confirmAction(member, { action: "upload_released", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: r.refusalId }, params }), { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    // Not before both files are in the quarantine by record; never by a moderator.
    expect(await refusal(release(admin))).toBe("release_not_quarantined");
    for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${r.mediaId}::uuid, ${storedImageName(r.mediaId, size)}, 1234, ${"b".repeat(64)}) on conflict do nothing`);
    }
    expect(await refusal(release(moderator))).toBe("admin_required");
    const released = await release(admin);
    expect(released).toMatchObject({ id: r.refusalId, release: { releasedAt: expect.any(String), basis: "leave" } });
    expect((await holdOf(r.mediaId))!.erased).toBe(true);
    // The plan's one line for the image, which names both of its files: they are to be destroyed.
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [r.mediaId])).toEqual([`destroy ${r.mediaId}`]);
    expect(await refusal(release(admin))).not.toBeNull();
    expect(await refusal(endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "no_report", reason: "other" }))).toBe("hold_not_open");
  });

  test("Held uploads: the open first, oldest first; the count of the same uploader's other held uploads, never one ended as No report; no handle (8.6)", async () => {
    const a = await refused();
    const sent = UploadResponse.parse(await upload(h.deps, a.ownerId, png(MATCH_FIXTURES.acting)));
    h.worker.ready(sent.id, { width: 8, height: 8 });
    const second = MediaStatusResponse.parse(await status(h.deps, a.ownerId, sent.id));
    if (second.status !== "refused") throw new Error("the second upload was not refused");
    refusals.push(second.refusalId);
    media.push(sent.id);

    const first = page.uploads.find((found) => found.id === a.refusalId)!;
    expect(first.otherRefusals).toBe(1);
    expect(first.match).toMatchObject({ source: "test", hashType: "sha256", matchKind: "exact", listed: true, acting: true });
    const open = page.uploads.filter((found) => found.endAs === null);
    expect(open.map((found) => found.refusedAt)).toEqual([...open.map((found) => found.refusedAt)].sort());
    await endAs(admin, second.refusalId, { endAs: "no_report", reason: "other" });
    expect((await world.moderation.forStaff.uploads()).uploads.find((found) => found.id === a.refusalId)!.otherRefusals).toBe(0);
  });

  test("after a restore: a lost end of a hold is closed by an admin's end again while the refusal is there, and replayed when it is gone (row 17)", async () => {
    const r = await refused();
    const gap = async (refusalId: string, mediaId: string, endAs: string) => {
      const [made] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
        insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, imported_at, class)
        values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, 900000000 + ${gaps.length}, ${"c".repeat(64)}, 'upload_hold_ended', 'upload_refusal', ${refusalId},
                ${JSON.stringify({ mediaId, params: { endAs, reason: endAs === "no_report" ? "other" : null } })}::jsonb, now() - interval '1 hour', now(), 'release')
        returning id`);
      gaps.push(made!.id);
      return made!.id;
    };
    const present = await gap(r.refusalId, r.mediaId, "report");
    const view = await restoreView(world.moderation.deps);
    expect(view.gaps.find((found) => found.id === present)).toMatchObject({ class: "release", hold: { endAs: "report", present: true } });
    expect(view.mayOpen).toBe(false);
    await endAs(admin, r.refusalId, { endAs: "report", reason: null });
    const [closed] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; closed: boolean }>(sql`select disposition, closed_at is not null as closed from public.restore_gaps where id = ${present}::uuid`);
    expect(closed).toEqual({ disposition: "reapplied", closed: true });
    // A refusal the restored database does not hold: replayed, which keeps its image row from every post.
    const lostRefusal = randomUUID();
    const lostMedia = (await refused()).mediaId;
    const gone = await gap(lostRefusal, lostMedia, "no_report");
    const [replayed] = await migrateDb.execute<{ result: string }>(sql`select public.upload_hold_replay(${lostRefusal}::uuid, ${lostMedia}::uuid, 'no_report', now() - interval '1 hour') as result`);
    expect(replayed!.result).toBe("replayed 1");
    const [after] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string }>(sql`select disposition from public.restore_gaps where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
    expect(after!.disposition).toBe("imported");
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ result: string }>(sql`select public.upload_hold_replay(${r.refusalId}::uuid, ${r.mediaId}::uuid, 'report', now()) as result`))[0]!.result).toBe("present");
    expect(await refusal(migrateDb.execute(sql`select public.upload_hold_replay(${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${r.mediaId}::uuid, 'report', now())`))).toBe("replay_no_gap");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/media/match-adapter.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MATCH_FIXTURES } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { createMediaFiles } from "../../src/media/files";
import {
  MATCH_ACTING,
  MATCH_LISTED,
  TEST_LISTED_CLASS,
  TEST_LIST_VERSION,
  TEST_SOURCE,
  TEST_UNLISTED_CLASS,
  matchAdapterFrom,
  matchRequest,
  matchedHash,
  type TestMatchAdapter,
  type UploadHashes,
} from "../../src/media/match-adapter";

/**
 * The comparison's adapter (3d design, sections 5 "The adapters", 7.8 and 12.2; Task 7): `off`, `test` and a source's
 * name, chosen by MEDIA_MATCH. The test adapter answers on the digests of the two byte-constant PNG files alone, which
 * node:crypto's digests of the same bytes are; one function builds a request, from the four hashes and nothing else; and
 * the upload's bytes are hashed as they are received, before anything else is done with them. This build computes no
 * PDQ: the owner has not allowed the fetch of the reference's vectors, so no request carries one.
 */
const sha = (algorithm: "sha256" | "sha1" | "md5", bytes: Uint8Array) => createHash(algorithm).update(bytes).digest();
const hashesOf = (bytes: Uint8Array): UploadHashes => ({ sha256: sha("sha256", bytes), sha1: sha("sha1", bytes), md5: sha("md5", bytes) });
const test_ = () => matchAdapterFrom({ MEDIA_MATCH: "test", APP_SITE: "closed" }) as TestMatchAdapter;

describe("the adapter", () => {
  test("off: the default, which is asked nothing and sends nothing", async () => {
    const off = matchAdapterFrom({ MEDIA_MATCH: "off", APP_SITE: "open" });
    expect(off.mode).toBe("off");
    expect(off.source).toBeNull();
    await expect(off.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.acting)))).rejects.toThrow(/off/);
  });

  test("a source's name stops the start: no such adapter in this build; the test adapter only on a closed site", () => {
    expect(() => matchAdapterFrom({ MEDIA_MATCH: "iwf", APP_SITE: "closed" })).toThrow("no such adapter in this build");
    expect(() => matchAdapterFrom({ MEDIA_MATCH: "test", APP_SITE: "open" })).toThrow(/APP_SITE is open/);
  });

  test("test: the acting file is an exact SHA-256 match of the listed and acting class; the flag file is near (SHA-1) or of the unlisted class (MD5); anything else is clear", async () => {
    const adapter = test_();
    expect([adapter.mode, adapter.source, adapter.listed, adapter.acting]).toEqual(["test", TEST_SOURCE, [TEST_LISTED_CLASS], [TEST_LISTED_CLASS]]);
    expect(await adapter.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.acting)))).toEqual({ state: "matched", hashType: "sha256", kind: "exact", classification: TEST_LISTED_CLASS, listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION });
    expect(await adapter.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.flag)))).toEqual({ state: "matched", hashType: "sha1", kind: "near", classification: TEST_LISTED_CLASS, listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION });
    adapter.flag = "unlisted";
    expect(await adapter.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.flag)))).toEqual({ state: "matched", hashType: "md5", kind: "exact", classification: TEST_UNLISTED_CLASS, listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION });
    expect(await adapter.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(new TextEncoder().encode("any other file"))))).toEqual({ state: "clear" });
    adapter.silent = true;
    expect(await adapter.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.acting)))).toEqual({ state: "unanswered" });
    adapter.silent = false;
    adapter.matchAll = true;
    expect((await adapter.check(matchRequest(hashesOf(new TextEncoder().encode("x"))))).state).toBe("matched");
    expect(adapter.requests).toHaveLength(6);
  });

  test("MATCH_LISTED and MATCH_ACTING: the test adapter's one pair, acting a part of listed", () => {
    expect(MATCH_LISTED).toEqual({ test: ["test_listed"] });
    expect(MATCH_ACTING).toEqual({ test: ["test_listed"] });
    for (const [source, acting] of Object.entries(MATCH_ACTING)) for (const classification of acting) expect(MATCH_LISTED[source]).toContain(classification);
  });
});

describe("the request builder", () => {
  test("it takes the four hashes alone and sends each as lower-case hexadecimal; no PDQ in this build, so the member is absent", () => {
    const hashes = hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.acting);
    const request = matchRequest(hashes);
    expect(Object.keys(request).sort()).toEqual(["md5", "sha1", "sha256"]);
    expect(request).not.toHaveProperty("pdq");
    expect(request.sha256).toBe("4088e46614abf60d00aed74d6062e2a363f78f022c0565e231277fb13b9b93c1");
    expect(request.sha1).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);
    expect(request.md5).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/);
    // Were a worker to give a PDQ, it would travel as hexadecimal too, and only then.
    expect(matchRequest({ ...hashes, pdq: new Uint8Array(32).fill(171) }).pdq).toBe("ab".repeat(32));
    // A caller cannot smuggle anything else through: the builder copies the four members it knows.
    expect(Object.keys(matchRequest({ ...hashes, id: "x", owner: "y" } as UploadHashes)).sort()).toEqual(["md5", "sha1", "sha256"]);
  });

  test("the match record keeps the hash the match rests on, never another", () => {
    const hashes = hashesOf(MATCH_FIXTURES.flag);
    expect(Buffer.from(matchedHash(hashes, "sha1")!).toString("hex")).toBe(createHash("sha1").update(MATCH_FIXTURES.flag).digest("hex"));
    expect(matchedHash(hashes, "pdq")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("the three hashers in receive (7.8)", () => {
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-match-"));
  afterAll(() => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const chunked = (bytes: Uint8Array, size: number) =>
    new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
      start(controller) {
        for (let at = 0; at < bytes.length; at += size) controller.enqueue(bytes.subarray(at, at + size));
        controller.close();
      },
    });

  test("the bytes as received, in chunks of any size, give node:crypto's SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5 of the whole file", async () => {
    const base = path.join(root, randomUUID());
    const files = createMediaFiles({ uploadsDir: path.join(base, "uploads"), storeDir: path.join(base, "store"), log: pino({ level: "silent" }) });
    await files.prepare();
    for (const dir of [files.store.files, files.store.results, files.store.attempts, files.store.tmp]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    for (const size of [1, 7, 4096]) {
      const received = await files.receiveHashed(randomUUID(), chunked(MATCH_FIXTURES.flag, size), 10_000, () => undefined);
      expect(received.bytes).toBe(MATCH_FIXTURES.flag.length);
      expect(Buffer.from(received.hashes.sha256).equals(sha("sha256", MATCH_FIXTURES.flag))).toBe(true);
      expect(Buffer.from(received.hashes.sha1).equals(sha("sha1", MATCH_FIXTURES.flag))).toBe(true);
      expect(Buffer.from(received.hashes.md5).equals(sha("md5", MATCH_FIXTURES.flag))).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { cloneElement, type ReactElement } from "react";

/**

vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({

}));
vi.mock("expo-image", () => ({ Image: () => <img alt="" /> }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);

const REFUSAL = "1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-000000000011";

});

describe("a refused upload in the composer (9.5)", () => {
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {

  ALERT_KIND_LIST,

  CHECK_STATES,

  MATCH_KINDS,
  MATCH_RETRY_BATCH,
  MediaErrorCode,
  MediaStatusResponse,
  ModerationErrorCode,
  QueueRow,
  RestoreGap,
  SEAL_DRAFTS,
  SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS,
  STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS,
  StaffStepUpOptionsRequest,
  UPLOAD_END_REASONS,
  UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS,
  UPLOAD_ENDS,
  UploadHoldEndedParams,
  UploadRefusalView,
  UploadReleasedParams,
  alertPlaceholders,
  renderAlert,
  statementMatchKind,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * Known material's contracts (3d design, sections 6.7, 7.8, 7.11, 7.12, 10 and W.7; Task 7): the closed lists each CHECK
 * is written from, the derived kind of match a statement prints, the strict params of the two step-ups of Held uploads
 * and the reason an answer without a seal on an acting match signs, the shapes staff and the uploader are given (never a
 * hash, a file or a handle), and the two alerts.
 */
describe("known material's constants", () => {
  test("the closed lists of section 10.1, each the CHECK of its column, and the retry's batch", () => {
    expect(CHECK_STATES).toEqual(["pending", "clear", "matched", "unchecked", "capped"]);
    expect(MATCH_HASH_TYPES).toEqual(["sha256", "sha1", "md5", "pdq"]);
    expect(MATCH_KINDS).toEqual(["exact", "near"]);
    expect(UPLOAD_ENDS).toEqual(["report", "no_report"]);
    expect(UPLOAD_END_REASONS).toEqual(["source_withdrew", "counsel_no_duty", "other"]);
    expect(MATCH_ANSWER_REASONS).toEqual(["source_withdrew", "counsel", "other"]);
    expect(MATCH_RETRY_BATCH).toBe(20);
    // Every reason has its console's label, and no label tells an admin which end to take.
    expect(Object.keys(UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS)).toEqual([...UPLOAD_END_REASONS]);
    expect(Object.keys(MATCH_ANSWER_REASON_LABELS)).toEqual([...MATCH_ANSWER_REASONS]);
    for (const label of [...Object.values(UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS), ...Object.values(MATCH_ANSWER_REASON_LABELS)]) expect(label).not.toMatch(/Report when|Choose/);
    // The numbers of known material in automation_rules(), which a database test holds column for member.
    expect([AUTOMATION_RULES.refusalsPerHour, AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours, AUTOMATION_RULES.matchTimeoutMs, AUTOMATION_RULES.matchRetryHours, AUTOMATION_RULES.matcherDownMinutes, AUTOMATION_RULES.pdqMinQuality, AUTOMATION_RULES.matchKeepDays]).toEqual([
      20, 24, 3000, 24, 15, 50, 180,
    ]);
  });

  test("a statement's kind of match is derived, never copied: exact only for an exact match of a cryptographic hash, near for every perceptual match (W.3)", () => {
    expect(statementMatchKind("sha256", "exact")).toBe("exact");
    expect(statementMatchKind("sha1", "exact")).toBe("exact");
    expect(statementMatchKind("md5", "exact")).toBe("exact");
    expect(statementMatchKind("pdq", "exact")).toBe("near");
    expect(statementMatchKind("sha256", "near")).toBe("near");
    expect(statementMatchKind("pdq", "near")).toBe("near");
  });

  test("the facts draft of a seal on a match says what the comparison found, holds the comparison's place and nothing of a hash, a list or a class", () => {
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.match_post).toBe("{comparison}. korbat's staff do not open such an image, and korbat has not assessed it.");
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.match_post).not.toMatch(/reported|is child sexual abuse material|confirmed/);
  });
});

describe("the step-ups of Held uploads and the reason of an answer without a seal (10.4)", () => {
  const uuid = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";

  test("upload_hold_ended: an end with no default, a reason exactly with no_report, strict", () => {
    expect(UploadHoldEndedParams.safeParse({ endAs: "report", reason: null }).success).toBe(true);

    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse(base).success).toBe(true);

    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...base, matchAnswerReason: null }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...base, matchAnswerReason: "because" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse({ ...base, kind: "interim", throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R2", factsDigest: "b".repeat(64), reasonDigest: "c".repeat(64), actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }], matchAnswerReason: "other" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("what staff and the uploader are given", () => {
  const record = { source: "test", listVersion: "test-1", hashType: "sha256", matchKind: "exact", classification: "test_listed", listed: true, acting: true, queriedAt: "2026-10-19T10:00:00.000Z" };

  test("a case's signal carries a match's record, never a hash; a queue row its flag", () => {
    expect(CaseSignal.parse({ itemId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", kind: "known_match", thresholdVersion: null, match: record }).match).toEqual(record);

describe("the two alerts of known material (W.7)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-19T12:00:00.000Z");

  test("they follow automated_waiting at the end of the list, each a push and a sentence to every staff account, with counts and times only", () => {
```
