```ts
          expect(() => loadConfig({ ...prod, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: origin }), origin).toThrow(/CONSOLE_RP_ID cannot be an IP address or localhost in production/);
        }
      });
    });
    test("development accepts what only production refuses: http, the app's hostname, a shared or foreign relying party ID", () => {
      // Both relying party IDs are localhost in development; only the tables keep staff keys and passkeys apart there.
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: consoleOrigin })).toMatchObject({ CONSOLE_RP_ID: "localhost", WEBAUTHN_RP_ID: "localhost" });
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, APP_ORIGIN: "http://app.localhost:8081", CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "http://localhost:8090" }).CONSOLE_RP_ID).toBe("localhost");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: consoleOrigin, CONSOLE_RP_ID: "other.example" }).CONSOLE_RP_ID).toBe("other.example");
      expect(loadConfig({ ...good, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "http://127.0.0.1:8090" }).CONSOLE_RP_ID).toBe("127.0.0.1");
    });
  });
```

```ts
const R1_GROUND: IntakeGround = {

  channel: "system",
  reporterId: null,
  findingBy: null,
  contactId: null,
  ruleId: "R1",
  allegesIllegal: false,
  csam: false,
  category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1,
  categoryKeyword: null,
  citedLaw: null,
  explanation: null,
  bonaFide: false,
  automatedProcessing: true,

/** The nine faults of LAB A2, and the decider check of A3, each written through the step's own statements with one change. */
type Fault = "final" | "no_audit" | "staff_audit" | "no_signal" | "two_measures" | "measure_remove" | "rule_r3" | "finding_r3" | "seal_on_r1" | "seal_under_r2" | "other_post_image" | "plain_actor";

/**
 * The automated decision on the database (3d design, sections 6.6 and 12.1 rows 2 to 4 and 7; LAB A as tests on the built
 * code, O4): the built decisions_record and decision_holds, which carry 3e's and 3f's branches, replaced by the migration
 * automated_decisions with its changes alone. Each case of out-A.txt is one test here with the same code, written through
 * the API's own statements (the step's finding, measure and audit row, the module's insert of a decision and of a ledger
 * row): A1 a program's withhold that commits; A2's nine faults, each refused and leaving nothing; a person's decision that
 * claims fully; A3 the API's role that cannot update a decision; A4 the fallback; A5 to A7 a person's final decision, a
 * correction and "no breach" after a program's measure; A8 the caps, here per rule and with the two limits on unanswered
 * measures. A program's decisions commit with the system's plain audit row; the faults and the caps run in transactions
 * that are rolled back. The person's decisions commit with real keys (moderation-decide.ts).
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the automated decision on the database (3d Task 6, LAB A)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  /** A placeholder key: an audit row it confirms is only ever written in a transaction that is rolled back. */
  let staffKey: TestStaff;

    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(authDb)]);
  });

  /** A post with images by a new author, committed, whose first image the program scores; the step's outcome on it. */
  async function program(images = 1, config: Parameters<typeof automationDeps>[2] = {}) {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const outcome = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, config), p.mediaIds[0]!);

  }

  /**
   * One fault of LAB A2, in a transaction that is rolled back, as the API's role: the step's own statements in its order
   * (the author's profile, the finding, the snapshot, the decision, its ledger rows, the signal, the audit row) with the
   * one change the fault names, then the check at commit made to run at once. Answers the code the database raised, or
   * null when the decision stood.
   */
  async function faulty(fault: Fault): Promise<{ code: string | null; detail: string | null }> {
    let result: { code: string | null; detail: string | null } = { code: null, detail: null };
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
      const other = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const deps = automationDeps(tx);
      const mediaId = fault === "other_post_image" ? other.mediaIds[0]! : p.mediaIds[0]!;
      const signalId = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      const attempt = tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(sp, [p.authorId], "no key update");
        const ground = fault === "finding_r3" ? { ...R1_GROUND, ruleId: "R3" as const, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R3 } : R1_GROUND;
        const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, sp, { ground, live: [{ type: "post", id: p.postId, position: 1, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] });
        const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
        await joinSignal(sp, signalId, recorded.items[0]!.id);
        const row = (await caseById(sp, caseId))!;
        const snapshot = await snapshotIn(deps, sp, row);
        const stateVersion = (await caseById(sp, caseId))!.stateVersion;
        let params: Record<string, unknown> = automatedParams({ stateVersion, snapshot, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! });
        if (fault === "final") params = { ...params, kind: "final", throughSeq: row.intakeSeq };
        if (fault === "rule_r3") params = { ...params, ruleId: "R3", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R3 };
        if (fault === "measure_remove") params = { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "remove_media", mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] };
        if (fault === "two_measures") params = { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }, { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] };
        if (fault === "seal_on_r1") params = { ...params, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] };
        if (fault === "seal_under_r2") params = { ...params, ruleId: "R2", category: MINORS, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] };
        const decisionId = randomUUID();
        await insertSystemDecision(sp, { id: decisionId, caseId, params: params as AutomatedDecidedParams });
        for (const action of params.actions as { kind: "withhold_media"; mediaId: string }[]) await insertAction(sp, decisionId, action);
        if (fault !== "no_signal") await signalHandled(sp, signalId, "measure", decisionId);
        const metadata = { params, decisionId, signalId, target: { type: "post", id: p.postId } };
        if (fault === "staff_audit") {
          await staffProfile(sp, staffKey);
          await appendConfirmedAudit(sp, {
            actorId: staffKey.id,
            keyId: staffKey.keyId,
            action: "case_decided",
            targetType: "case",
            targetId: caseId,
            metadata,
            staffSession: randomUUID(),
            actionHash: hex64(),
            stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
            requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
            expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),

        } else if (fault === "plain_actor") {
          await staffProfile(sp, staffKey);
          await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: staffKey.id, action: "automated_decided", targetType: "case", targetId: caseId, requestId: null, metadata });
        } else if (fault !== "no_audit") {
          await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "automated_decided", targetType: "case", targetId: caseId, requestId: null, metadata });
        }

  test("LAB A1: a program's withhold of one image commits without a decider, fully automated and detected, for no admin, its statement pending, the system's plain audit row last", async () => {

  test("LAB A2: each of the nine faults is refused, invalid_decision or the intake's CHECK, and leaves nothing", async () => {
    const counts = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
    expect(await faulty("final")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });

    expect(await faulty("no_signal")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("two_measures")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("measure_remove")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect(await faulty("rule_r3")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });
    expect((await faulty("finding_r3")).code).toMatch(/^23514 .*intakes_automated/);
    // A seal resting on an R1 score: under R1 decision_actions_check refuses a seal on no suspect item; under R2 the

    expect(await faulty("seal_on_r1")).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision" });

  test("decision_holds names the member at fault in its detail", async () => {

    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(outcome);

    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["removed"]);

    expect(await decisionRow(apiDb, p.decisionId!)).toMatchObject({ kind: "interim", decided_by: null, automated_decision: "fully", ended_interim: false });
    // Its statement's data says what found it, and that the moderator did not open the image on this case.

    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(outcome);
    expect(await imageStates(apiDb, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["visible"]);
    expect(await inForce(apiDb, { postId: p.postId })).toEqual([]);

    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(outcome);

  test("already_protected: a person's withhold of the post, or of the image, stands for the program's, whose finding is kept as covered", async () => {
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {

      for (const measure of ["withhold", "withhold_media"] as const) {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        await decideWith(tx, staffKey, caseId, await decisionParams(tx, staffKey, caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act(measure, measure === "withhold" ? null : p.mediaIds[0]!)] }));

        expect((await signalRow(tx, signalId)).intake_item_id, measure).not.toBeNull();
        // The other image of the post is not covered by a withhold of the first one alone; a withhold of the post covers it.
        const second = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[1]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;

  describe("LAB A8 on the built code: the caps by rule and the two limits on unanswered measures", () => {
    /**
     * A day of a program's decisions, written as the migrator with the decision triggers off (as yearForTest writes its
     * year), inside the caller's transaction, which is rolled back: `n` decisions without a decider under `rule`, `ago` in
     * the past, on open cases of posts of new authors; when `inForce`, each with a withhold_media of an image of its own,
     * four to a post (a post holds four images), one case a post. A test calls it before its first step: a step's
     * decision leaves the commit's checks pending, and a table with pending checks cannot have its triggers turned off.
     */
    async function history(tx: DbTx, n: number, rule: "R1" | "R2", ago: string, inForce: boolean): Promise<{ actionIds: string[] }> {
      const perPost = inForce ? 4 : n;
      const groups: { postId: string; authorId: string; mediaIds: string[]; caseId: string; snapshot: { id: string; digest: string }; count: number }[] = [];
      for (let left = n; left > 0; left -= perPost) {
        const count = Math.min(perPost, left);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, inForce ? count : 0);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const [snapshot] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; digest: string }>(sql`select id, digest from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid limit 1`);
        groups.push({ ...p, caseId, snapshot: snapshot!, count });
      }
      for (const table of ["decisions", "decision_actions"]) await tx.execute(sql.raw(`alter table public.${table} disable trigger user`));
      const actionIds: string[] = [];
      for (const group of groups) {
        const made = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                        snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim,
                                        automated_detection, automated_decision)
          select ${group.caseId}::uuid, 'interim', 0, 'restricted', 'incompatible', ${rule}, 3, 4, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'own_initiative',
                 ${group.snapshot.id}::uuid, ${group.snapshot.digest}, null, now() - ${ago}::interval, '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g::text), now() - ${ago}::interval,
                 false, false, false, true, 'fully'
            from generate_series(1, ${group.count}::int) g
          returning id`);
        if (!inForce) continue;
        for (const [i, decision] of made.entries()) {
          const [action] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
            insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id, created_at)
            values (${decision.id}::uuid, 'withhold_media', ${group.mediaIds[i]!}::uuid, ${group.authorId}::uuid, ${group.postId}::uuid, now() - ${ago}::interval) returning id`);
          actionIds.push(action!.id);
        }
      }
      for (const table of ["decisions", "decision_actions"]) await tx.execute(sql.raw(`alter table public.${table} enable trigger user`));
      return { actionIds };
    }

    /**
     * What the database already counts for a rule, committed by this file's earlier tests: the R1 decisions without a
     * decider of the last hour, and their measures in force. The limits count every program's decision, so a test fills
     * a limit up from there.
     */
    async function counted(tx: DbTx, rule: "R1" | "R2"): Promise<{ hour: number; unanswered: number }> {
      const [row] = await tx.execute<{ hour: number; unanswered: number }>(sql`
        select (select count(*)::int from public.decisions d where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = ${rule} and d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as hour,
               (select count(*)::int from public.measures_in_force m join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id
                 where d.decided_by is null and d.rule_id = ${rule}) as unanswered`);
      return row!;
    }

    /** A new post's image scored and stepped as the migrator's transaction sees it; the step's outcome. */
    async function step(tx: DbTx) {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const signalId = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      return { ...(await automatedStep(automationDeps(tx), signalId)), signalId, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! };
    }

    test("the hour's cap is R1's own: twenty R2 decisions in the hour leave R1 its measure, twenty R1 ones refuse the next with its finding kept", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.r2DecisionsPerHour, "R2", "10 minutes", false);
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerHour - 1 - (await counted(tx, "R1")).hour, "R1", "10 minutes", false);
        // The twentieth R1 decision of the hour is taken: R2's twenty are not R1's.
        expect((await step(tx)).handled).toBe("measure");
        const capped = await step(tx);
        expect([capped.handled, capped.limit, capped.decisionId]).toEqual(["capped", "hour", null]);
        expect((await signalRow(tx, capped.signalId)).intake_item_id).not.toBeNull();
        expect(await imageStates(tx, [capped.mediaId])).toEqual(["visible"]);
        // The alert says which limit was met, and how many findings stand without a measure since.
        const [alert] = await tx.execute<{ facts: Record<string, number | string> }>(sql`select facts from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'automation_capped' order by id desc limit 1`);
        expect(alert!.facts).toMatchObject({ limitHour: 1, count: 1 });
      });
    });

    test("3d Task 7 (row 4): twenty R1 decisions in the hour, then an acting match on a post, which is sealed: the counts are taken per rule", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerHour - (await counted(tx, "R1")).hour, "R1", "10 minutes", false);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const signalId = (await insertMatchSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, matchId: await matchForTest(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!, "acting") }))!;
        const sealed = await automatedStep(automationDeps(tx, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" }), signalId);
        expect(sealed.handled).toBe("measure");
        expect(await imageStates(tx, p.mediaIds)).toEqual(["sealed"]);
      });
    });

    test("the day's cap: a hundred R1 decisions of the last day refuse the next, as day", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.decisionsPerDay, "R1", "3 hours", false);
        expect(await step(tx)).toMatchObject({ handled: "capped", limit: "day" });
      });
    });

    test("unanswered: twenty R1 measures in force stop a new one under R1 alone, and a person's answer lets the program act again", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const { actionIds } = await history(tx, AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredMax - (await counted(tx, "R1")).unanswered, "R1", "3 days", true);
        expect(await step(tx)).toMatchObject({ handled: "capped", limit: "unanswered" });
        // One measure lifted, as a person's correction lifts it: nineteen wait, and the program takes its measure again. The
        // capped step left no check pending (it wrote no decision), so the triggers can be turned off once more.
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.decision_actions disable trigger user`);
        const [lifted] = await tx.execute<{ decision_id: string; media_id: string; subject_account_id: string; post_id: string }>(
          sql`select decision_id, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id from public.decision_actions where id = ${actionIds[0]!}::uuid`,
        );
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, post_id, reverses_action_id, created_at)
                             values (${lifted!.decision_id}::uuid, 'restore_media', ${lifted!.media_id}::uuid, ${lifted!.subject_account_id}::uuid, ${lifted!.post_id}::uuid, ${actionIds[0]!}::uuid, now())`);
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.decision_actions enable trigger user`);
        expect((await step(tx)).handled).toBe("measure");
      });
    });

    test("waiting: a request for a person older than unansweredHours, its measure in force, stops new measures under either rule", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const first = await step(tx);
        expect(first.handled).toBe("measure");
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.automated_objections (decision_id, text) values (${first.decisionId!}::uuid, 'Please look again.')`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_objections set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${AUTOMATION_RULES.unansweredHours + 1}::int) where decision_id = ${first.decisionId!}::uuid`);
        expect(await step(tx)).toMatchObject({ handled: "capped", limit: "waiting" });
      });
    });
  });

  test("no row of a program's decision is left by the faults: the file's counts are its committed programs' alone", async () => {
    const now = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
    // Each committed program above wrote one decision; the faults and the caps wrote nothing that stayed.
    expect(now.decisions! - before.decisions!).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const [stray] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions d where d.decided_by is null and not exists (select 1 from automated_signals s where s.decision_id = d.id)`);
    expect(stray!.n).toBe(0);
  });

  test("the measure's own write path is the one the step runs (measureIn), and a second program's measure meets the case's lock order", async () => {
    // measureIn is what the step's savepoint runs: called as the step calls it, inside a transaction that is rolled back.
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const deps = automationDeps(tx);
      const signalId = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, tx, { ground: R1_GROUND, live: [{ type: "post", id: p.postId, position: 1, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! }] });
      await joinSignal(tx, signalId, recorded.items[0]!.id);
      const decisionId = await measureIn(deps, tx, { caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, postId: p.postId, signalId, mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]! });
      await tx.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
      expect((await decisionRow(tx, decisionId)).automated_decision).toBe("fully");
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { MatchHashType, MatchKind, SignalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { automatedStep, type StepOutcome } from "../../src/moderation/automated";
import { TEST_LISTED_CLASS, TEST_LIST_VERSION, TEST_SOURCE, TEST_UNLISTED_CLASS } from "../../src/media/match-adapter";
import { createMatchRepo } from "../../src/media/match-repo";
import { insertMatchSignal, insertScoreSignal } from "../../src/moderation/automated-repo";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { moderationDeps, uuids, type Runner } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * The automated decision's fixtures (3d design, section 12; Task 6). A test builds the moderation module's dependencies
 * with the settings it needs, on its own configuration, as the tests build every adapter in the process: the scorer `test`
 * (whose threshold is 0.5 under version 0) and, unless said, AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS on. The configuration's refusal of a test
 * adapter on an open site is the configuration's own test; these settings never reach loadConfig.
 */

/** The configuration of a server whose R1 check runs, flagging or (the default here) withholding. */
export function automationConfig(over: Partial<Config> = {}): Config {
  return { ...loadConfig(), R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: "on", APP_SITE: "closed", ...over };
}

/** The moderation module's dependencies over a pool or a transaction, with automationConfig's settings. */
export function automationDeps(db: Runner, over: Partial<ModerationDeps> = {}, config: Partial<Config> = {}): ModerationDeps {
  return moderationDeps(db, { config: automationConfig(config), ...over });
}

/** A signal the fixture wrote and the step's outcome on it. */
export interface Signalled extends StepOutcome {
  signalId: string;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7: a match record of an image, as the comparison writes one, as the API's role (its trigger forces `listed` and
 * `acting`): by default an exact SHA-256 match of the test source's listed and acting class, the record that acts.
 * `near` gives a near match of that class (listed, not acting); `other` the class the source does not list (a flag).
 */
export async function matchForTest(db: Runner, mediaId: string, kind: "acting" | "near" | "other" = "acting", hashType: MatchHashType = kind === "near" ? "sha1" : kind === "other" ? "md5" : "sha256"): Promise<string> {
  const matchKind: MatchKind = kind === "near" ? "near" : "exact";
  const record = await createMatchRepo(db as Db).insertMatch(db, {
    mediaId,
    source: TEST_SOURCE,
    listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION,
    hashType,
    kind: matchKind,
    classification: kind === "other" ? TEST_UNLISTED_CLASS : TEST_LISTED_CLASS,
    hash: randomBytes(hashType === "md5" ? 16 : hashType === "sha1" ? 20 : 32),
  });
  return record.id;
}

/**
 * `signalForTest(media, kind)` (design, section 12): inserts a signal as the API's role, as the step's first statement
 * writes one, and runs the automated step once on it. A score's signal carries `score` (1, over every threshold, unless
 * said) under the test scorer's version 0. 3d Task 7: a match's signal names a match record, written by matchForTest
 * (the acting kind unless `match` says) unless an id is given.
 */
export async function signalForTest(deps: ModerationDeps, mediaId: string, kind: SignalKind = "r1_score", score = 1, match: { id?: string; kind?: "acting" | "near" | "other" } = {}): Promise<Signalled & { matchId: string | null }> {
  if (kind === "known_match") {
    const matchId = match.id ?? (await matchForTest(deps.apiDb, mediaId, match.kind ?? "acting"));
    const signalId = await insertMatchSignal(deps.apiDb, { mediaId, matchId });
    if (signalId === null) throw new Error("the image has a match's signal already");
    return { signalId, matchId, ...(await automatedStep(deps, signalId)) };
  }
  const signalId = await insertScoreSignal(deps.apiDb, { mediaId, score, thresholdVersion: 0 });
  if (signalId === null) throw new Error("the image has a score's signal already");
  return { signalId, matchId: null, ...(await automatedStep(deps, signalId)) };
}

/** A signal's row as the step left it. */
export async function signalRow(db: Runner, id: string): Promise<{ handled: string | null; handled_at: string | null; decision_id: string | null; intake_item_id: string | null; kind: string; score: number | null }> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ handled: string | null; handled_at: string | null; decision_id: string | null; intake_item_id: string | null; kind: string; score: number | null }>(
    sql`select handled, handled_at::text as handled_at, decision_id, intake_item_id, kind, score from public.automated_signals where id = ${id}::uuid`,
  );
  return { ...row! };
}

/** The system's audit row that names a decision, as the chain holds it. */
export async function systemRowOf(db: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<{ actor_id: string; action: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; step_up: unknown; key_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> } | null> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ actor_id: string; action: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; step_up: unknown; key_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
    sql`select actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, step_up, key_id, metadata from public.audit_log where metadata ->> 'decisionId' = ${decisionId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
  );
  return row ?? null;
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, what a test of the automated decision committed beyond what removeFixtures takes with its
 * profiles: the alert rows of the three kinds (and moderation_urgent) raised since the test began.
 */
export async function removeAutomation(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, alertsSince: string, mediaIds: readonly string[] = []): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.automated_signals where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  // 3d Task 7: the match records of these images, and refusals that name them.
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.upload_refusals where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.media_matches where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.edge_purges where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(
    sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('automated_objection', 'automation_capped', 'automated_waiting', 'moderation_urgent', 'moderation_csam_lifted', 'matcher_down', 'hold_ended_unreported', 'seal_released') and created_at >= ${alertsSince}::timestamptz`,
  );
}
```

```ts
      expect(after.oldest).toMatch(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$/);

        await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { signal: signal!.id }, `${SWEEP_HOURS} hours 1 minute`);
        expect(await count()).toBe(before + 1);
      });
    } finally {
      await closeDb(migrateDb);
    }
  });
```

```ts
 * retired rows without a place; retires every stored value whose place and hash the restored chain no longer holds,

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: staff.js head-restore-mark (3d Task 5)", () => {
  let migrateDb: Db;

  const ZEROS = "0".repeat(64);

  beforeAll(async () => {
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    await cleanUp();
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await cleanUp();
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
  });

  test("its words: day:value pairs or none; a day that is no day, a value that is no head's, or a day given twice is refused before anything is read", () => {
    expect(parseFigureArgs("head-restore-mark", [])).toEqual({ command: "head-restore-mark", values: [] });
    expect(parseFigureArgs("head-restore-mark", [`2026-10-17:${"a".repeat(64)}`, `2026-10-18:${"b".repeat(64)}`])).toEqual({
      command: "head-restore-mark",
      values: [
        { day: "2026-10-17", value: "a".repeat(64) },
        { day: "2026-10-18", value: "b".repeat(64) },
      ],
    });
    for (const bad of [["2026-10-17"], [`2026-13-01:${ZEROS}`], [`2026-10-17:${"A".repeat(64)}`], [`2026-10-17:${"a".repeat(63)}`], [`2026-10-17:${ZEROS}`, `2026-10-17:${"1".repeat(64)}`], ["--force"]]) {
      expect(() => parseFigureArgs("head-restore-mark", bad), bad.join(" ")).toThrow(/head-restore-mark/);
    }
  });

  test("after a restore: the keeper's values stored retired, every value that no longer fits retired and none deleted, today's restore row naming the last that fits, and its audit row last", async () => {
    const [state] = await migrateDb.execute<{ today: string; seq: number; hash: string }>(
      sql`select to_char((now() at time zone 'UTC')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today, seq::int as seq, hash from public.audit_head where id = 1`,
    );
    const { today, seq, hash } = state!;
    const back = (n: number) => new Date(Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00.000Z`) - n * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    // Six days ago, a value of the restored head's place and hash: it fits. Five days ago, the same place with a value its
    // hash does not give, and four days ago a place above the restored head: neither fits.
    const insert = (d: string, place: number, value: string) =>
      migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.head_publications (day, kind, chain_seq, value, witness, published_at) values (${d}::date, 'head', ${place}, ${value}, 'none', now())`);
    const wrongHash = `${"0".repeat(63)}1`;
    await insert(back(6), seq, headValue(back(6), seq, hash));
    await insert(back(5), seq, headValue(back(5), seq, wrongHash));
    await insert(back(4), seq + 3, headValue(back(4), seq + 3, ZEROS));
    const v3 = "3".repeat(64);
    const v2 = "2".repeat(64);
    const audits = async () => (await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log`))[0]!.n;
    const before = await audits();

    // A keeper's value for a day the database holds with another value: refused, and nothing changed.
    expect(await run(["head-restore-mark", `${back(6)}:${v3}`])).toEqual({
      code: 1,
      lines: [`err head-restore-mark: head_mismatch: the value of ${back(6)} differs from the one the database holds; nothing changed`],
    });
    // A day after today is no day a mail was sent for.
    const tomorrow = new Date(Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00.000Z`) + 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    expect((await run(["head-restore-mark", `${tomorrow}:${v3}`])).lines).toEqual([`err head-restore-mark: invalid_day: ${tomorrow} is after today; nothing changed`]);
    expect(await audits()).toBe(before);

    const done = await run(["head-restore-mark", `${back(3)}:${v3}`, `${back(2)}:${v2}`, `${back(6)}:${headValue(back(6), seq, hash)}`]);
    expect(done).toEqual({
      code: 0,
      lines: [
        "out head-restore-mark: 2 values of the keeper's mails stored, retired; 1 already held.",
        `out head-restore-mark: restore recorded for ${today}. The last published value that still verifies is of ${back(6)}. 4 later values are shown as retired.`,
      ],
    });
    const rows = await migrateDb.execute<{ day: string; kind: string; chain_seq: number | null; value: string; published: boolean; retired: boolean; last_day: string | null }>(sql`
      select to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, kind, chain_seq::int as chain_seq, value, published_at is not null as published, retired_at is not null as retired, to_char(last_day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_day
        from public.head_publications order by day desc, kind`);
    expect(rows.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
      { day: today, kind: "restore", chain_seq: seq, value: headValue(today, seq, hash), published: true, retired: false, last_day: back(6) },
      { day: back(2), kind: "head", chain_seq: null, value: v2, published: true, retired: true, last_day: null },
      { day: back(3), kind: "head", chain_seq: null, value: v3, published: true, retired: true, last_day: null },
      { day: back(4), kind: "head", chain_seq: seq + 3, value: headValue(back(4), seq + 3, ZEROS), published: true, retired: true, last_day: null },
      { day: back(5), kind: "head", chain_seq: seq, value: headValue(back(5), seq, wrongHash), published: true, retired: true, last_day: null },
      { day: back(6), kind: "head", chain_seq: seq, value: headValue(back(6), seq, hash), published: true, retired: false, last_day: null },
    ]);
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown>; step_up: unknown }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata, step_up from public.audit_log where chain_seq = (select seq from public.audit_head where id = 1)`,
    );
    expect({ ...audit }).toEqual({ action: "head_restore_marked", actor_id: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, target_type: null, target_id: null, metadata: { day: today, retired: 4 }, step_up: null });
    expect(await audits()).toBe(before + 1);

    // One restore a day: a second run is refused and changes nothing.
    expect(await run(["head-restore-mark"])).toEqual({ code: 1, lines: [`err head-restore-mark: restore_marked: a restore is recorded for ${today} already; nothing changed`] });
    expect(await audits()).toBe(before + 1);
  });

  test("with nothing stored that still fits, the restore row names no day, and the line says so", async () => {
    await cleanUp();
    const done = await figureCommand(migrateDb, { command: "head-restore-mark", values: [] });
    const [state] = await migrateDb.execute<{ today: string }>(sql`select to_char((now() at time zone 'UTC')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today`);
    expect(done).toEqual({ ok: true, lines: [`head-restore-mark: restore recorded for ${state!.today}. No published value still verifies. 0 later values are shown as retired.`] });
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ last_day: string | null }>(sql`select last_day::text from public.head_publications where kind = 'restore'`);
    expect(row!.last_day).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * 3d Task 1: fixtures of the quarantine's record (3d design, sections 6.1 and 12). quarantine_files is the migrator's
 * alone: the API's role holds no right on it, so every read, write and count here is made as the migrator.
 */

/** One file's row of the quarantine, as the migrator reads it, times as text. */
export interface QuarantineRow {
  media_id: string;
  file: string;
  post_id: string | null;
  size: number | null;
  sha256: string | null;
  moved_at: string;
  returned_at: string | null;
  destroyed_at: string | null;
  lost_at: string | null;
  lost_told: string | null;
  imported_at: string | null;
  unknown: boolean;
}

/** The rows of these images, by image and file. */
export async function quarantineRows(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<QuarantineRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<QuarantineRow & Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select media_id, file, post_id, size::int as size, sha256, moved_at::text, returned_at::text, destroyed_at::text, lost_at::text,
           lost_told::text, imported_at::text, unknown
      from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)}) order by media_id, file`);
  return found.map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

/** How many rows the table holds, as the migrator (the API role cannot count them). */
export async function quarantineCount(q: Db | DbTx): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.quarantine_files`);
  return row!.n;
}

/** The plan as the migrator reads it, for these images only, as "<direction> <image id>" strings, sorted. */
export async function planOf(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ direction: string; media_id: string }>(sql`select p.direction, p.media_id from public.quarantine_plan() p where p.media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  return found.map((row) => `${row.direction} ${row.media_id}`).sort();
}

/**
 * What ageCustodyForTest moves back: a decision (when a move in became due) with its ledger rows; an image's quarantine
 * rows; an alert kind's rows; (3d Task 6) a signal, by its id, or the request for a person about a decision, by the
 * decision's id; (3d Task 7) a held upload's refusal, by its id, with its match record and its image's hold.
 */
export type CustodyAgeTarget =
  | { decision: string }
  | { media: string }
  | { alerts: "quarantine_due" | "quarantine_lost" | "automated_waiting" | "automated_objection" | "automation_capped" | "matcher_down" | "hold_ended_unreported" }
  | { signal: string }
  | { objection: string }
  | { refusal: string };

/**
 * The fixture of 3d's section 12, `ageCustodyForTest(target, interval)` (Task 1; Tasks 2, 6 and 7 grow it): as the
 * migrator, moves the times of the rows a day's alert or a due move is judged by back by the interval. It is the only way
 * a test meets a day's alert: every time is forced when it is first written, and no setting shortens a number. For a
 * decision: its decided_at, and the created_at of its ledger rows and of every ledger row that reversed one of them (when
 * a return became due). For an image: every time its quarantine rows hold. For an alert kind: when each of its outbox
 * rows was created. 3d Task 6: for a signal, when it was written and when it was handled, so the sweep's window and its
 * minute are met; for a request for a person, when it was sent, so its target and the limit on waiting are met. 3d Task
 * 7: for a refusal, when it was refused, objected to and ended, when its match record was compared and handled, and the
 * image row's hold when it is a time (an end as no_report), so the delay of noReportHours, the hold on the address and
 * the matchKeepDays of the record are met. Run it inside a transaction that ends in a rollback, or undo it.
 */
export async function ageCustodyForTest(q: Db | DbTx, target: CustodyAgeTarget, interval: string): Promise<void> {
  if ("decision" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.decisions set decided_at = decided_at - ${interval}::interval where id = ${target.decision}::uuid`);
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.decision_actions set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval
       where decision_id = ${target.decision}::uuid
          or reverses_action_id in (select a.id from public.decision_actions a where a.decision_id = ${target.decision}::uuid)`);
  } else if ("media" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.quarantine_files
         set moved_at = moved_at - ${interval}::interval, returned_at = returned_at - ${interval}::interval,
             destroyed_at = destroyed_at - ${interval}::interval, lost_at = lost_at - ${interval}::interval
       where media_id = ${target.media}::uuid`);
  } else if ("signal" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval, handled_at = handled_at - ${interval}::interval where id = ${target.signal}::uuid`);
  } else if ("objection" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.automated_objections set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval where decision_id = ${target.objection}::uuid`);
  } else if ("refusal" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.upload_refusals
         set refused_at = refused_at - ${interval}::interval, objected_at = objected_at - ${interval}::interval, ended_at = ended_at - ${interval}::interval
       where id = ${target.refusal}::uuid`);
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.media_matches m set queried_at = m.queried_at - ${interval}::interval, handled_at = m.handled_at - ${interval}::interval
        from public.upload_refusals r where r.id = ${target.refusal}::uuid and m.id = r.match_id`);
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.post_media p set hold_until = p.hold_until - ${interval}::interval
        from public.upload_refusals r where r.id = ${target.refusal}::uuid and p.id = r.media_id and p.hold_until <> 'infinity'::timestamptz`);
  } else {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval where kind = ${target.alerts}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, the quarantine's rows of these images and, given the time the test began, the staff alerts
 * raised since then that name no message and no order: those its seals, lifted seals and records raised
 * (moderation_urgent, moderation_csam_lifted, quarantine_lost). Files of this kind run one at a time.
 */
export async function removeCustody(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[], alertsSince?: string): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  if (alertsSince !== undefined) {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where message_id is null and order_id is null and created_at >= ${alertsSince}::timestamptz`);
  }
}
```

```ts
  async function intakeRuns(db: Db | DbTx, sent: IntakeGround, live: LiveTarget[], afterCopy?: (postId: string) => Promise<void>): Promise<number> {
    const deps = moderationDeps(db);
```
