```ts
        const frozen: Frozen = { repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
        for (const when of ["as posted", "deleted by its author"]) {
          if (when === "deleted by its author") await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
          for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
            const answered = await run(frozen);
            expect(answered.filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id)), `${name}, ${when}`).toEqual([]);
            expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), `${name}, ${when}`).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
          }
        }
        // The account's upload on no post is reached by no case: the owner's purge took it.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [upload])).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("once nothing freezes the post any more, the same deleters take its rows", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId)).toEqual([]);
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(sorted(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId))).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
      });
    });

    test("a hold that is released on a frozen post's image frees nothing: the freeze keeps the row whether a hold stands or not", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report about the post itself places its case's hold and freezes the post.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update media_holds set released_at = now() where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        const [row] = await w.tx.execute<{ held: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until is not null as held from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(row).toEqual({ held: false });
        await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
        for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
          await run({ repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds });
          expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), name).toEqual(p.mediaIds);
        }
      }, migrateDb);
    });
  });

  describe("gate K through the flows: the author's deletion, the purge, the sweeper and the reconcile pass", () => {
    /** Each kind of reach through a real report of child sexual abuse material; it answers nothing, the post is frozen. */
    const REPORTS: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "its own item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(post.postId), "csam"),
      "its author's account's item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam"),
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId })), "csam"),
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(REPORTS))("a post frozen through %s: its rows outlive every flow that deletes, no file of them is requested, and no reader shows them once the post is deleted", async (kind) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const frozen = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await REPORTS[kind]!(w, { postId: frozen.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        // A case about the account reaches every post of the account, so there the other post's image is kept too.
        const kept = kind === "its author's account's item" ? [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds] : frozen.mediaIds;
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => kept.includes(id));

        // The author deletes the post, through the flow: the post is a tombstone, and its image rows stay.
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId);
        expect(await rejection(getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // No reader shows a kept image of a deleted post, to its owner either, so the freeze tells the author nothing.
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [ada.id, null]) expect((await ask(w, id, viewer)).kind, `serve ${String(viewer)}`).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.find(id)).toBeNull();
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(ada.id, id)).toBe(false);
        }
        expect((await w.repo.forPosts([frozen.postId])).size).toBe(0);
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(ada.id)).toEqual([...free.mediaIds, upload]);
        // The reconcile pass asks which ids have a row: the kept rows are seen, so their files are no orphans.
        expect(await w.repo.existing(frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(new Set(frozen.mediaIds));

        // The export names no image under the deleted post, holds no file of it, and lists none as missing.
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`, `media/${upload}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === frozen.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", media: [] });
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === free.postId)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(free.mediaIds);
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

        // The sweeper two days on, with its reconcile pass: every stored file is old by then, and none of the kept rows'
        // files is taken for an orphan.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The account is purged, by the request and then again by the job: the kept rows stay, unserved, and only the
        // files of the rows that went are requested.
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds, upload])).toEqual(sorted(kept));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: {
            forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)),
            exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")),
            takeDownDue: async () => ({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 }),
          },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // 3e: the strike it gives counts all the same (a strike never has a no_effect): what counts is the breach.
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([
          ["remove", "deleted"],
          ["strike", null],
        ]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never, social: socialForModeration(w.tx as unknown as Db) }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {
          expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
        }
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper's reconcile pass leaves the retained rows' files alone.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
      });
    });
  });

  describe("gates S and V: every reader, for a frozen post and for sealed images", () => {
    /** An author with an image post, a reply of their own with an image and a post Explore ranks, and a reader who follows them. */
    async function scene(w: World) {
      // Explore ranks as of a past this file has to itself, so no other suite's post is in the ranking read below.
      const asOf = new Date(Date.UTC(2019, 0, 10, 12));
      const [author, other, ...fans] = await accounts(w.tx as unknown as Db, asOf, 5);
      const top = await w.h.postWithImages(author!.id, 2);
      const strangerReply = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply by someone else", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const reply = await newPost(w.s.repo, author!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply with an image", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const replyImage = await w.h.readyImage(author!.id);
      await w.tx.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${reply}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'a reply image' where id = ${replyImage}::uuid`);
      const quoting = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "look at this", { quoteOfId: top.postId });
      const ranked = await newPostRow(w.tx, author!.id, { createdAt: sql`${earlier(asOf, 2 * HOUR).toISOString()}::timestamptz` });
      const rankedImage = await newImageRow(w.tx, author!.id, ranked, 0);
      await likedBy(w.s.repo, ranked, fans as { id: string }[], earlier(asOf, HOUR));
      // A round writes nothing while a ranking as new as its own time exists, and other suites leave theirs behind:
      // inside this transaction, which is rolled back, there is none.
      await w.tx.execute(sql`delete from explore_runs`);
      await rank(w.s.repo, asOf);
      for (const reader of [author!, other!]) {
        expect(await w.s.repo.like(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
        expect(await w.s.repo.bookmark(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(await w.s.repo.follow(other!.id, author!.id, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      return { author: author!, other: other!, top, strangerReply, reply, replyImage, quoting, ranked, rankedImage };
    }
    type Scene = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>;
    type Listed = (MediaView | HiddenMedia)[] | undefined;

    /**
     * Every list a post's images are read through, each as the viewer gets it: the images of the named post in that list.
     * `signedIn` marks the lists only an account has; Following is read by the one who follows the author.
     */
    function lists(w: World, f: Scene): { name: string; images: string[]; signedIn?: boolean; onlyFor?: string; read: (viewer: string | null) => Promise<Listed> }[] {
      const top = [...f.top.mediaIds];
      const inItems = (items: { post: PostView }[], id: string) => items.find((item) => item.post.id === id)?.post.media;
      const inPosts = (items: PostView[], id: string) => items.find((post) => post.id === id)?.media;
      return [
        { name: "the single post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId)).media },
        { name: "a thread's own post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).post.media },
        { name: "a thread's ancestor", images: top, read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.strangerReply, page)).ancestors as PostView[], f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a thread's reply", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).replies.items, f.reply) },
        { name: "the Latest timeline", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await latestTimeline(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the Following timeline", images: top, signedIn: true, onlyFor: f.other.id, read: async (v) => inItems((await followingTimeline(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "Explore", images: [f.rankedImage], read: async (v) => inItems((await explorePage(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.ranked) },
        { name: "the profile's posts", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await profilePosts(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the profile's replies", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await profileReplies(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.reply) },
        { name: "likes", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await likedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "bookmarks", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await bookmarkedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a quote embed", images: top, read: async (v) => { const quote = (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.quoting)).quoteOf; return quote && "media" in quote ? quote.media : undefined; } },
      ];
    }
    /** Runs every list for every viewer it has, and hands each answer to `check`. */
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { postMedia, posts, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { MediaFailure } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { MEDIA_FORMATS, storeLayout, type MediaFormat, type StoreLayout } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import type { MediaDeps } from "../../src/media/context";
import { matchAdapterFrom, type MatchAdapter } from "../../src/media/match-adapter";
import { createMatchRepo } from "../../src/media/match-repo";
import { createMediaFiles } from "../../src/media/files";
import { status } from "../../src/media/flows/status";
import { upload } from "../../src/media/flows/upload";
import { createMediaRepo } from "../../src/media/repo";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { enforceWriteLimit } from "../../src/social/limits";
import { createSocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";
import { DAY_MS, HOUR_MS } from "../../src/social/tiers";
import { decideForTest } from "./moderation-decide";
import { newPost, newProfile, ticker } from "./social-fixtures";

/** The first bytes of each kind of file. The API judges an upload by these and never decodes it. */
export const BYTES = {
  jpeg: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0]), Buffer.from("JFIF-test-image")]),
  png: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]), Buffer.from("png-test-image")]),
  pdf: Buffer.from("%PDF-1.7 not an image"),
  heic: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0, 0, 0, 24]), Buffer.from("ftypheic"), Buffer.from([0, 0, 0, 0]), Buffer.from("mif1heic")]),
  animatedWebp: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from("RIFF"), Buffer.from([40, 0, 0, 0]), Buffer.from("WEBPVP8X"), Buffer.from([10, 0, 0, 0, 0x02, 0, 0, 0])]),
};

/** A request body that arrives in chunks and declares no length. */
export function bodyOf(...chunks: Uint8Array[]): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
  return new ReadableStream({
    start(controller) {
      for (const chunk of chunks) controller.enqueue(chunk);
      controller.close();
    },
  });
}

/** Stands in for the worker: writes files and results into a store directory exactly as the protocol says, without decoding anything. */
export function fakeWorker(store: StoreLayout | string) {
  const layout = typeof store === "string" ? storeLayout(store) : store;
  for (const dir of [layout.files, layout.results, layout.attempts, layout.tmp]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return {
    /**
     * What the worker leaves behind for an image it accepted: 3d Task 6, a result of version 2, which the worker writes,
     * with the scorer's model and score when one is given (R1_CLASSIFIER not off).
     */
    ready(id: string, size: { width: number; height: number } = { width: 2048, height: 1536 }, r1?: { model: string; score: number }) {
      mkdirSync(layout.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(layout.image(id, "large"), `large-webp-of-${id}`);
      writeFileSync(layout.image(id, "small"), `small-webp-of-${id}`);
      writeFileSync(layout.result(id), JSON.stringify({ v: 2, id, status: "ready", ...size, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL", ...(r1 ? { r1 } : {}) }));
    },
    /** The same as version 1 wrote it, which the API still reads (a worker of the build before). */
    readyV1(id: string, size: { width: number; height: number } = { width: 2048, height: 1536 }) {
      mkdirSync(layout.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(layout.image(id, "large"), `large-webp-of-${id}`);
      writeFileSync(layout.image(id, "small"), `small-webp-of-${id}`);
      writeFileSync(layout.result(id), JSON.stringify({ v: 1, id, status: "ready", ...size, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" }));
    },
    /** What it leaves behind for one it refused. */
    failed(id: string, reason: MediaFailure) {
      writeFileSync(layout.result(id), JSON.stringify({ v: 2, id, status: "failed", reason }));
    },
    /** A heartbeat written at the given time. */
    beat(at: number) {
      writeFileSync(layout.heartbeat, JSON.stringify({ v: 1, at }));
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The media module on real Postgres, with both volumes in a temporary directory and a stand-in for
 * the worker that writes files and results exactly as the protocol says. Nothing here decodes an image.
 */
export async function mediaHarness(db: Db, options: { formats?: readonly MediaFormat[]; minFreeBytes?: number; storeDevice?: number; clockStart?: number; r1Model?: string | null; match?: MatchAdapter } = {}) {
  const clock = ticker(options.clockStart);
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-media-"));
  const files = createMediaFiles({ uploadsDir: path.join(root, "uploads"), storeDir: path.join(root, "store"), log: pino({ level: "silent" }), storeDevice: options.storeDevice });
  await files.prepare();

  const limits = new MemoryStore(() => clock.now().getTime());
  const deps: MediaDeps = {
    repo: createMediaRepo(db),
    files,
    formats: options.formats ?? MEDIA_FORMATS,
    minFreeBytes: options.minFreeBytes ?? 0,
    reconcileMode: "on",
    enforceUploadLimit: (userId, accountCreatedAt, now) => enforceWriteLimit(limits, userId, "upload", accountCreatedAt, now),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now: clock.next,
    // 3d Task 6: the scorer's model whose scores finalize keeps; none, as with R1_CLASSIFIER=off, unless a test sets one.
    r1Model: options.r1Model ?? null,
    // 3d Task 7: the comparison with known material, off unless a test gives an adapter (the test matcher, on a closed site).
    match: options.match ?? matchAdapterFrom({ MEDIA_MATCH: "off", APP_SITE: "open" }),
    matches: createMatchRepo(db),
    matched: { handler: null },
  };

  const worker = fakeWorker(files.store);

  /** An image of this account that the worker accepted and the API recorded: ready, on no post yet; scored when r1 is given. */
  async function readyImage(ownerId: string, size?: { width: number; height: number }, r1?: { model: string; score: number }): Promise<string> {
    const sent = await upload(deps, ownerId, { contentType: "image/jpeg", contentLength: undefined, body: bodyOf(BYTES.jpeg) });
    worker.ready(sent.id, size, r1);
    await status(deps, ownerId, sent.id);
    return sent.id;
  }

  /** A post by this account with ready images on it, written straight to the tables. */
  async function postWithImages(authorId: string, count = 1, body = "a post with images"): Promise<{ postId: string; mediaIds: string[] }> {
    const postId = await newPost(createSocialRepo(db), authorId, clock.next(), body);
    const mediaIds: string[] = [];
    for (let position = 0; position < count; position++) {
      const id = await readyImage(authorId);
      await db.update(postMedia).set({ postId, position, altText: `image ${position + 1}` }).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));
      mediaIds.push(id);
    }
    return { postId, mediaIds };
  }

  /**
   * Puts a post into a state. The author's deletion is written as the social module writes it. A moderation state comes
   * about only through a decision: the posts' guard refuses the API role any other write of it, so withheld, removed and
   * back to visible go through decideForTest, which needs the API's pool (a file that uses them closes its pools with
   * closeDecisions).
   */
  const setPostState = async (postId: string, state: "visible" | "withheld" | "removed" | "deleted_by_author"): Promise<void> => {
    if (state === "deleted_by_author") await db.update(posts).set({ state }).where(eq(posts.id, postId));
    else await decideForTest(db, postId, state);
  };

  return {
    deps,
    files,
    clock,
    worker,
    readyImage,
    postWithImages,
    setPostState,
    jpeg: () => ({ contentType: "image/jpeg", contentLength: undefined, body: bodyOf(BYTES.jpeg) }),
    /** An account old enough for the established tier. */
    established: () => newProfile(db, { createdAt: new Date(clock.now().getTime() - 3 * DAY_MS) }),
    /** An account in its first day. */
    fresh: () => newProfile(db, { createdAt: new Date(clock.now().getTime() - HOUR_MS) }),
    cleanup: () => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }),
    newId: randomUUID,
  };
}

export type MediaHarness = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof mediaHarness>>;
```

```ts
    let id = "";
    if (onboard) {
      expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
      id = (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from profiles where handle = ${handle}`))[0]!.id;
      w.profileIds.push(id);
    }
    return { b, email, handle, id, session: { userId: id, role: "user" as const, onboarded: true } };
  }

  /** A decision that committed, by its id. */
  const decided = async (staff: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: Parameters<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>[2]) => {
    const outcome = await d.decideAs(staff, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  /** A notice as its sender sent it, signed out unless a session is given, with its items and the case of its first one. */
  async function sent(request: NoticeRequest, session: Parameters<NoticesWorld["sender"]>[0] = null) {
    const answer = w.remember(await submitNotice(w.deps, request, w.sender(session)));
    await w.moderation.settle();
    const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
    return { ...answer, items, caseId: items[0]!.case_id! };
  }
  /** A report under a rule as a signed-in account sends it: no human check. */
  const report = (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => notices.rule(targets, { turnstileToken: undefined, ...extra });
  /** The daily release, by the database's one function for it: every item answered so far is shown its outcome. */
  const release = () => releaseOutcomes(w.apiDb, new Date());

  /** GET a JSON answer and hold the raw body strictly equal to its parsed form. */
  async function read<T>(b: Browser, path: string, schema: { parse(value: unknown): T }): Promise<T> {
    const res = await b.fetch(path);
    expect(res.status, `${path}: ${await res.clone().text()}`).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control"), path).toBe("no-store");
    const raw: unknown = await res.json();
    const parsed = schema.parse(raw);
    expect(raw, path).toStrictEqual(parsed);
    return parsed;
  }
  const casesOf = (b: Browser, cursor?: string) => read(b, `/api/moderation/cases${cursor ? `?cursor=${cursor}` : ""}`, AuthorCasesPage);
  const decisionOf = (b: Browser, id: string) => read(b, `/api/moderation/decisions/${id}`, DecisionView);
  const reportsOf = (b: Browser, cursor?: string) => read(b, `/api/moderation/reports${cursor ? `?cursor=${cursor}` : ""}`, ReportsPage);
  const postOf = (b: Browser, id: string) => read(b, `/api/posts/${id}`, PostView);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the routes

  test("the twelve signed-in routes (3e adds the reply, 3d Task 2 the notices and a release's notice, Task 6 the request for a person, Task 7 a refused upload's notice and its objection) are the module's whole surface under /api/moderation; each refuses a reader without a session and an account that has not chosen a handle", async () => {
    const routes = app.routes.filter((route) => route.path.startsWith("/api/moderation") && route.method !== "ALL").map((route) => `${route.method} ${route.path}`);
    expect([...new Set(routes)].sort()).toEqual([
      "GET /api/moderation/cases",
      "GET /api/moderation/decisions/:id",
      "GET /api/moderation/notices",
      "GET /api/moderation/releases/:release",
      "GET /api/moderation/reports",
      "GET /api/moderation/uploads/:refusal",
      "POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/appeal",
      "POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/objection",
      "POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/reply",
      "POST /api/moderation/items/:item/reexamine",
      "POST /api/moderation/report-mail/resume",
      "POST /api/moderation/uploads/:refusal/objection",
    ]);
    // The session is asked for before anything of the request is read: the appeal and the re-examination refuse the
    // same way with no body at all.
    const paths: [string, string | undefined][] = [
      ["/api/moderation/cases", undefined],
      [`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}`, undefined],
      ["/api/moderation/reports", undefined],
      ["/api/moderation/notices", undefined],
      [`/api/moderation/releases/${randomUUID()}`, undefined],
      ["/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}/appeal`, "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}/reply`, "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/decisions/${randomUUID()}/objection`, "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/items/${randomUUID()}/reexamine`, "POST"],
      [`/api/moderation/uploads/${randomUUID()}`, undefined],
      [`/api/moderation/uploads/${randomUUID()}/objection`, "POST"],
    ];
    const half = await signUp(false);
    for (const [path, method] of paths) {
      const signedOut = await new Browser(app, origin).fetch(path, { method });
      expect(signedOut.status, path).toBe(401);
      expect((await error(signedOut)).code, path).toBe("unauthenticated");
      const notOnboarded = await half.b.fetch(path, { method });
      expect(notOnboarded.status, path).toBe(403);
      expect((await error(notOnboarded)).code, path).toBe("onboarding_required");
    }
  });

  test("a decision's address must be an id, a cursor must be one the API wrote, and the resume is a POST with the session's CSRF token", async () => {
    const reader = await signUp();
    const notAnId = await reader.b.fetch("/api/moderation/decisions/not-an-id");
    expect(notAnId.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await error(notAnId)).code).toBe("invalid_request");
    for (const path of ["/api/moderation/cases?cursor=nonsense", "/api/moderation/reports?cursor=nonsense"]) {
      const res = await reader.b.fetch(path);
      expect(res.status, path).toBe(400);
      expect((await error(res)).code, path).toBe("invalid_request");
    }
    expect((await reader.b.fetch("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume")).status).toBe(404);
    const withoutCsrf = await reader.b.fetch("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST", csrf: false });
    expect(withoutCsrf.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await error(withoutCsrf)).code).toBe("csrf_failed");
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the author's list and one decision

  test("the author's list holds the decisions they were told of, newest first, and a decision opens only for its subject; none tells of who reported, what they wrote or how many", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const stranger = await signUp();
    const reporter = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "the reported words" });
    const explanation = `explained-${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    const first = await sent(report([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R3", explanation }), reporter.session);
    await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
    const interim = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    const final = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    // A second post of the author's, reported and found fine: its author is told nothing of that decision.
    const fine = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const other = await sent(report([postTarget(fine)]), reporter.session);
    const silent = await decided(moderator, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });

    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    const created = (await w.apiDb.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`))[0]!.at;
    expect(page.nextCursor).toBeNull();
    expect(page.decisions).toEqual([
      // 3e: the removal under R3 gives the post its strike, listed with the day it stops counting.
      { id: final, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", decidedOn: today(), post: { id: postId, createdAt: created }, actions: ["remove", "strike"], endedInterim: true, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, appealUntil: expect.any(String), appeal: null, reversedOn: null, strike: { countsUntil: expect.any(String), overruledAt: null }, byProgram: false },
      { id: interim, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", decidedOn: today(), post: { id: postId, createdAt: created }, actions: ["withhold"], endedInterim: false, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, appealUntil: null, appeal: null, reversedOn: null, strike: null, byProgram: false },
    ]);
    expect(page.decisions.map((row) => row.id)).not.toContain(silent);
    expect((await casesOf(stranger.b)).decisions).toEqual([]);
    expect((await casesOf(reporter.b)).decisions).toEqual([]);

    // The decision's view: the statement's data, where its appeal stands, and the content it was made on.
    const view = await decisionOf(author.b, final);
    const decidedAt = new Date(view.decidedAt);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ id: final, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R3", source: "report", post: { id: postId, createdAt: created }, reversedOn: null });
    expect(view.appealUntil).toBe(appealDeadline(decidedAt).toISOString());
    expect(page.decisions[0]!.appealUntil).toBe(view.appealUntil);
    // 3e: the removal gave a strike, with the day it stops counting and the strikes that counted then.
    expect(view.measures).toMatchObject([
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null, sealed: null },
      { kind: "strike", mediaId: null, sealed: null, endsAt: page.decisions[0]!.strike!.countsUntil, activeThen: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(view.endedMeasures).toEqual([{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null }]);
    expect(view.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "the reported words", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: null });
    // It renders as the mail did: the app calls the same function on the same data.
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(view);
    expect(paragraphs.join(" ")).toContain(getRule("R3")!.title);
    expect(w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision").at(-1)!.data.statement).toBe(paragraphs.join(String.fromCharCode(10)));
    const whileDeciding = await decisionOf(author.b, interim);
    expect(whileDeciding).toMatchObject({ kind: "interim", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null, content: { kind: "post", body: "the reported words" } });

    // Nobody else opens it, the reporter included, and a decision its author was not told of opens for nobody.
    for (const [who, id] of [[stranger.b, final], [reporter.b, final], [author.b, silent], [author.b, randomUUID()]] as const) {
      const res = await who.fetch(`/api/moderation/decisions/${id}`);
      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
      expect((await error(res)).code).toBe("not_found");
    }

    // The post's chip names the removal, to its author alone.
    expect((await postOf(author.b, postId)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: final, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: page.decisions[0]!.strike!.countsUntil });
    const whole = JSON.stringify([page, view, whileDeciding, await postOf(author.b, postId), w.mailer.to(author.email, "moderation_decision")]);
    for (const secret of [reporter.handle, reporter.id, explanation, first.ref]) expect(whole.includes(secret), secret).toBe(false);
    // And no member of the answers could carry a report, its sender or a count of them: the source is a category.
    const names = new Set<string>();
    const collect = (value: unknown): void => {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) value.forEach(collect);
      else if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") for (const [name, member] of Object.entries(value)) (names.add(name), collect(member));
    };
    collect([page, view, whileDeciding]);
    // 3e Task 5: `reportingStanding` is where the author's own restriction of reporting stands, never a report about them.
    expect([...names].filter((name) => /report|intake|notice|notifier|sender|count$|items?$/i.test(name))).toEqual(["imageCount", "reportingStanding"]);
    expect(view.source).toBe("report");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place in its author's views: each image is a placeholder that tells the author alone that it is sealed, the post has no chip, and the sealing decision's view shows the text beside the sealed images", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const reader = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "text beside the images" });
    const images = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 0), await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, postId, 1)];
    const notice = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
    const seal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });

    const own = await postOf(author.b, postId);
    expect(own).toMatchObject({ id: postId, body: "text beside the images", state: "visible" });
    expect(own.media).toEqual(images.map((id) => ({ id, hidden: true, sealed: true })));
    // The post itself is neither withheld nor removed: it has no chip, and the decision is under Settings, Cases.
    expect("moderation" in own).toBe(false);
    for (const other of [reader.b, new Browser(app, origin)]) expect((await postOf(other, postId)).media).toEqual(images.map((id) => ({ id, hidden: true })));

    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: seal, kind: "interim", actions: ["seal_media"], ruleId: "R2", legal: false, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null }]);
    const view = await decisionOf(author.b, seal);
    expect(view.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }]);
    expect(view.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" });
    // Nothing of a sealed image is in the answer: no id, no path and no description.
    for (const part of [...images, "image 1", "image 2", "/api/media/"]) expect(JSON.stringify(view).includes(part), part).toBe(false);

    // An admin answers without a seal: the seal ends, and the decision's view lists the images for the app's own image route.
    const answer = await decided(admin, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, seal)).content).toEqual({
      kind: "post",
      body: "text beside the images",
      deletedByAuthor: false,
      images: images.map((id, index) => ({ id, alt: `image ${index + 1}`, width: 1200, height: 800, small: mediaPath(id, "small"), large: mediaPath(id, "large") })),
      imageCount: 2,
      imagesHidden: null,
    });
    // The author was told that what korbat did while deciding has ended: that decision is listed, above the seal's.
    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(page.decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: answer, kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], endedInterim: true, ruleId: null, legal: false, appealUntil: null }, { id: seal }]);
    const ended = await decisionOf(author.b, answer);
    // A decision without a measure tells its author neither its facts nor its reason: they are the case's record.
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] });
  });

  test("a decision about a post its author deleted since shows korbat's copy of the text and none of its images; one whose copy was erased says on which day, and whether the post itself is still there", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const kept = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "kept by its author" });
    const gone = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "deleted by its author" });
    const goneImage = await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, gone, 0);
    const decisions: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const postId of [kept, gone]) {
      const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
      decisions[postId] = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    }
    // The author deletes the second post, as the app's delete does: the row stays as a tombstone, and its image is held for the case.
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
    const deleted = await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!);
    expect(deleted.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "deleted by its author", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" });
    expect(JSON.stringify(deleted).includes(goneImage)).toBe(false);
    expect(deleted.post).toMatchObject({ id: gone });

    // The retention job's erasure, done here as the migrator does it: the content columns and the salt null, the day stamped.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = null, media = null, display_name = null, bio = null, salt = null, erased_at = now()
                            where id in (select snapshot_id from decisions where id = any(${`{${Object.values(decisions).join(",")}}`}::uuid[]))`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: true });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
    // Once an R4 redaction erased the content, every decision about the post says so, whichever is viewed.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set redacted_at = now() where id = ${decisions[kept]!}::uuid`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "r4_redacted" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
  });

  test("a removal reversed in full says on which day, and leaves nothing to appeal; the correction is a decision of its own in the list", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(postId)], { email: w.address() }));
    const removal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, removal)).appealUntil).not.toBeNull();
    // 3e: a removal on the ground of the law gives no strike.
    expect((await postOf(author.b, postId)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: removal, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false, strikeUntil: null });
    const correction = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore")] });

    const page = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(page.decisions).toMatchObject([
      { id: correction, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, legal: false, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null },
      { id: removal, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", actions: ["remove"], ruleId: null, legal: true, appealUntil: null, reversedOn: today() },
    ]);
    expect(await decisionOf(author.b, removal)).toMatchObject({ source: "notice", ground: "illegal", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: today() });
    expect(await decisionOf(author.b, correction)).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewed: { kind: "final", ground: "illegal" }, reversals: [{ kind: "restore" }], appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null });
    // The post is visible again, and carries no chip.
    const post = await postOf(author.b, postId);
    expect(post.state).toBe("visible");
    expect("moderation" in post).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, which for a reset is the value the reset removed; it names no post", async () => {

  test("the author's list is read a page at a time, newest first, each decision once", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const made: string[] = [];
    // One decision more than a page holds, each the removal of a post of its own.
    for (let n = 0; n <= 20; n++) {
      const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id))]));
      made.push(await decided(admin, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] }));
    }
    const first = await casesOf(author.b);
    expect(first.decisions).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(first.nextCursor).toEqual(expect.any(String));
    const second = await casesOf(author.b, first.nextCursor!);
    expect(second.nextCursor).toBeNull();
    expect([...first.decisions, ...second.decisions].map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([...made].reverse());
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the chip

  test("the chip names the decision of the strongest post measure in force: an interim decision as such, a removal before a withhold, the newest removal first; and it is the author's alone", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const reader = await signUp();
    // Withheld while korbat decides, under R4.
    const held = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const first = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(held)], { ruleId: "R4" }));
    const withhold = await decided(moderator, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await postOf(author.b, held)).toMatchObject({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: withhold, ruleId: "R4", legal: false, interim: true } });
    // Nobody else is shown a withheld post at all.
    expect((await reader.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${held}`)).status).toBe(404);

    // Removed twice, by the decisions of two cases: the newer removal is named.
    const twice = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const one = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(twice)]));
    await decided(moderator, one.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const two = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(twice)], { ruleId: "R3" }));
    const newer = await decided(moderator, two.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    // 3e: the post got its one strike from the R1 removal; the newer removal gives none, so its chip names no strike.
    expect((await postOf(author.b, twice)).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: newer, ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null });
    // A withhold while a third case is decided does not take the chip from the removal.
    const three = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(twice)], { ruleId: "R6" }));
    await decided(moderator, three.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await postOf(author.b, twice)).toMatchObject({ state: "removed", moderation: { decisionId: newer, ruleId: "R3", interim: false } });

    // The author's own lists carry the chip too; a visible post carries none.
    const fine = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const list = await read(author.b, `/api/profiles/${author.handle}/posts?limit=50`, TimelinePage);
    const listed = new Map(list.items.map((item) => [item.post.id, item.post]));
    expect(listed.get(held)?.moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: withhold, ruleId: "R4", legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null });
    expect(listed.get(twice)?.moderation).toMatchObject({ decisionId: newer });
    expect("moderation" in listed.get(fine)!).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3f: every read on the author's side takes the decisions its author was told of by one fragment, both halves; a decision held untold leaves the list, its view and the chip until it is told", async () => {
    // Both halves: a 3c decision whose author is told nothing (the silent one above) has informed_at set, and an order's
    // held notice (Task 3) has informed_at null.
    expect(new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(toldToAuthor("d")).sql).toBe("(d.author_mail <> 'none' and d.informed_at is not null)");
    const author = await signUp();
    const post = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(post)]));
    const removal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await casesOf(author.b)).decisions.map((d) => d.id)).toContain(removal);
    expect((await postOf(author.b, post)).moderation).toMatchObject({ decisionId: removal });
    const [kept] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ informed_at: string; author_mail: string; author_mail_at: string | null }>(

        { ref: first.ref, receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/), items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, scope: null, ...reported }, { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, scope: "account", ...reported }] },

    for (let n = 0; n <= REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE; n++) {

      if (n % 9 === 0) w.ahead.limitsMs += HOUR;
      const target = n === 0 ? accountTarget(`gone_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`) : { kind: "link" as const, url: `${origin}/post/${randomUUID()}` };

    expect((await reportsOf(reporter.b)).reportMailStopped).toBe(false);
    expect(await w.authForModeration.accountReportMailStopped(reporter.id)).toBe(false);
    expect((await resume(reporter.b)).status).toBe(204);
```

```ts
    test("each source is a summary: reporters get letters in the order of their first items in the case; a notifier is what was given, or that the contact is lost; the path for child sexual abuse material is anonymous; a finding was found by a moderator; a reporter whose link is gone is only that", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps, contacts } = world(tx);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const [first, second] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const [known, lost] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
        contacts.set(known, { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: true });
        await intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, ground.illegal(second.id), aPost(p.postId));
        // The first reporter again, on the other ground: the same letter.
        await intake(tx, ground.illegal(first.id), aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: known }, aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: lost }, aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, ground.illegal(null), aPost(p.postId));
        await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(p.postId));
        const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.finding(other.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        // The second reporter's link is forgotten, as after their account's deletion: only the migrator's functions do that.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set reporter_account_id = null where reporter_account_id = ${second.id}::uuid`);

        const view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), caseId);
        const none = { accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null };
        const noContact = { named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };
        expect(view.items.map((item) => item.source)).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", itemsFiled: "2_to_9" }),
          { kind: "unlinked", label: "A signed-in reporter no longer linked", ...none, ...noContact },
          expect.objectContaining({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", itemsFiled: "2_to_9" }),
          { kind: "notifier", label: "A notifier", ...none, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: true, contactLost: false },
          { kind: "notifier", label: "A notifier", ...none, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false, contactLost: true },
          { kind: "notifier", label: "A notifier", ...none, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false, contactLost: false },
          { kind: "anonymous", label: "Anonymous", ...none, ...noContact },
          { kind: "staff", label: "Found by a moderator", ...none, ...noContact },
        ]);
        // No contact's id leaves the server: the summary is all the console gets.
        expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain(known);
        expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain(lost);

        // On another case the same person is lettered by that case's own order.
        const q = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const third = await profile(tx);
        await intake(tx, ground.rule(third.id, "R1"), aPost(q.postId));
        const again = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id, "R1"), aPost(q.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        expect((await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), again)).items.map((item) => item.source.label)).toEqual(["Reporter A", "Reporter B"]);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a reporter's bands are computed over the reporter's own released items: an item answered without action while nobody could open the images is counted apart, never as decided without action", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps } = world(tx);
        const release = () => tx.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now() - interval '1 hour')`);
        const decidedAgo = (decisionId: string) => tx.execute(sql`update decisions set decided_at = now() - interval '5 hours' where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
        // Whatever other suites left releasable goes first.
        await release();
        const reporter = await profile(tx);

        // A post frozen through its author's account's case: a moderator's no-action answer to the rule report is unseen.
        const frozen = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const unseenCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(frozen.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await report(tx, anAccount(frozen.authorId), "csam");
        await decidedAgo(await decideIn(tx, mod, unseenCase, NO_SEAL));
        await release();
        let view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), unseenCase);
        expect(view.decisions).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true, suspect: false })]);
        expect(view.items[0]!.source).toMatchObject({ itemsFiled: "1", actedOn: "none_decided", answeredUnseen: "1" });

        // A second report, acted on, and a third without action with the images in sight: one of two decided items acted on.
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const removedCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(removed.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decidedAgo(await decideIn(tx, mod, removedCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
        const cleared = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const clearedCase = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(cleared.postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decidedAgo(await decideIn(tx, mod, clearedCase, NO_SEAL));
        await release();
        view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), clearedCase);
        expect(view.items[0]!.source).toMatchObject({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", itemsFiled: "2_to_9", actedOn: "half_or_more", answeredUnseen: "1" });
        expect(view.items[0]).toMatchObject({ outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: view.decisions[0]!.id });
        // An account made thirteen months ago is in the oldest band.
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set created_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${reporter.id}::uuid`);
        expect((await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), clearedCase)).items[0]!.source.accountAge).toBe("over_12_months");
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a report of child sexual abuse material: suspicion with what the case reaches, no image allowed, the quoted post's case linked from the quoting post's item and the added item marked; a seal lists what it covers; an answer without a seal is counted as an earlier answer", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps } = world(tx);
        const quoted = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const quoting = await imagePost(tx, 1, undefined, { quoteOfId: quoted.postId });
        const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(quoting.postId));
        const [named, added] = [recorded.items.find((item) => item.position === 1)!, recorded.items.find((item) => item.position === 11)!];

        const quotingView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), named.caseId!);
        expect(quotingView).toMatchObject({ lane: 0, imagesAllowed: false });
        expect(quotingView.suspicion).toEqual({
          open: true,
          reach: { posts: 1, images: 1, sealed: 0, served: 1, newestPostOn: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/) },
          earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } },
        });
        expect(quotingView.items[0]).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, csam: true, quotedByPosition: null, quotedCaseId: added.caseId, source: { kind: "anonymous" } });
        const quotedView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), added.caseId!);
        expect(quotedView.items[0]).toMatchObject({ suspect: true, position: 11, quotedByPosition: 1, quotedCaseId: null });
        expect(quotedView.suspicion?.reach).toMatchObject({ posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2 });

        // Whoever is on duty seals the quoted post's images while deciding: the answer lists what the seal covers.
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, mod, added.caseId!, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
        const sealedView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), added.caseId!);
        expect(sealedView.suspicion).toMatchObject({ open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 2, served: 0 } });
        // Text is never sealed: the post keeps its state and level, and its snapshot is shown.
        expect(sealedView).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: false, target: { state: "visible", level: "visible" } });
        expect(sealedView.snapshots[0]).toMatchObject({ withheld: false, body: "a post" });
        expect(sealedView.decisions).toEqual([
          expect.objectContaining({ id: seal, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R2", category: MINORS, suspect: true, unseen: false, needsAdmin: false, staffHandle: await handleOf(tx, mod.id) }),
        ]);
        expect(sealedView.decisions[0]!.actions).toEqual([
          { id: expect.any(String), kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, ...NO_STANDING, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [{ postId: quoted.postId, createdAt: expect.any(String), images: 2 }] } },
        ]);
        expect(sealedView.decisions[0]!.facts).toEqual(expect.stringContaining("facts"));

        // An admin answers without a seal: the seal has ended, the case is closed, and its images may be opened again.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, added.caseId!, NO_SEAL);
        const answered = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), added.caseId!);
        expect(answered).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: true, suspicion: { open: false, reach: { sealed: 0, served: 2 } } });
        expect(answered.closedAt).not.toBeNull();
        // The seal taken while deciding ended by itself with that answer: no reversal lifted it. (Both decisions carry the
        // one time of this test's transaction, so the seal's is found by its id.)
        expect(answered.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === seal)!.actions[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "seal_media", inForce: false, liftedBy: null });
        // The answer counts as an earlier one, about the target and about its author, on the case itself and on the next
        // report of this kind; an answer with a seal about another post of the author does not.
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        expect(answered.suspicion?.earlier).toEqual({ target: { count: 1, lastOn: today, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: today } });
        const sealedForGood = await imagePost(tx, 1, quoted.authorId);
        const goodCase = (await report(tx, aPost(sealedForGood.postId), "csam")).caseId;
        await decideIn(tx, admin, goodCase, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const next = (await report(tx, aPost(quoted.postId), "csam")).caseId;
        const nextView = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), next);
        expect(nextView.suspicion).toMatchObject({ open: true, earlier: { target: { count: 1, lastOn: today }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: today } } });
        // The sealed post's own closed case: the seal for good stands, so its images stay out of staff's sight.
        expect(await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), goodCase)).toMatchObject({ imagesAllowed: false, suspicion: { open: false, earlier: { target: { count: 0 }, author: { count: 1 } } } });
      });
    });

    test("an earlier answer without a seal is counted for twelve months and no longer: one decided eleven months ago is, one moved past twelve is not, about the target and about its author alike", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const { deps } = world(tx);
        expect(SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS).toBe(12);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const answer = await decideIn(tx, admin, (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam")).caseId, NO_SEAL);
        // Another post of the same author, answered the same way: it counts for the author, never for this target.
        const sibling = await imagePost(tx, 1, p.authorId);
        const siblingAnswer = await decideIn(tx, admin, (await report(tx, aPost(sibling.postId), "csam")).caseId, NO_SEAL);
        const next = (await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam")).caseId;
        const earlier = async () => (await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), next)).suspicion!.earlier;
        // Only the migrator moves a decision's time.
        const decidedAgo = (id: string, ago: string) => tx.execute(sql`update decisions set decided_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where id = ${id}::uuid`);
        const dayOf = async (id: string) => (await tx.execute<{ day: string }>(sql`select to_char(decided_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day from decisions where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!.day;

        await decidedAgo(answer, "11 months");
        expect(await earlier()).toEqual({ target: { count: 1, lastOn: await dayOf(answer), imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 2, lastOn: await dayOf(siblingAnswer) } });
        await decidedAgo(answer, "12 months 1 day");
        expect(await earlier()).toEqual({ target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: await dayOf(siblingAnswer) } });
        await decidedAgo(siblingAnswer, "13 months");
        expect(await earlier()).toEqual({ target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } });
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("an account's case reaches every image on the account's posts, as it stands at each read, and never shows an image; a seal's list in the answer stops at SEAL_LIST_MAX posts", async () => {

        expect(view.suspicion).toMatchObject({ open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2 }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, imagesOpenedOn: null } } });
        // The account posts again: the case reaches the new image too.

        await tx.execute(sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) select ${author.id}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL' from generate_series(1, ${more}::int)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`
          update post_media m set post_id = pairs.post_id, position = 0, alt_text = 'one of many'
            from (select i.id as media_id, p.id as post_id
                    from (select id, row_number() over (order by id) as n from post_media where owner_id = ${author.id}::uuid and post_id is null) i
                    join (select id, row_number() over (order by id) as n from posts where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid and body like 'post %') p on p.n = i.n) pairs
           where m.id = pairs.media_id`);
        await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);

        expect(sealed.list).toHaveLength(SEAL_LIST_MAX);
        // Oldest post first.
        expect(sealed.list.map((row) => row.createdAt)).toEqual([...sealed.list.map((row) => row.createdAt)].sort());
        expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success).toBe(true);
      });
    });
```
