```ts
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toContain("No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ automatedDetection: false, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: null }))).toEqual(statementParagraphs(statement()));
  });

  // 3d Task 7 (W.3): a match's words. The source's name is printed as the match record holds it.
  const MATCH = { kind: "known_match", source: "Example Hotline", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam", viewed: null } as const;
  const R2 = getRule("R2", 3)!;
  const EXACT = "an automated comparison found that an image of your post has the same fingerprint as one that Example Hotline has classified as child sexual abuse material";
  const NEAR =
    "an automated comparison found that an image of your post has a fingerprint of how the picture looks that Example Hotline reports as matching one it has classified as child sexual abuse material";
  const OTHER = "an automated comparison of fingerprints with a list kept by Example Hotline flagged an image of your post for korbat's staff";
  /** A program's seal of a post's images on an acting match, under R2, as Task 6's step records it. */
  const sealed = (more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) => program({ ruleId: "R2", measures: [measure("seal_media")], signal: MATCH, ...more });

  test("Task 7: the comparison, word for word, by what the source lists the entry as and the kind of match; 'the same fingerprint' only for an exact one", () => {
    expect(W.automated.comparison("csam", "exact", "Example Hotline")).toBe(EXACT);
    expect(W.automated.comparison("csam", "near", "Example Hotline")).toBe(NEAR);
    expect(W.automated.comparison("other", "exact", "Example Hotline")).toBe(OTHER);
    expect(W.automated.comparison("other", "near", "Example Hotline")).toBe(OTHER);
    expect(W.automated.notAssessed("csam", "exact")).toBe(
      "korbat's staff do not open an image that is found this way, before a decision or after it, and korbat has not assessed it. The comparison shows that two files have the same fingerprint; it does not show what your image is.",
    );
    expect(W.automated.notAssessed("csam", "near")).toBe(
      "korbat's staff do not open an image that is found this way, before a decision or after it, and korbat has not assessed it. The comparison is of fingerprints of how a picture looks, which two different images can share, by accident or on purpose; it does not show what your image is.",
    );
    expect(W.automated.notAssessed("other", "exact")).toBe(
      "korbat's staff do not open an image that is found this way, before a decision or after it, and korbat has not assessed it. A flag is not a finding: it shows that a fingerprint is on a list or close to one that is, not what your image is.",
    );
    expect(W.update.automated.partly).toBe("This decision rests in part on an automated comparison of fingerprints; an admin took it without opening the images.");
  });

  test("Task 7: a program's seal on a match, paragraph by paragraph: the seal, its scope, until an admin answers, the source, the comparison, not assessed, the rule and Ask for a person worded for an admin", () => {
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(sealed());
    expect(paragraphs.slice(1)).toEqual([
      W.scope.interim,
      "This lasts until an admin has answered. The admin either seals the images for good, in which case korbat keeps them only for the authorities it reports this to, or answers without a seal, in which case they are shown again. A program does nothing else: it removes nothing, and it does not suspend, limit or end your account. While images are sealed korbat keeps what a report to the authorities would need, as its terms say for every seal (Terms, Your data).",
      "What this decision is about was found by an automated check of korbat's own.",
      `Automated means were used to find this and to take this measure: ${EXACT}, and korbat sealed the post's images at once. No person took part in this measure, and no admin has decided yet.`,
      W.automated.notAssessed("csam", "exact"),
      `The rule this was done under: korbat rule R2, "${R2.title}": ${R2.text}`,
      REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askAdmin,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toContain("sealed");
    const words = text(sealed());
    expect(words).not.toMatch(/It breaks|korbat's reasons|The facts|looked at the image|confirmed|posted such|is child sexual abuse material/);
    expect(words).not.toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[4].askPerson);
    // A near match's seal (a perceptual hash the source called exact acts the same way) never says "the same fingerprint".
    expect(text(sealed({ signal: { ...MATCH, matchKind: "near" } }))).not.toContain("same fingerprint");
    expect(text(sealed({ signal: { ...MATCH, matchKind: "near" } }))).toContain(NEAR);
  });

  test("Task 7: a person's decision on a match says a program found it and a person decided without opening the image; a partly automated one says it rests on the comparison in part", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(person(false, { signal: MATCH }))).toContain(
      `Automated means were used to find this: ${EXACT}. They were not used to decide it: a person at korbat took this decision, without opening the image that the comparison named. ${W.automated.notAssessed("csam", "exact")}`,
    );
    expect(statementParagraphs(person(false, { signal: MATCH, automatedDecision: "partially" }))).toContain(
      `Automated means were used to find this, and this decision rests on them in part: ${EXACT}. An admin took the decision without opening the images, on that comparison and on what korbat can read. ${W.automated.notAssessed("csam", "exact")}`,
    );
    // A flag of another class: the list flagged it, and a flag is not a finding.
    const flag = text(person(false, { signal: { ...MATCH, listedAs: "other", matchKind: "near" } }));
    expect(flag).toContain(OTHER);
    expect(flag).toContain("A flag is not a finding");
    expect(flag).not.toMatch(/child sexual abuse material|same fingerprint|looked at the image/);
    // The record of a match that the retention job erased reads as a flag of an unnamed source, never as a finding.
    expect(text(person(false, { signal: { ...MATCH, source: null, listedAs: null, matchKind: null } }))).toContain("flagged an image of your post");
    // A partly automated decision without a match's signal is not worded: it would say more than the record holds.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(person(false, { automatedDecision: "partially" }))).toThrow(/names no signal/);
  });

  test("a program's statement needs a redress version that holds Ask for a person", () => {
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(program({ redressVersion: 3 }))).toThrow(/Ask for a person/);
  });
});

describe("3d Task 7: UPLOAD_NOTICE, the refused upload's notice (design, sections 7.12 and 9.5; W.5)", () => {
  const R2 = getRule("R2", 3)!;
  /** An upload refused on an exact match, held, with the objection open: the notice's first state. */
  const view = (more: Partial<Parameters<typeof uploadNoticeParagraphs>[0]> = {}): Parameters<typeof uploadNoticeParagraphs>[0] => ({
    id: "5d0c1b2a-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d",
    refusedAt: "2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z",
    source: "Example Hotline",
    matchKind: "exact",
    listedAs: "csam",
    objection: null,
    mayObject: true,
    endedAt: null,
    endAs: null,
    endReason: null,
    released: null,
    reportKept: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const render = (more: Partial<Parameters<typeof uploadNoticeParagraphs>[0]> = {}) => uploadNoticeParagraphs(view(more), R2.title, REDRESS_TEXTS[4]);
  const HEAD = [
    "korbat did not accept an image you uploaded on 2026-10-01 12:00 UTC. It is on no post, and nobody can see it, you included.",
    "This was done by automated means, and no person took part: an automated comparison found that the file you uploaded has the same fingerprint as one that Example Hotline has classified as child sexual abuse material.",
    "korbat's staff do not open an upload that is found this way, before a decision or after it, and korbat has not assessed it. The comparison shows that two files have the same fingerprint; it does not show what your image is.",
    `The rule this was done under: korbat rule R2, "${R2.title}". What korbat compares, and with whom, is stated under Automation on the rules page.`,
  ];

  test("a held refusal: the four paragraphs every notice opens with, the hold with korbat's number of days, and the offer to object", () => {
    expect(render()).toEqual([...HEAD, UPLOAD_NOTICE.held, REDRESS_TEXTS[4].uploadObject]);
    expect(UPLOAD_NOTICE.held).toContain(`for up to ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days from the refusal`);
    expect(UPLOAD_NOTICE.held).toContain("No timer ends the hold.");
    // A near match the source called exact acts too, and is never "the same fingerprint".
    expect(render({ matchKind: "near" }).join(" ")).not.toContain("same fingerprint");
  });

  test("an objection replaces the offer; the hold's end without a report says what follows, by its reason; a report says korbat keeps the file for the authorities", () => {
    const objected = render({ mayObject: false, objection: { text: "x", objectedAt: "2026-10-02T08:15:00.000Z" } });
    expect(objected).toEqual([...HEAD, UPLOAD_NOTICE.held, "You objected on 2026-10-02 08:15 UTC. An admin reads what you wrote and decides."]);
    expect(objected.join(" ")).not.toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[4].uploadObject!);
    const withdrew = render({ mayObject: false, endAs: "no_report", endReason: "source_withdrew", endedAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z" });
    expect(withdrew).toEqual([
      ...HEAD,
      `An admin ended the hold on 2026-10-03 10:00 UTC without a report, and korbat deletes the file. ${AUTOMATION_RULES.matchKeepDays} days after the hold ended korbat erases the fingerprint and the link between this record and your account; what it keeps after that is that an upload was refused on that day, with nothing that leads to you (Terms, Your data). Example Hotline withdrew or corrected its entry: you can upload the image again.`,
    ]);
    for (const reason of ["counsel_no_duty", "other"] as const) {
      const words = render({ mayObject: false, endAs: "no_report", endReason: reason, endedAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z" }).join(" ");
      expect(words).toContain(
        "The image is still not accepted while Example Hotline's list holds a matching entry. If you think the entry is wrong, Example Hotline is the body that can correct it: korbat cannot, since nobody at korbat opens the image.",
      );
      expect(words).not.toContain("you can upload the image again");
    }
    const report = render({ endAs: "report", endReason: null, endedAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z" });
    expect(report).toEqual([...HEAD, REDRESS_TEXTS[4].uploadObject, "On 2026-10-03 10:00 UTC an admin decided, without opening the file, that korbat reports it to the authorities. korbat keeps the file for them alone."]);
    expect(render({ endAs: "report", endedAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z", reportKept: true }).at(-1)).toBe(
      "On 2026-10-03 10:00 UTC an admin decided, without opening the file, that korbat reports it to the authorities. korbat keeps the file for them alone. The record of that report names your account and keeps its email address for as long as korbat keeps its records to authorities (Terms, Your data).",
    );
  });

  test("a released refusal says korbat destroys the file and not a word of what an authority found; no paragraph says what the image is or that anyone confirmed it", () => {
    const released = render({ mayObject: false, endAs: "report", endedAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z", released: "2026-11-03T10:00:00.000Z" });
    expect(released.at(-1)).toBe("korbat released the file on 2026-11-03 10:00 UTC, on the leave or instruction of an authority or a court: it will not give it back, and it destroys it.");
    for (const words of [render(), released].map((paragraphs) => paragraphs.join(" "))) {
      expect(words).not.toMatch(/is child sexual abuse material|confirmed|posted|nobody has seen|found that the image is/);
    }
  });

  test("a notice that offers the objection needs redress version 4's text", () => {
    // Redress texts before version 4 hold no uploadObject.
    expect("uploadObject" in REDRESS_TEXTS[3]).toBe(false);
    expect(() => uploadNoticeParagraphs(view(), R2.title, {})).toThrow(/uploadObject/);
    expect(uploadNoticeParagraphs(view({ mayObject: false }), R2.title, {})).toEqual([...HEAD, UPLOAD_NOTICE.held]);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/admin/src/screens/Uploads.tsx`

```tsx
import { RETENTION, UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS, UPLOAD_END_REASONS, type HeldUpload, type StaffRole, type UploadEnd, type UploadEndReason, type UploadHoldEndedParams, type UploadReleasedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { Frame } from "../frames";
import { CUSTODY_WORDS, describeError, RELEASE_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { endHoldWithKey, releaseUploadWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { MatchRecordView } from "./Case";

/**
 * 3d Task 7, Held uploads (design, sections 7.12, 8.6 and 10.3): the refusals whose hold has not ended, then those ended as
 * "Report" and not released, then those released or ended as "No report" in the last 30 days. The screen shows no image,
 * requests none and links none: a refusal is its time, its match's record, a count of the same uploader's other held
 * uploads, whether the account still exists, the objection framed, and its state. An admin ends a hold with the step-up
 * upload_hold_ended: the two ends stand side by side, worded as what each does, and neither is chosen when the page
 * loads (rule 4 of section 8); a hold ended as "Report" can be released on a recorded leave (upload_released).
 */

const W = CUSTODY_WORDS.uploads;

/**
 * The ends an admin can still choose for a refusal, as upload_hold_end allows them: both while the hold is open; "No
 * report" after "Report" until a release; "Report" after "No report" until the upload is deleted; none once released.
 */
export function endsOffered(upload: HeldUpload, now: number = Date.now()): UploadEnd[] {
  if (upload.release?.releasedAt != null) return [];
  if (upload.endAs === null) return ["report", "no_report"];
  if (upload.endAs === "report") return ["no_report"];
  return upload.deletesAt !== null && Date.parse(upload.deletesAt) > now ? ["report"] : [];
}

/** The params the key signs for an end: null until an end, and for "No report" its reason, is chosen. */
export function holdEndParams(endAs: UploadEnd | null, reason: UploadEndReason | null): UploadHoldEndedParams | null {
  if (endAs === null) return null;
  if (endAs === "report") return { endAs, reason: null };
  return reason === null ? null : { endAs, reason };
}

/** The params the key signs for the release of a held upload: only on a recorded leave, with its reference. */
export function uploadReleaseParams(upload: HeldUpload): UploadReleasedParams | null {
  const release = upload.release;
  if (release === null || release.releasedAt !== null || release.leave === null) return null;
  return { basis: "leave", leaveId: release.leave.id, theirReference: release.leave.reference };
}

/** A refusal's state line (8.6). */
export function stateLine(upload: HeldUpload): string {
  if (upload.release?.releasedAt != null) return W.state.released(bothTimes(upload.release.releasedAt));
  if (upload.endAs === "report" && upload.endedAt !== null) return W.state.report(bothTimes(upload.endedAt), upload.reported, upload.quarantined);
  if (upload.endAs === "no_report" && upload.endedAt !== null) {
    return W.state.noReport(bothTimes(upload.endedAt), upload.endReason === null ? "" : UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS[upload.endReason], upload.deletesAt === null ? "" : bothTimes(upload.deletesAt));
  }
  return W.state.open;
}

/** What the page does for one refusal: whose role, which refusal is on its way, and each refusal's refusal. */
export interface UploadsActions {
  role: StaffRole;
  busy: string | null;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
  onEnd(upload: HeldUpload, params: UploadHoldEndedParams): void;
  onRelease(upload: HeldUpload, params: UploadReleasedParams): void;
}

/**
 * The two ends, side by side as radio buttons of the same weight, neither checked nor focused when the block is drawn,
 * each with what it does; the reasons of "No report" once that end is chosen; then the key. Greyed for a moderator.
 */
function EndControl({ upload, actions }: { upload: HeldUpload; actions: UploadsActions }) {
  const [endAs, setEndAs] = useState<UploadEnd | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<UploadEndReason | null>(null);
  const offered = endsOffered(upload);
  if (offered.length === 0) return null;
  const admin = actions.role === "admin";
  const params = holdEndParams(endAs, reason);
  const busy = actions.busy === upload.id;
  const name = `end-${upload.id}`;
  return (
    <div className={`actions${admin ? "" : " greyed"}`}>
      <p className="hint">{W.unseen}</p>
      <fieldset disabled={!admin || busy}>
        <legend>{W.choose}</legend>
        {offered.map((end) => (
          <label key={end}>
            <input type="radio" name={name} value={end} checked={endAs === end} onChange={() => setEndAs(end)} />
            <strong>{end === "report" ? W.report.label : W.noReport.label}</strong>
            {`: ${end === "report" ? W.report.what : W.noReport.what}`}
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      {endAs === "no_report" ? (
        <fieldset disabled={!admin || busy}>
          <legend>{W.noReport.reason}</legend>
          {UPLOAD_END_REASONS.map((value) => (
            <label key={value}>
              <input type="radio" name={`${name}-reason`} value={value} checked={reason === value} onChange={() => setReason(value)} />
              {UPLOAD_END_REASON_LABELS[value]}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
      {endAs === "no_report" && reason === null ? <p className="hint">{W.chooseReason}</p> : null}
      <p className="hint">{W.sign}</p>
      {admin ? null : <p className="hint">{W.adminOnly}</p>}
      {actions.errors[upload.id] ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {actions.errors[upload.id]}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <button type="button" disabled={!admin || params === null || busy} aria-busy={busy} onClick={() => params !== null && actions.onEnd(upload, params)}>
        {W.confirm}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 8.5's block for a held upload ended as "Report" (8.6): the facts read from the record upload-report opened and the
 * leave recorded for the refusal, the words, and "Release and destroy" while a leave is recorded, for an admin alone.
 * An authority's reference and a leave's are framed. No image is requested or drawn here.
 */
function UploadReleaseBlock({ upload, actions }: { upload: HeldUpload; actions: UploadsActions }) {
  const facts = upload.release;
  if (facts === null) return null;
  const R = RELEASE_WORDS;
  const F = R.facts;
  const admin = actions.role === "admin";
  const params = uploadReleaseParams(upload);
  const busy = actions.busy === upload.id;
  const day = (at: string | null, none: string) => (at === null ? none : bothTimes(at));
  return (
    <section className={`block release${admin ? "" : " greyed"}`} aria-labelledby={`release-${upload.id}`}>
      <h4 id={`release-${upload.id}`}>{R.title}</h4>
      <dl>
        <dt>{F.reported.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.reported ? F.reported.yes : F.reported.no}</dd>
        <dt>{F.theirReference.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.theirReference === null ? F.theirReference.none : <Frame by={F.theirReference.frame} text={facts.theirReference} />}</dd>
        <dt>{F.answer.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.answer === null ? F.answer.none : F.answer.values[facts.answer]}</dd>
        <dt>{F.answeredAt.label}</dt>
        <dd>{day(facts.answeredAt, F.answeredAt.none)}</dd>
        <dt>{F.handedOverAt.label}</dt>
        <dd>{day(facts.handedOverAt, F.handedOverAt.none)}</dd>
        <dt>{F.leave.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.leave === null ? F.leave.none : F.leave.from[facts.leave.from]}</dd>
        <dt>{F.leaveReference.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.leave === null ? F.leaveReference.none : <Frame by={F.theirReference.frame} text={facts.leave.reference} />}</dd>
        <dt>{F.leaveDay.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.leave === null ? F.leaveDay.none : facts.leave.receivedOn}</dd>
        <dt>{F.tell.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.tellHeld ? F.tell.record : F.tell.atOnce}</dd>
        <dt>{F.quarantined.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.quarantined ? F.quarantined.yes : F.quarantined.no}</dd>
      </dl>
      {facts.releasedAt !== null && facts.backupsClearAt !== null ? <p className="notice">{W.releaseDone(bothTimes(facts.releasedAt), facts.noticeHeld === true, bothTimes(facts.backupsClearAt))}</p> : null}
      <p className="hint">{R.backups(RETENTION.backupDays)}</p>
      {facts.silenceDays === null ? <p className="hint">{R.periodUnset}</p> : null}
      {facts.releasedAt !== null ? null : facts.leave === null ? (
        <p className="notice">{facts.answer === "illegal" ? R.assessed : R.nothing}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          {facts.answer === "not_illegal" ? <p className="error">{R.conflict}</p> : null}
          <p>{R.leave(F.leave.from[facts.leave.from]!)}</p>
        </>
      )}
      {params === null ? null : (
        <div className="actions">
          <p className="hint">{W.releaseSign}</p>
          {admin ? null : <p className="hint">{R.adminOnly}</p>}
          <button type="button" disabled={!admin || busy} aria-busy={busy} onClick={() => actions.onRelease(upload, params)}>
            {R.button}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** One refusal's block (8.6): its time, its match's record, the uploader's count and state, the objection, and the controls. */
export function UploadBlock({ upload, actions }: { upload: HeldUpload; actions: UploadsActions }) {
  return (
    <article className="panel upload" aria-labelledby={`upload-${upload.id}`}>
      <h3 id={`upload-${upload.id}`}>{W.refusedAt(bothTimes(upload.refusedAt))}</h3>
      <MatchRecordView match={upload.match} />
      <p>{W.others(upload.otherRefusals)}</p>
      {upload.uploaderGone ? <p className="notice">{W.gone}</p> : null}
      <p className="notice">{stateLine(upload)}</p>
      {upload.objection !== null && upload.objectedAt !== null ? (
        <>
          <p>{W.objection.lead(bothTimes(upload.objectedAt))}</p>
          <Frame by={W.objection.by} text={upload.objection} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      <EndControl upload={upload} actions={actions} />
      <UploadReleaseBlock upload={upload} actions={actions} />
    </article>
  );
}

export interface UploadsViewProps {
  rows: Loadable<HeldUpload[]>;
  more: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  onLoadMore(): void;
  actions: UploadsActions;
}

export function UploadsView({ rows, more, loadingMore, onLoadMore, actions }: UploadsViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="uploads-title">
      <h2 id="uploads-title">{W.title}</h2>
      <p className="hint">{W.what}</p>
      <Loaded
        value={rows}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>{W.empty}</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="uploads">
              {list.map((upload) => (
                // Keyed by the refusal and its state: a block drawn again after an end starts with nothing chosen.
                <UploadBlock key={`${upload.id}-${upload.endAs ?? "open"}-${upload.release?.releasedAt ?? ""}`} upload={upload} actions={actions} />
              ))}
            </div>
          )
        }
      />
      {more ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={onLoadMore} disabled={loadingMore} aria-busy={loadingMore}>
          {W.more}
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The screen: reads the first page when it opens, and each further page when the person asks; never on a timer. */
export function Uploads({ api, credentials, role }: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; role: StaffRole }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Loadable<HeldUpload[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    api.uploads(null, { activity: true }).then(
      (answer) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setRows({ state: "ready", value: answer.uploads });
        setNext(answer.nextCursor);
      },
      (err: unknown) => alive.current && setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
    );
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (next === null || rows.state !== "ready") return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const answer = await api.uploads(next, { activity: true });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setRows({ state: "ready", value: [...rows.value, ...answer.uploads] });
      setNext(answer.nextCursor);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  /** Runs one keyed act on a refusal and puts the refusal as it now shows in the place of the one the page showed. */
  const act = async (upload: HeldUpload, run: () => Promise<HeldUpload>) => {
    setBusy(upload.id);
    setErrors((now) => ({ ...now, [upload.id]: "" }));
    try {
      const after = await run();
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setRows((now) => (now.state === "ready" ? { state: "ready", value: now.value.map((row) => (row.id === after.id ? after : row)) } : now));
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setErrors((now) => ({ ...now, [upload.id]: describeError(err) }));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const actions: UploadsActions = {
    role,
    busy,
    errors,
    onEnd: (upload, params) => void act(upload, () => endHoldWithKey({ api, credentials }, upload.id, params)),
    onRelease: (upload, params) => void act(upload, () => releaseUploadWithKey({ api, credentials }, upload.id, params)),
  };
  return <UploadsView rows={rows} more={next !== null} loadingMore={loadingMore} onLoadMore={() => void loadMore()} actions={actions} />;
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/media/match-adapter.ts`

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { MatchHashType, MatchKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { MATCH_FIXTURES } from "@korbat/media-protocol";

/**
 * The comparison with known material (3d design, sections 2 rows 28, 32 and 33, 5 "The adapters", 7.8; Task 7), chosen by
 * MEDIA_MATCH when the process starts. It is given hashes and nothing else, and it imports nothing of the media module:
 * match.ts and the finalize flow read the rows and hand it one request built by `matchRequest`, which takes the four
 * hashes alone, so no adapter can be sent an image, an address, an account or an id of korbat's. An architecture test
 * holds the file to that.
 *
 *   - `off` (the default): nothing is hashed or compared anywhere; the adapter answers nothing, and nothing asks it.
 *   - `test`: answers on the digests of the two byte-constant PNG files of @korbat/media-protocol's MATCH_FIXTURES,
 *     computed from those bytes when the adapter is built. The `acting` file is an exact SHA-256 match of the one
 *     classification the adapter declares listed and acting; the `flag` file is a match that does not act, of the kind a
 *     test sets: a near match of the listed class (by SHA-1), or an exact match of the class that is not listed (by MD5).
 *     A test can also make it not answer, or answer every file as the acting match. It is built only while the app's
 *     site is closed, in the process as at start.
 *   - a source's name: no adapter for a real source exists in this build (each needs an agreement before its interface can
 *     be read); the configuration stops the process at start with "no such adapter in this build".
 *
 * Each adapter declares MATCH_LISTED, the classifications its source itself names child sexual abuse material, and its
 * part MATCH_ACTING, those on which a program may act; the database's match_listed() and match_acting() hold the same
 * pairs, which a database test checks.
 */

/** The four hashes an upload has: three cryptographic hashes of the bytes as received, and PDQ when the worker gave one. */
export interface UploadHashes {
  sha256: Uint8Array;
  sha1: Uint8Array;
  md5: Uint8Array;
  /** 32 bytes; absent in this build, whose worker computes no PDQ. */
  pdq?: Uint8Array;
}

/** What is sent: each hash as lower-case hexadecimal, and nothing else. */
export interface MatchRequest {
  sha256: string;
  sha1: string;
  md5: string;
  pdq?: string;
}

/** What the source answered: no match; a match; or nothing in time, which the caller records as unchecked. */
export type MatchAnswer =
  | { state: "clear" }
  | {
      state: "matched";
      hashType: MatchHashType;
      kind: MatchKind;
      /** As the source returned it, at most 100 characters. */
      classification: string;
      listVersion: string | null;
    }
  | { state: "unanswered" };

export interface MatchAdapter {
  readonly mode: "off" | "test";
  /** The source's declared name, which a statement names once the source allows it; null while off. */
  readonly source: string | null;
  readonly listed: readonly string[];
  readonly acting: readonly string[];
  check(request: MatchRequest): Promise<MatchAnswer>;
}

/** The `test` adapter's switches, which a test sets; and what it was sent, one request a call. */
export interface TestMatchAdapter extends MatchAdapter {
  readonly mode: "test";
  /** The kind of match the `flag` fixture answers. */
  flag: "near" | "unlisted";
  /** Answers nothing (unanswered) while set. */
  silent: boolean;
  /** Answers every request as an exact match of the acting class while set: a source gone wrong. */
  matchAll: boolean;
  readonly requests: readonly MatchRequest[];
}

/** The test adapter's source name and its two classifications, which match_listed() and match_acting() hold too. */
export const TEST_SOURCE = "test";
export const TEST_LISTED_CLASS = "test_listed";
export const TEST_UNLISTED_CLASS = "test_unlisted";
export const TEST_LIST_VERSION = "test-1";
/** MATCH_LISTED and MATCH_ACTING of each adapter built in, by source; the test adapter's alone in this build. */
export const MATCH_LISTED: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>> = { [TEST_SOURCE]: [TEST_LISTED_CLASS] };
export const MATCH_ACTING: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>> = { [TEST_SOURCE]: [TEST_LISTED_CLASS] };

const hex = (bytes: Uint8Array) => Buffer.from(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength).toString("hex");

/**
 * The one function that builds a request: the four hashes as hexadecimal, PDQ only when given. It takes the hashes and
 * nothing else, and a test fails when its result holds any other member.
 */
export function matchRequest(hashes: UploadHashes): MatchRequest {
  const request: MatchRequest = { sha256: hex(hashes.sha256), sha1: hex(hashes.sha1), md5: hex(hashes.md5) };
  if (hashes.pdq !== undefined) request.pdq = hex(hashes.pdq);
  return request;
}

/** The settings the adapter is built from: the configuration's own members of the same names. */
export interface MatchSettings {
  MEDIA_MATCH: string;
  APP_SITE: "open" | "closed";
}

const digest = (algorithm: "sha256" | "sha1" | "md5", bytes: Uint8Array) => createHash(algorithm).update(bytes).digest("hex");

export function matchAdapterFrom(settings: MatchSettings): MatchAdapter | TestMatchAdapter {
  if (settings.MEDIA_MATCH === "off") {
    return {
      mode: "off",
      source: null,
      listed: [],
      acting: [],
      check: async () => {
        throw new Error("known material: the comparison is off, and nothing is sent");
      },
    };
  }
  if (settings.MEDIA_MATCH !== TEST_SOURCE) throw new Error(`known material: MEDIA_MATCH=${settings.MEDIA_MATCH}: no such adapter in this build`);
  // The same rule as the configuration's, so a test adapter built in the process answers only on a closed site too.
  if (settings.APP_SITE !== "closed") throw new Error("known material: MEDIA_MATCH=test is refused while APP_SITE is open");
  // The digests are taken from the fixtures' bytes here, when the adapter is built; a unit test holds them to node:crypto's.
  const acting = digest("sha256", MATCH_FIXTURES.acting);
  const flagSha1 = digest("sha1", MATCH_FIXTURES.flag);
  const flagMd5 = digest("md5", MATCH_FIXTURES.flag);
  const requests: MatchRequest[] = [];
  const adapter: TestMatchAdapter = {
    mode: "test",
    source: TEST_SOURCE,
    listed: MATCH_LISTED[TEST_SOURCE]!,
    acting: MATCH_ACTING[TEST_SOURCE]!,
    flag: "near",
    silent: false,
    matchAll: false,
    requests,
    async check(request) {
      requests.push({ ...request });
      if (adapter.silent) return { state: "unanswered" };
      if (adapter.matchAll || request.sha256 === acting) {
        return { state: "matched", hashType: "sha256", kind: "exact", classification: TEST_LISTED_CLASS, listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION };
      }
      if (adapter.flag === "near" && request.sha1 === flagSha1) {
        return { state: "matched", hashType: "sha1", kind: "near", classification: TEST_LISTED_CLASS, listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION };
      }
      if (adapter.flag === "unlisted" && request.md5 === flagMd5) {
        return { state: "matched", hashType: "md5", kind: "exact", classification: TEST_UNLISTED_CLASS, listVersion: TEST_LIST_VERSION };
      }
      return { state: "clear" };
    },
  };
  return adapter;
}

/** The hash a match rests on, taken from the hashes the request was built from: what the match record keeps. */
export function matchedHash(hashes: UploadHashes, hashType: MatchHashType): Uint8Array | null {
  if (hashType === "pdq") return hashes.pdq ?? null;
  return hashes[hashType];
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/media/match-repo.ts`

```ts
import { sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  DESTRUCTIVE_DAYS,
  UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE,
  type MatchCheckState,
  type MatchHashType,
  type MatchKind,
  type MatchRecord,
  type UploadEnd,
  type UploadEndReason,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ReceivedHashes } from "./files";

/**
 * Every statement on the three tables of the migration known_material (3d design, sections 5, 6.7, 7.8 and 7.12; Task 7):
 * media_hashes, media_matches and upload_refusals, which no file outside the media module names (the architecture test's
 * rule on post_media covers them). The database forces what a record and a refusal mean: media_matches_insert forces
 * `listed` and `acting`, upload_refusals_insert refuses a record that is not acting or an image that is attached and
 * answers refusals_capped over the hour's limit, and upload_refusals_hold holds the image row and the uploader's address.
 * Every time is the database's. Nothing here reads or answers an image file.
 */

/** A connection or a transaction to run a statement on. */
export type Runner = Pick<Db, "execute"> | Pick<DbTx, "execute">;

/** Ids as one uuid[] parameter. */
const uuidArray = (ids: readonly string[]): SQL => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;
/** An instant as ISO text in UTC, to the millisecond. */
const iso = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')`);
/** An instant as ISO text in UTC, to the microsecond, for a list's cursor. */
const micros = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')`);

/** An upload's hashes as the comparison reads them, with its check's state, its image's state and where it is. */
export interface HashedUpload {
  mediaId: string;
  ownerId: string;
  status: "processing" | "ready" | "failed";
  postId: string | null;
  checkState: MatchCheckState;
  hashes: ReceivedHashes;
}

/** A match record's row as the readers of this module turn it into a MatchRecord. */
type RawMatch = {
  id: string;
  media_id: string;
  case_id: string | null;
  source: string;
  list_version: string | null;
  hash_type: MatchHashType;
  match_kind: MatchKind;
  classification: string | null;
  listed: boolean;
  acting: boolean;
  queried_at: string;
};

const MATCH_COLUMNS = sql`x.id, x.media_id, x.case_id, x.source, x.list_version, x.hash_type, x.match_kind, x.classification, x.listed, x.acting, ${iso("x.queried_at")} as queried_at`;

const recordOf = (row: RawMatch): MatchRecord => ({
  source: row.source,
  listVersion: row.list_version,
  hashType: row.hash_type,
  matchKind: row.match_kind,
  classification: row.classification,
  listed: row.listed,
  acting: row.acting,
  queriedAt: row.queried_at,
});

/** A refusal as Held uploads lists it, before its release block is read. */
export interface RefusalRow {
  id: string;
  mediaId: string;
  ownerId: string | null;
  refusedAt: string;
  match: MatchRecord;
  otherRefusals: number;
  uploaderGone: boolean;
  objection: string | null;
  objectedAt: string | null;
  endedAt: string | null;
  endAs: UploadEnd | null;
  endReason: UploadEndReason | null;
  deletesAt: string | null;
  reported: boolean;
  releaseId: string | null;
  quarantined: boolean;
}

type RawRefusal = RawMatch & {
  refusal_id: string;
  refusal_media_id: string;
  owner_id: string | null;
  refused_at: string;
  other_refusals: number;
  uploader_gone: boolean;
  objection: string | null;
  objected_at: string | null;
  ended_at: string | null;
  end_as: UploadEnd | null;
  end_reason: UploadEndReason | null;
  deletes_at: string | null;
  notification_id: string | null;
  release_id: string | null;
  quarantined: boolean;
};

/**
 * The refusal's columns with its match and the counts an admin is shown: `other_refusals` counts the same uploader's other
 * refusals whose hold has not ended or ended as report, never one ended as no_report, so a mistake of the source that an
 * admin set aside weighs on nothing later; `deletes_at` is the image row's hold_until after an end as no_report.
 */
const REFUSAL_COLUMNS = sql`${MATCH_COLUMNS}, u.id as refusal_id, u.media_id as refusal_media_id, u.owner_id, ${iso("u.refused_at")} as refused_at,
  (select count(*)::int from public.upload_refusals o
    where o.owner_id = u.owner_id and o.id <> u.id and (o.end_as is null or o.end_as = 'report')) as other_refusals,
  (u.owner_id is null or exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = u.owner_id and p.deleted_at is not null)) as uploader_gone,
  u.objection, ${iso("u.objected_at")} as objected_at, ${iso("u.ended_at")} as ended_at, u.end_as, u.end_reason,
  case when u.end_as = 'no_report' then ${iso("m.hold_until")} end as deletes_at,
  u.notification_id, u.release_id, public.media_quarantined(u.media_id) as quarantined`;

const refusalOf = (row: RawRefusal): RefusalRow => ({
  id: row.refusal_id,
  mediaId: row.refusal_media_id,
  ownerId: row.owner_id,
  refusedAt: row.refused_at,
  match: recordOf(row),
  otherRefusals: row.other_refusals,
  uploaderGone: row.uploader_gone,
  objection: row.objection,
  objectedAt: row.objected_at,
  endedAt: row.ended_at,
  endAs: row.end_as,
  endReason: row.end_reason,
  deletesAt: row.deletes_at,
  reported: row.notification_id !== null,
  releaseId: row.release_id,
  quarantined: row.quarantined,
});

/** What an uploader's notice reads of their refusal (UploadRefusalView), before the release's time is checked. */
export interface OwnRefusal {
  id: string;
  refusedAt: string;
  source: string;
  hashType: MatchHashType;
  matchKind: MatchKind;
  objection: string | null;
  objectedAt: string | null;
  endedAt: string | null;
  endAs: UploadEnd | null;
  endReason: UploadEndReason | null;
  /** Whether the delay after an end as no_report has passed: until then the uploader is told nothing of that end. */
  delayPassed: boolean;
  releaseId: string | null;
  notificationId: string | null;
}

export function createMatchRepo(db: Db) {
  return {
    /** The pool the statements run on, for a read outside a transaction. */
    db: db as Runner,
    /** A transaction on that pool: finalize's and the retry's, which store an answer with its record and refusal. */
    transaction: <T>(fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => db.transaction(fn),

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ the hashes and the check (7.8)

    /**
     * Step 1's second write: the upload's hashes with its check pending, inside the transaction that inserts its image
     * row, so no image row exists without its hashes while the comparison is on.
     */
    async insertHashes(tx: Runner, mediaId: string, hashes: ReceivedHashes): Promise<void> {
      await tx.execute(sql`
        insert into public.media_hashes (media_id, sha256, sha1, md5, check_state)
        values (${mediaId}::uuid, ${hashes.sha256}::bytea, ${hashes.sha1}::bytea, ${hashes.md5}::bytea, 'pending')`);
    },

    /** The upload's hashes and where it stands, or null when it has none (the comparison was off when it came). */
    async hashed(q: Runner, mediaId: string): Promise<HashedUpload | null> {
      const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`
        select h.media_id, m.owner_id, m.status, m.post_id, h.check_state, h.sha256, h.sha1, h.md5
          from public.media_hashes h join public.post_media m on m.id = h.media_id
         where h.media_id = ${mediaId}::uuid`)) as unknown as { media_id: string; owner_id: string; status: HashedUpload["status"]; post_id: string | null; check_state: MatchCheckState; sha256: Buffer; sha1: Buffer; md5: Buffer }[];
      if (!row) return null;
      return { mediaId: row.media_id, ownerId: row.owner_id, status: row.status, postId: row.post_id, checkState: row.check_state, hashes: { sha256: row.sha256, sha1: row.sha1, md5: row.md5 } };
    },

    /** The check's state, when and by which adapter it was last answered. */
    async setCheck(q: Runner, mediaId: string, state: MatchCheckState, source: string | null): Promise<void> {
      await q.execute(sql`update public.media_hashes set check_state = ${state}, checked_at = now(), source = ${source} where media_id = ${mediaId}::uuid`);
    },

    /** One match record; its trigger forces `listed` and `acting`, which are answered with its id. */
    async insertMatch(
      q: Runner,
      record: { mediaId: string; source: string; listVersion: string | null; hashType: MatchHashType; kind: MatchKind; classification: string; hash: Uint8Array },
    ): Promise<{ id: string; listed: boolean; acting: boolean }> {
      const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`
        insert into public.media_matches (media_id, source, list_version, hash_type, match_kind, classification, hash, listed, acting, queried_at)
        values (${record.mediaId}::uuid, ${record.source}, ${record.listVersion}, ${record.hashType}, ${record.kind}, ${record.classification},
                ${Buffer.from(record.hash.buffer, record.hash.byteOffset, record.hash.byteLength)}::bytea, false, false, now())
        returning id, listed, acting`)) as unknown as { id: string; listed: boolean; acting: boolean }[];
      return row!;
    },

    /** A refusal of an upload on no post; its triggers hold it and answer upload_attached, refusal_not_acting or refusals_capped. */
    async insertRefusal(q: Runner, refusal: { mediaId: string; ownerId: string; matchId: string }): Promise<string> {
      const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`
        insert into public.upload_refusals (media_id, owner_id, match_id, refused_at)
        values (${refusal.mediaId}::uuid, ${refusal.ownerId}::uuid, ${refusal.matchId}::uuid, now()) returning id`)) as unknown as { id: string }[];
      return row!.id;
    },

    /**
     * match-retry's read (7.8 step 6): the uploads whose check is unchecked or capped and whose image row is younger than
     * `hours`, the oldest first, at most `limit`.
     */
    async retryDue(limit: number, hours: number): Promise<string[]> {
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`
        select h.media_id from public.media_hashes h join public.post_media m on m.id = h.media_id
         where h.check_state in ('unchecked', 'capped') and m.created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours}::int)
         order by m.created_at, m.id limit ${limit}::int`)) as unknown as { media_id: string }[];
      return rows.map((row) => row.media_id);
    },

    /** The ids of these uploads whose check is capped: the sweeper and the owner's status leave them to match-retry. */
    async capped(ids: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
      if (ids.length === 0) return new Set();
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`select media_id from public.media_hashes where check_state = 'capped' and media_id = any(${uuidArray(ids)})`)) as unknown as { media_id: string }[];
      return new Set(rows.map((row) => row.media_id));
    },

    /** How many uploads wait under the limit on refusals, and how many checks stay unanswered: matcher_down's facts. */
    async checkCounts(): Promise<{ unchecked: number; capped: number; oldestUnchecked: string | null }> {
      const [row] = (await db.execute(sql`
        select (count(*) filter (where h.check_state = 'unchecked'))::int as unchecked, (count(*) filter (where h.check_state = 'capped'))::int as capped,
               ${iso("min(m.created_at) filter (where h.check_state = 'unchecked')")} as oldest
          from public.media_hashes h join public.post_media m on m.id = h.media_id`)) as unknown as { unchecked: number; capped: number; oldest: string | null }[];
      return { unchecked: row!.unchecked, capped: row!.capped, oldestUnchecked: row!.oldest };
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ the match records (6.7, 7.9, 7.11)

    /** The image's unerased match record that the program is not done with, and its unerased one whatever its mark. */
    async recordsOfImages(q: Runner, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, { id: string; listed: boolean; acting: boolean; handled: boolean }>> {
      const found = new Map<string, { id: string; listed: boolean; acting: boolean; handled: boolean }>();
      if (mediaIds.length === 0) return found;
      const rows = (await q.execute(sql`
        select distinct on (x.media_id) x.media_id, x.id, x.listed, x.acting, x.handled_at is not null as handled
          from public.media_matches x where x.media_id = any(${uuidArray(mediaIds)}) and x.erased_at is null
         order by x.media_id, (x.handled_at is null) desc, x.queried_at desc, x.id`)) as unknown as { media_id: string; id: string; listed: boolean; acting: boolean; handled: boolean }[];
      for (const row of rows) found.set(row.media_id, { id: row.id, listed: row.listed, acting: row.acting, handled: row.handled });
      return found;
    },

    /** One record, as staff are shown it, with its image and its case; null when there is none. */
    async record(q: Runner, matchId: string): Promise<(MatchRecord & { id: string; mediaId: string; caseId: string | null; handled: boolean; erased: boolean }) | null> {
      const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`select ${MATCH_COLUMNS}, x.handled_at is not null as handled, x.erased_at is not null as erased from public.media_matches x where x.id = ${matchId}::uuid`)) as unknown as (RawMatch & { handled: boolean; erased: boolean })[];
      return row ? { ...recordOf(row), id: row.id, mediaId: row.media_id, caseId: row.case_id, handled: row.handled, erased: row.erased } : null;
    },

    /** The records of these match ids, keyed by id: the case page's signals. */
    async records(matchIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, MatchRecord>> {
      const found = new Map<string, MatchRecord>();
      if (matchIds.length === 0) return found;
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`select ${MATCH_COLUMNS} from public.media_matches x where x.id = any(${uuidArray(matchIds)})`)) as unknown as RawMatch[];
      for (const row of rows) found.set(row.id, recordOf(row));
      return found;
    },

    /** Which of these images an unerased match record names: gate V's door, and the case page's [case.image.matched]. */
    async matched(q: Runner, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
      if (mediaIds.length === 0) return new Set();
      const rows = (await q.execute(sql`select distinct x.media_id from public.media_matches x where x.media_id = any(${uuidArray(mediaIds)}) and x.erased_at is null`)) as unknown as { media_id: string }[];
      return new Set(rows.map((row) => row.media_id));
    },

    /**
     * The automated step's write (7.9 step 2.2), in its transaction: the record is marked handled and, with a case, names
     * it once (review ruling 8). Its guard lets each column change only from null.
     */
    async joined(tx: Runner, matchId: string, caseId: string | null): Promise<void> {
      await tx.execute(sql`
        update public.media_matches set case_id = coalesce(case_id, ${caseId}::uuid), handled_at = now()
         where id = ${matchId}::uuid and handled_at is null`);
    },

    /**
     * The sweep's read of matches (7.9): images on a post whose post is not deleted by its author, ready and not erased,
     * with an unerased match record the program is not done with, acting or a flag; at most `limit`, the oldest first.
     */
    async unhandledOnPosts(limit: number): Promise<{ mediaId: string; postId: string; matchId: string }[]> {
      if (limit <= 0) return [];
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`
        select x.media_id, m.post_id, x.id from public.media_matches x
          join public.post_media m on m.id = x.media_id join public.posts p on p.id = m.post_id
         where x.handled_at is null and x.erased_at is null and m.status = 'ready' and m.erased_at is null and p.state <> 'deleted_by_author'
         order by x.queried_at, x.id limit ${limit}::int`)) as unknown as { media_id: string; post_id: string; id: string }[];
      return rows.map((row) => ({ mediaId: row.media_id, postId: row.post_id, matchId: row.id }));
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ refusals: the uploader's (7.12 steps 1 and 2)

    /** The refusal of an image, for its owner's status: its id while it names the owner. */
    async refusalOfImage(mediaId: string, ownerId: string): Promise<string | null> {
      const [row] = (await db.execute(sql`select u.id from public.upload_refusals u where u.media_id = ${mediaId}::uuid and u.owner_id = ${ownerId}::uuid`)) as unknown as { id: string }[];
      return row?.id ?? null;
    },

    /** One of the owner's refusals, as its notice reads it; null for any other's. */
    async ownRefusal(ownerId: string, refusalId: string): Promise<OwnRefusal | null> {
      const [row] = (await db.execute(sql`
        select u.id, ${iso("u.refused_at")} as refused_at, x.source, x.hash_type, x.match_kind, u.objection, ${iso("u.objected_at")} as objected_at,
               ${iso("u.ended_at")} as ended_at, u.end_as, u.end_reason,
               (u.end_as is distinct from 'no_report' or u.ended_at + make_interval(hours => r.no_report_hours) <= now()) as delay_passed,
               u.release_id, u.notification_id
          from public.upload_refusals u join public.media_matches x on x.id = u.match_id cross join public.automation_rules() r
         where u.id = ${refusalId}::uuid and u.owner_id = ${ownerId}::uuid`)) as unknown as {
        id: string;
        refused_at: string;
        source: string;
        hash_type: MatchHashType;
        match_kind: MatchKind;
        objection: string | null;
        objected_at: string | null;
        ended_at: string | null;
        end_as: UploadEnd | null;
        end_reason: UploadEndReason | null;
        delay_passed: boolean;
        release_id: string | null;
        notification_id: string | null;
      }[];
      if (!row) return null;
      return {
        id: row.id,
        refusedAt: row.refused_at,
        source: row.source,
        hashType: row.hash_type,
        matchKind: row.match_kind,
        objection: row.objection,
        objectedAt: row.objected_at,
        endedAt: row.ended_at,
        endAs: row.end_as,
        endReason: row.end_reason,
        delayPassed: row.delay_passed,
        releaseId: row.release_id,
        notificationId: row.notification_id,
      };
    },

    /** The owner's refusals, newest first, after a cursor's (time, id), one more than `limit`; with each one's sort key. */
    async refusalsOf(ownerId: string, after: { at: string; id: string } | null, limit: number): Promise<{ id: string; at: string; key: string }[]> {
      return (await db.execute(sql`
        select u.id, ${iso("u.refused_at")} as at, ${micros("u.refused_at")} as key from public.upload_refusals u
         where u.owner_id = ${ownerId}::uuid
           and (${after === null} or (u.refused_at, u.id) < (${after?.at ?? null}::timestamptz, ${after?.id ?? null}::uuid))
         order by u.refused_at desc, u.id desc limit ${limit}::int`)) as unknown as { id: string; at: string; key: string }[];
    },

    /**
     * The one statement that writes an objection (7.12 step 2): only on the owner's refusal, and only while it has none,
     * is not released and did not end as no_report, the rule the guard states too. Answers whether a row changed.
     */
    async object(ownerId: string, refusalId: string, text: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const rows = await db.execute(sql`
        update public.upload_refusals set objection = ${text}, objected_at = now()
         where id = ${refusalId}::uuid and owner_id = ${ownerId}::uuid and objection is null and release_id is null and end_as is distinct from 'no_report'
        returning id`);
      return rows.length === 1;
    },

    /** Whether the owner has a refusal of this id, whatever its state: the route's not_found and objection_not_open. */
    async owns(ownerId: string, refusalId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const rows = await db.execute(sql`select 1 from public.upload_refusals where id = ${refusalId}::uuid and owner_id = ${ownerId}::uuid`);
      return rows.length === 1;
    },

    /** The refusals whose notice is still owed, the oldest first, with their uploader: the dispatch round's notices. */
    async refusalsUntold(limit: number): Promise<{ id: string; ownerId: string | null; refusedAt: string }[]> {
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`
        select u.id, u.owner_id, ${iso("u.refused_at")} as refused_at from public.upload_refusals u where u.told = 'pending'
         order by u.refused_at, u.id limit ${limit}::int`)) as unknown as { id: string; owner_id: string | null; refused_at: string }[];
      return rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, ownerId: row.owner_id, refusedAt: row.refused_at }));
    },

    /** The outcome of a refusal's notice, which changes only a notice still pending. */
    async refusalTold(refusalId: string, outcome: "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "none" | "failed"): Promise<void> {
      await db.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set told = ${outcome}::delivery_state where id = ${refusalId}::uuid and told = 'pending'`);
    },

    /** The ends as no_report whose delay has passed and whose notice that the hold was lifted is still owed. */
    async liftedUntold(limit: number): Promise<{ id: string; ownerId: string | null; endedAt: string }[]> {
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`
        select u.id, u.owner_id, ${iso("u.ended_at")} as ended_at from public.upload_refusals u cross join public.automation_rules() r
         where u.lifted_told = 'pending' and u.end_as = 'no_report' and u.ended_at + make_interval(hours => r.no_report_hours) <= now()
         order by u.ended_at, u.id limit ${limit}::int`)) as unknown as { id: string; owner_id: string | null; ended_at: string }[];
      return rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, ownerId: row.owner_id, endedAt: row.ended_at }));
    },

    /** The outcome of the notice that a hold was lifted, which changes only a notice still pending. */
    async liftedTold(refusalId: string, outcome: "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "none" | "failed"): Promise<void> {
      await db.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set lifted_told = ${outcome}::delivery_state where id = ${refusalId}::uuid and lifted_told = 'pending'`);
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ refusals: staff's (7.12 steps 3 to 5, 8.2, 8.6)

    /**
     * Held uploads (7.12 step 3): the open holds, oldest first (section 0); then those ended as report and not released,
     * oldest first (section 1); then those released or ended as no_report in the last DESTRUCTIVE_DAYS days, newest first
     * (section 2). A page is UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE + 1 rows from `offset`: the list is short, and its order is the sections'.
     */
    async heldList(offset: number): Promise<RefusalRow[]> {
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`
        with listed as (
          select u.*, coalesce((select r.released_at from public.releases r where r.id = u.release_id), u.ended_at) as closed_at,
                 case when u.end_as is null then 0 when u.end_as = 'report' and u.release_id is null then 1 else 2 end as section
            from public.upload_refusals u
        )
        select ${REFUSAL_COLUMNS}
          from listed u join public.media_matches x on x.id = u.match_id left join public.post_media m on m.id = u.media_id
         where u.section < 2 or u.closed_at >= now() - make_interval(days => ${DESTRUCTIVE_DAYS}::int)
         order by u.section, case when u.section < 2 then u.refused_at end, u.closed_at desc, u.id
         offset ${offset}::int limit ${UPLOADS_PAGE_SIZE + 1}::int`)) as unknown as RawRefusal[];
      return rows.map(refusalOf);
    },

    /** One refusal as Held uploads shows it; null when there is none. */
    async held(refusalId: string): Promise<RefusalRow | null> {
      const [row] = (await db.execute(sql`
        select ${REFUSAL_COLUMNS}
          from public.upload_refusals u join public.media_matches x on x.id = u.match_id left join public.post_media m on m.id = u.media_id
         where u.id = ${refusalId}::uuid`)) as unknown as RawRefusal[];
      return row ? refusalOf(row) : null;
    },

    /**
     * Home's [home.uploads] and the urgent alert's `heldUploads` (8.2, W.7): the holds no admin has ended, with the oldest
     * refusal; the unanswered objections of a hold that is open or ended as report and not released; and the uploads that
     * wait under the limit on refusals.
     */
    async heldOverview(): Promise<{ open: number; oldest: string | null; objected: number; capped: number }> {
      const [row] = (await db.execute(sql`
        select (count(*) filter (where u.end_as is null))::int as open, ${iso("min(u.refused_at) filter (where u.end_as is null)")} as oldest,
               (count(*) filter (where u.objection is not null and (u.end_as is null or (u.end_as = 'report' and u.release_id is null))))::int as objected,
               (select count(*)::int from public.media_hashes h where h.check_state = 'capped') as capped
          from public.upload_refusals u`)) as unknown as { open: number; oldest: string | null; objected: number; capped: number }[];
      return { open: row!.open, oldest: row!.oldest, objected: row!.objected, capped: row!.capped };
    },

    /** The holds ended as no_report in the last `days` days, newest first: Home's [home.unreported]. */
    async recentUnreported(days: number, max: number): Promise<{ at: string; refusalId: string }[]> {
      const rows = (await db.execute(sql`
        select ${iso("u.ended_at")} as at, u.id from public.upload_refusals u
         where u.end_as = 'no_report' and u.ended_at >= now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int)
         order by u.ended_at desc, u.id desc limit ${max}::int`)) as unknown as { at: string; id: string }[];
      return rows.map((row) => ({ at: row.at, refusalId: row.id }));
    },

    /** The uploader and the image of a refusal, for the end's and the release's transactions; null when there is none. */
    async refusalSubject(q: Runner, refusalId: string): Promise<{ ownerId: string | null; mediaId: string } | null> {
      const [row] = (await q.execute(sql`select u.owner_id, u.media_id from public.upload_refusals u where u.id = ${refusalId}::uuid`)) as unknown as { owner_id: string | null; media_id: string }[];
      return row ? { ownerId: row.owner_id, mediaId: row.media_id } : null;
    },
  };
}

export type MatchRepo = ReturnType<typeof createMatchRepo>;
```

### Create `apps/api/src/media/match.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, MATCH_RETRY_BATCH } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ResultFile } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import type { MatchEvent, MediaDeps } from "./context";
import { matchRequest, matchedHash, type MatchAnswer } from "./match-adapter";
import type { HashedUpload, Runner } from "./match-repo";

/**
 * The comparison of an upload with known material (3d design, sections 2 rows 27 to 35, 7.8 and 7.14; Task 7): asking the
 * source once, bounded in time, and storing its answer with the worker's verdict; the record of a match, and for an acting
 * match on an upload that is on no post its refusal and hold, which the database forces; and the job match-retry, which
 * asks again for a check that was not answered or that met the limit on refusals an hour. While MEDIA_MATCH is off no
 * upload has hashes, and nothing here runs.
 *
 * What a match does is the database's: media_matches_insert forces `listed` and `acting`, upload_refusals_insert refuses
 * a record that is not acting (so a flag refuses nothing) and answers refusals_capped over the hour's limit, and
 * upload_refusals_hold holds the image and the uploader's address. After the commit the moderation module is told through
 * media.onMatch: a refusal, for the uploader's notice and the urgent alert; a match on a posted image, for the automated
 * step; an upload over the limit, for matcher_down at once.
 */

/** match-retry's name: its lock is `job:match-retry`. A round a minute after the last one ended (7.14). */
export const MATCH_RETRY_JOB = "match-retry";
export const MATCH_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

/** The message of an exception a trigger or a function raised as its code (SQLSTATE P0001); null for anything else. */
function raised(err: unknown): string | null {
  let current: unknown = err;
  for (let depth = 0; depth < 5 && current; depth++) {
    const code = (current as { code?: unknown }).code;
    if (typeof current === "object" && code === "P0001") {
      const message = (current as { message?: unknown }).message;
      return typeof message === "string" ? message : null;
    }
    current = (current as { cause?: unknown }).cause;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * One question to the source (7.8 step 3.2): the request the adapter's one builder makes of the four hashes and nothing
 * else, bounded at AUTOMATION_RULES.matchTimeoutMs. No answer in time, and any failure of the adapter, is `unanswered`:
 * the upload is accepted and asked about again. A PDQ would be sent only at or over pdqMinQuality; this build has none.
 */
export async function askSource(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "match" | "log">, hashed: HashedUpload): Promise<MatchAnswer> {
  let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
  const late = new Promise<MatchAnswer>((resolve) => {
    timer = setTimeout(() => resolve({ state: "unanswered" }), AUTOMATION_RULES.matchTimeoutMs);
  });
  try {
    return await Promise.race([deps.match.check(matchRequest(hashed.hashes)), late]);
  } catch (err) {
    // The source's error is logged by its kind alone: no hash and no answer reaches a log line.
    deps.log.warn({ id: hashed.mediaId, err: (err as Error)?.name }, "known material: the source did not answer; the upload is accepted and asked about again");
    return { state: "unanswered" };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

/** What storing a check left: the row's outcome, and what the moderation module is told after the commit. */
export interface StoredCheck {
  /** `none` when another caller finalized the row first and nothing was written. */
  stored: "clear" | "unchecked" | "matched" | "capped" | "none";
  events: MatchEvent[];
}

/**
 * Inside a savepoint: the record of a match and, for an acting match of an upload on no post, its refusal. Answers the
 * event to tell. A refusal's insert that finds the row attached meanwhile (upload_attached, which no route answers) rolls
 * the savepoint back, and the match is stored again as a match on a posted image.
 */
async function storeMatch(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "matches" | "match">, tx: DbTx, upload: { mediaId: string; ownerId: string; onPost: boolean }, hashed: HashedUpload, answer: Extract<MatchAnswer, { state: "matched" }>): Promise<MatchEvent | null> {
  const record = { mediaId: upload.mediaId, source: deps.match.source!, listVersion: answer.listVersion, hashType: answer.hashType, kind: answer.kind, classification: answer.classification.slice(0, 100), hash: matchedHash(hashed.hashes, answer.hashType) ?? hashed.hashes.sha256 };
  const posted = async (q: Runner): Promise<MatchEvent> => {
    const match = await deps.matches.insertMatch(q, record);
    return { kind: "posted", mediaId: upload.mediaId, matchId: match.id };
  };
  if (upload.onPost) return posted(tx);
  try {
    return await tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
      const match = await deps.matches.insertMatch(sp, record);
      // A flag is accepted like any image: nothing is refused or held, and its record waits for the image to be posted.
      if (!match.acting) return null;
      const refusalId = await deps.matches.insertRefusal(sp, { mediaId: upload.mediaId, ownerId: upload.ownerId, matchId: match.id });
      return { kind: "refused", refusalId } satisfies MatchEvent;
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (raised(err) !== "upload_attached") throw err;
    return posted(tx);
  }
}

/**
 * finalize's transaction for an upload whose check was asked (7.8 step 3.3): the worker's verdict, as repo.finalize writes
 * it, only on a row still processing; its score; the check's state; and for a match its record and, when it acts, its
 * refusal. All of it in a savepoint: when the refusal's insert answers refusals_capped (the hour's limit), the savepoint
 * rolls back, nothing of the match is written and the row stays processing, and the check is recorded as capped. With a
 * 10-second lock timeout.
 */
export async function storeVerdict(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "matches" | "match">, id: string, result: ResultFile, score: number | null, hashed: HashedUpload, answer: MatchAnswer): Promise<StoredCheck> {
  return deps.matches.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', '10000ms', true)`);
    try {
      return await tx.transaction(async (sp): Promise<StoredCheck> => {
        const verdict =
          result.status === "ready"
            ? sql`status = 'ready', width = ${result.width}::int, height = ${result.height}::int, blurhash = ${result.blurhash}, nsfw_score = coalesce(${score}::real, nsfw_score)`
            : sql`status = 'failed', error = ${result.reason}`;
        const updated = (await sp.execute(sql`update public.post_media set ${verdict} where id = ${id}::uuid and status = 'processing' returning owner_id, post_id`)) as unknown as { owner_id: string; post_id: string | null }[];
        if (updated.length === 0) return { stored: "none", events: [] };
        if (result.status !== "ready") return { stored: "none", events: [] };
        if (answer.state !== "matched") {
          const state = answer.state === "clear" ? "clear" : "unchecked";
          await deps.matches.setCheck(sp, id, state, answer.state === "clear" ? deps.match.source : null);
          return { stored: state, events: [] };
        }
        await deps.matches.setCheck(sp, id, "matched", deps.match.source);
        const event = await storeMatch(deps, sp, { mediaId: id, ownerId: updated[0]!.owner_id, onPost: updated[0]!.post_id !== null }, hashed, answer);
        return { stored: "matched", events: event === null ? [] : [event] };
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (raised(err) !== "refusals_capped") throw err;
      // Nothing of the match is written and the row stays processing: not ready, not postable, nobody told.
      await deps.matches.setCheck(tx, id, "capped", deps.match.source);
      return { stored: "capped", events: [{ kind: "capped" }] };
    }
  });
}

/**
 * match-retry's answer for an image that is ready, its first check unanswered (7.8 step 6): clear, the state alone;
 * unanswered, the state again with the attempt's time; matched, the record and, for an acting match of an upload that is
 * still on no post, its refusal, or the record alone for an image on a post, whose automated step the event starts. A
 * refusal over the hour's limit leaves the check unchecked, to be asked again: the upload is ready already.
 */
export async function storeLateAnswer(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "matches" | "match">, hashed: HashedUpload, answer: MatchAnswer): Promise<StoredCheck> {
  return deps.matches.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', '10000ms', true)`);
    // The image row first, then a statement of its own: an attach or a deletion that committed meanwhile is seen.
    await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.post_media where id = ${hashed.mediaId}::uuid for no key update`);
    const now = await deps.matches.hashed(tx, hashed.mediaId);
    if (now === null || now.checkState !== "unchecked" || now.status !== "ready") return { stored: "none", events: [] };
    if (answer.state !== "matched") {
      const state = answer.state === "clear" ? "clear" : "unchecked";
      await deps.matches.setCheck(tx, hashed.mediaId, state, answer.state === "clear" ? deps.match.source : null);
      return { stored: state, events: [] };
    }
    try {
      return await tx.transaction(async (sp): Promise<StoredCheck> => {
        await deps.matches.setCheck(sp, hashed.mediaId, "matched", deps.match.source);
        const event = await storeMatch(deps, sp, { mediaId: hashed.mediaId, ownerId: now.ownerId, onPost: now.postId !== null }, hashed, answer);
        return { stored: "matched", events: event === null ? [] : [event] };
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (raised(err) !== "refusals_capped") throw err;
      await deps.matches.setCheck(tx, hashed.mediaId, "unchecked", null);
      return { stored: "unchecked", events: [{ kind: "capped" }] };
    }
  });
}

/** Tells the moderation module what a commit stored, each event in a try of its own; a lost call is found by a sweep. */
export async function tellMatched(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "matched" | "log">, events: readonly MatchEvent[]): Promise<void> {
  const handler = deps.matched.handler;
  if (handler === null) return;
  for (const event of events) {
    try {
      await handler(event);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, event: event.kind }, "known material: the moderation module was not told of a stored match; its sweep or its dispatch round finds it");
    }
  }
}

/** What one round of match-retry did. */
export interface MatchRetryReport {
  asked: number;
  clear: number;
  matched: number;
  unchecked: number;
  capped: number;
  failed: number;
}

/**
 * One round of match-retry (7.8 step 6, 7.14): with the comparison on, at most MATCH_RETRY_BATCH uploads whose check is
 * unchecked or capped and whose image row is younger than AUTOMATION_RULES.matchRetryHours, oldest first. A capped
 * upload is still processing, with its result in the store: finalize asks again and stores the verdict, or leaves it
 * capped while the hour's count does not allow a refusal. An unchecked one is ready: its late answer is stored as above.
 * Each upload in a try of its own. After matchRetryHours a row stays unchecked for good, and the sweeper's bound fails a
 * capped one.
 */
export async function matchRetryRound(deps: MediaDeps, finalize: (deps: MediaDeps, id: string) => Promise<boolean>): Promise<MatchRetryReport> {
  const report: MatchRetryReport = { asked: 0, clear: 0, matched: 0, unchecked: 0, capped: 0, failed: 0 };
  if (deps.match.mode === "off") return report;
  for (const id of await deps.matches.retryDue(MATCH_RETRY_BATCH, AUTOMATION_RULES.matchRetryHours)) {
    try {
      const hashed = await deps.matches.hashed(deps.matches.db, id);
      if (hashed === null) continue;
      report.asked++;
      if (hashed.checkState === "capped") {
        await finalize(deps, id);
        const after = await deps.matches.hashed(deps.matches.db, id);
        const state = after?.checkState;
        if (state === "matched") report.matched++;
        else if (state === "clear") report.clear++;
        else if (state === "capped") report.capped++;
        else report.unchecked++;
        continue;
      }
      const answer = await askSource(deps, hashed);
      const stored = await storeLateAnswer(deps, hashed, answer);
      if (stored.stored === "matched") report.matched++;
      else if (stored.stored === "clear") report.clear++;
      else report.unchecked++;
      await tellMatched(deps, stored.events);
    } catch (err) {
      report.failed++;
      deps.log.error({ err, id }, "match-retry: an upload's check could not be asked again; the next round tries it");
    }
  }
  return report;
}

/** The job under the shared lock: a round MATCH_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS after the last one ended, on one instance at a time. */
export function createMatchRetryJob(deps: MediaDeps, finalize: (deps: MediaDeps, id: string) => Promise<boolean>, lock: JobLock) {
  return createJob({ name: MATCH_RETRY_JOB, intervalMs: MATCH_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS, lockTtlMs: MATCH_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS * 2, lock, log: deps.log, run: () => matchRetryRound(deps, finalize) });
}
```
