  return { kind: "known_match", source: match.source, matchKind: statementMatchKind(match.hashType, match.matchKind), listedAs: match.listed ? "csam" : "other", viewed: null };
}

/**
 * The automation members of a person's statement (W.3), as the API's statement data carries them: what found the items the
 * decision is about, and whether its moderator opened the image on this case before deciding, which the page knows from
 * the images it showed this person. A correction or a review speaks of the decision it is about: a program's, or one whose
 * answered items a program found. Nothing when no program found anything here.
 */
function automationOf(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, viewedImages: readonly string[]): Partial<StatementInput> {
  let found: { signal: CaseSignal; mediaId: string | null } | null = null;
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review") {
    const corrected = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
    for (const signal of view.signals) {
      const item = view.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === signal.itemId);
      if (item !== undefined && (corrected?.byProgram === true || item.answeredBy === corrected?.id)) {
        found = { signal, mediaId: item.mediaId };
        break;
      }
    }
  } else {
    found = programFinding(view);
  }
  if (found === null) return {};
  const viewed = found.mediaId !== null && viewedImages.includes(found.mediaId);
  // 3d Task 7: a restriction on a match's finding citing R2 is partly automated, as decision_holds records it.
  return { automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: restrictsOnMatch(view, draft) ? "partially" : "not_automated", signal: statementSignalOf(found.signal, viewed) };
}

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (section 8.4, [case.auto]): the statement a program's decision sent its author, drawn again from the decision as
 * the case answer holds it: its one measure, no text, and the automation members of a decision without a decider.
 */
export function programStatementOf(view: CaseView, decision: CaseDecision): StatementInput {
  const signal = view.signals[0];
  return {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome,
    ground: decision.ground,
    ruleId: decision.ruleId,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: null,
    reason: null,
    source: decision.source,
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    post: postOf(view),
    measures: decision.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null).map((action) => ({ kind: action.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: action.noEffect, sealed: null })),
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    automatedDetection: true,
    automatedDecision: "fully",
    // 3d Task 7: a program's seal on a match names the match's source and kind, as its statement was sent.
    signal: signal === undefined ? { kind: "r1_score", source: null, matchKind: null, listedAs: null, viewed: null } : statementSignalOf(signal, null),
  };
}

/** Whether the decision a statement was drawn for sends its author anything: one that restricts nothing, lifts nothing and ends nothing is recorded without a mail. */
export const statementSent = (input: StatementInput): boolean => input.kind === "review" || input.kind === "correction" || input.measures.length + input.reversals.length + input.endedMeasures.length > 0;

/** Whether a correction that lifts these leaves nothing of its decision in force: then it reverses the decision, else part of it. */
function reversesAll(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): boolean {
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const inForce = (decision?.actions ?? []).filter((action) => liftsOneByOne(action) && action.inForce);
  return inForce.every((action) => holds(draft, reversalOf(action)));
}

/**
 * The statement as its author will receive it, from the draft: the data statementParagraphs renders for the preview. What
 * only the database knows when the decision is recorded (a seal's list, whether a measure changes anything) is the
 * page's reading of the case as it showed it. It throws for a post case without a snapshot the page can show
 * (previewable says so first).
 */
export function previewOf(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, now: Date, viewedImages: readonly string[] = []): StatementInput {
  const text = (kind: DraftTextKind): string | null => (normalised(draft.written[kind]) === "" ? null : normalised(draft.written[kind]));
  // 3d Task 6: what found the items, and whether this person opened the image, as the statement will say (W.3).
  const base = { redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION, decidedAt: now.toISOString(), post: postOf(view), ...automationOf(view, draft, viewedImages) };
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review") {
    const corrected = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
    if (!corrected || (corrected.kind !== "interim" && corrected.kind !== "final")) throw new Error("a correction's or a review's draft names a decision of the case that restricts");
    return {
      ...base,
      kind: draft.kind,
      outcome: draft.kind === "review" ? reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft) : draft.answer === "kept" ? "kept" : reversesAll(view, draft) ? "reversed" : "partly_reversed",
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      rulesVersion: corrected.rulesVersion,
      legalReference: null,
      facts: null,
      reason: text("review_reason"),
      source: corrected.source,
      measures: [],
      // 3e: a full reversal also overrules the decision's strike, as the params will carry it.
      reversals: [...draft.actions, ...overruleOf(corrected, draft.kind === "review" ? reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft) === "reversed" : reversesAll(view, draft))].map((reversal) => {
        const lifted = corrected.actions.find((action) => liftsOneByOne(action) && sameAction(reversalOf(action), reversal));
        // 3e: the handle a retirement's reversal gives back, which the case answer names on the retirement's row.
        const handle = reversal.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: lifted?.handle ?? null } : {};
        // 3e Task 3: what a lift of a suspension lifts, and where its period stands now, which is the lift's time.
        const lift =
          reversal.kind === "lift_suspension" && lifted
            ? {
                liftedKind: lifted.kind === "terminate" ? ("terminate" as const) : ("suspend" as const),
                liftedDecidedAt: corrected.decidedAt,
                periodThen: periodNow(lifted),
                // Task 4: a withdrawal for another measure, and whether the person had replied to what it withdraws.
                replaced: draft.replaced === true,
                replyFiledAt: lifted.reply?.filedAt ?? null,
              }
            : {};
        // 3e Task 5: what a lift of a reporting measure lifts, and whether a restriction's days still ran.
        const reporting = reversal.kind === "lift_reporting" && lifted ? reportingLiftOf(corrected, lifted, now) : {};
        return { kind: reversal.kind as ReversalKind, mediaId: reversal.mediaId, ...(lifted ? resetFacts(view, corrected, lifted) : NO_RESET), ...handle, ...lift, ...reporting };
      }),
      endedMeasures: [],
      reviewed: {
        kind: corrected.kind,
        ground: corrected.ground,
        ruleId: corrected.ruleId,
        rulesVersion: corrected.rulesVersion,
        legalReference: corrected.legalReference,
        decidedAt: corrected.decidedAt,
        // 3e's review (people1): the basis of the corrected decision's suspension or termination, as the API's statement carries it.
        basis: corrected.actions.find((action) => action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate")?.basis ?? null,
      },
      // Task 4: what an answer to the reply fixes, as far as the page can tell now.
      ...(draft.kind === "correction" ? { repliedTo: repliedToPreview(corrected, draft, now) } : {}),
    };
  }
  const restricts = draft.outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  const reach = view.suspicion?.reach ?? { posts: 0, images: 0 };
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that holds a measure. Those of a decision without one are the
  // case's record, for staff: the statement's data holds neither, here as in the API's own reading of the decision.
  const told = draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  return {
    ...base,
    kind: draft.kind,
    outcome: draft.outcome,
    ground: restricts ? draft.ground : null,
    ruleId: restricts && !law ? draft.ruleId : null,
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    legalReference: law ? text("legal_reference") : null,
    facts: told ? text("facts") : null,
    reason: told ? text("reason") : null,
    source: predictedSource(view, draft.kind),
    measures: draft.actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => {
        const noEffect = noEffectOf(view, action, draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim");
        // 3e Task 4: an announced suspension or termination, or a termination at once.
        if ((action.kind === "suspend" && action.announced === true) || action.kind === "terminate") return previewStanding(view, action, noEffect, now);
        // 3e Task 3: a suspension at once, with its basis, its end and the decision it rests on, as the database will fix them.
        if (action.kind === "suspend") return previewSuspension(view, draft, action, noEffect, now);
        // 3e Task 5: a warning about reporting or a restriction of it, with its end and the warning a restriction follows.
        if (action.kind === "warn_reporting" || action.kind === "restrict_reporting") return previewReporting(view, action, noEffect, now);
        const measure = { kind: action.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect, sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: reach.posts, images: reach.images, deletedImages: 0 } : null };
        // 3e: a retirement names the snapshot's handle, and the placeholder's form when it changes the profile.
        if (action.kind !== "retire_handle") return measure;
        return { ...measure, handle: snapshotHandle(view) ?? (view.target.type === "account" ? (view.target.handle?.toLowerCase() ?? null) : null), placeholder: noEffect === null ? PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER : null };
      })
      // 3e: the strike the params will carry, until when it counts (decided now) and the strikes that count with it.
      .concat(
        strikeOf(view, draft).map(() => ({
          kind: "strike" as MeasureKind,
          mediaId: null,
          noEffect: null,
          sealed: null,
          endsAt: new Date(now.getTime() + STANDING_RULES.strikeDays * DAY_MS).toISOString(),
          activeThen: ACTIVE_THEN[view.authorStanding?.activeStrikes ?? "0"],
        })),
      ),
    reversals: draft.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null).map((action) => ({ kind: action.kind as ReversalKind, mediaId: action.mediaId, ...NO_RESET })),
    endedMeasures: endedBy(view, draft),
    reviewed: null,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the params and the confirmation

/** The digest of a snapshot, computed here from the members the page displayed: never the digest the answer carried. */
/** The digest a decision signs: of what the page showed, or, for a copy withheld while its post is preserved for an order, the stored one. */
export function signedSnapshotDigest(snapshot: CaseSnapshot): Promise<string> {
  return snapshot.withheld ? Promise.resolve(snapshot.digest) : shownSnapshotDigest(snapshot);
}

export function shownSnapshotDigest(snapshot: Extract<CaseSnapshot, { withheld: false }>): Promise<string> {
  return snapshotDigest({
    salt: snapshot.salt,
    targetType: snapshot.targetType,
    targetId: snapshot.targetId,
    takenAt: snapshot.takenAt,
    authorHandle: snapshot.authorHandle,
    postState: snapshot.postState,
    postCreatedAt: snapshot.postCreatedAt,
    replyToId: snapshot.replyToId,
    quoteOfId: snapshot.quoteOfId,
    body: snapshot.body,
    media: snapshot.media,
    displayName: snapshot.displayName,
    bio: snapshot.bio,
    handle: snapshot.handle,
  });
}

/** The digests a decision's params carry: the shown snapshot's, and those of the texts the console saved. */
export interface DecisionDigests {
  snapshot: string;
  facts: string | null;
  reason: string | null;
  legalReference: string | null;
}

/**
 * The params the key confirms, built from what the page shows (3c design, section 7.5, step 1): the case's version, the
 * range a final decision answers, the newest snapshot by its id with the digest the console computed, the digests of the
 * saved texts and the actions in their one order. The contracts' schema refuses what cannot stand before any key is asked.
 */
export function decisionParamsOf(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, digests: DecisionDigests): CaseDecidedParams {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  if (!newest) throw new Error("a decision names a snapshot of its case: the case holds none");
  const corrected = draft.kind === "correction" ? view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId) : undefined;
  if (draft.kind === "correction" && !corrected) throw new Error("a correction's draft names a decision of the case");
  // 3e: the strike the case answer says is due, and the overruling of a full correction, are the console's to add: the
  // person never chooses either. A kept answer to a reply, and a kept correction that withdraws a decision's marks, lift
  // nothing and overrule nothing. Task 5: a final "No breach" decision signs the marks its person ticked on the items it
  // answers; any other signs none, and a withdrawal of marks signs no list either (the database withdraws them all).
  const kept = draft.answer === "kept" || draft.withdrawMarks === true;
  const added = draft.kind === "correction" ? (kept ? [] : overruleOf(corrected, reversesAll(view, draft))) : strikeOf(view, draft);
  const actions = [...draft.actions, ...added].sort(compareDecisionActions);
  const unfounded = draft.kind === "correction" ? [] : marksOf(view, draft);
  const shared = { stateVersion: view.stateVersion, snapshotId: newest.id, snapshotDigest: digests.snapshot, redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION, actions, unfounded, replaced: draft.kind === "correction" && draft.replaced === true };
  if (draft.kind === "correction" && corrected) {
    return CaseDecidedParams.parse({
      ...shared,
      kind: "correction",
      throughSeq: 0,
      reviewsDecisionId: corrected.id,
      outcome: kept ? "kept" : reversesAll(view, draft) ? "reversed" : "partly_reversed",
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      // A correction carries the rulebook version and the category of the decision it corrects.
      rulesVersion: corrected.rulesVersion,
      category: corrected.category,
      categoryKeyword: null,
      factsDigest: null,
      reasonDigest: digests.reason,
      legalReferenceDigest: null,
    });
  }
  const restricts = draft.outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  return CaseDecidedParams.parse({
    ...shared,
    kind: draft.kind,
    throughSeq: draft.kind === "final" ? throughSeqOf(view) : 0,
    reviewsDecisionId: null,
    outcome: draft.outcome,
    ground: restricts ? draft.ground : null,
    ruleId: restricts && !law ? draft.ruleId : null,
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    category: draft.category,
    categoryKeyword: law && draft.terrorist ? "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" : null,
    // A restriction carries both; a decision without a measure carries each when it was written.
    factsDigest: digests.facts,
    reasonDigest: digests.reason,
    legalReferenceDigest: law ? digests.legalReference : null,
    // 3d Task 7: the reason of an answer without a seal on an acting match, signed only where it is asked for, so every
    // other decision's params hash as before.
    ...(answerReasonNeeded(view, draft) ? { matchAnswerReason: draft.matchAnswerReason ?? null } : {}),
  });
}

/** The texts whose fields a draft's decision has on the page, in the order they are saved. */
export function textsOffered(draft: CaseDraft): DraftTextKind[] {
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review") return ["review_reason"];
  return draft.outcome === "restricted" && draft.ground === "illegal" ? ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference"] : ["facts", "reason"];
}

/**
 * The texts a draft's decision cannot do without. A restriction needs its facts and its reason, and on the law its legal
 * reference; a correction its reason. A decision without a measure may leave both of its texts empty, except an answer to
 * a report or finding of child sexual abuse material: an admin decides it without seeing the images, and says in the
 * facts what the answer rested on.
 */
export function textsRequired(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): DraftTextKind[] {
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review" || draft.outcome === "restricted") return textsOffered(draft);
  return suspectOpen(view).length > 0 ? ["facts"] : [];
}

/** Whether a draft holds what its decision needs before anything is sent: something to do, and each text it cannot do without. */
export function complete(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): boolean {
  if (textsRequired(view, draft).some((kind) => normalised(draft.written[kind]) === "")) return false;
  // 3e: a kept answer to a reply lifts nothing; every other correction lifts something.
  if (draft.kind === "correction") return draft.answer === "kept" ? draft.actions.length === 0 : draft.actions.length > 0;
  if (draft.kind === "review") return reviewConsistent(view, draft);
  return draft.outcome !== "restricted" || draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
}

/** What saving one text of a draft came to: the saved text, the console's words for a refusal with its code, or null when there was nothing to save. */
export type TextSaveOutcome = { saved: SavedText } | { error: string; code: string } | null;

/**
 * Saves one text of a draft, without the key (3c design, section 7.4): when its field loses focus, and again at Confirm
 * for a text that is not saved yet. Nothing is sent for an empty text, or for one whose normalised form is the one saved
 * already. A refusal comes back in the console's words; nothing is thrown, and the draft is not touched: what was
 * written stays with the caller, which saves it again at the next occasion.
 */
export async function saveDraftText(deps: { api: StaffApi; random?: RandomBytes }, caseId: CaseId, draft: CaseDraft, kind: DraftTextKind): Promise<TextSaveOutcome> {
  const text = normalised(draft.written[kind]);
  if (text === "" || draft.texts[kind]?.text === text) return null;
  try {
    const saved = await saveStaffText(deps, caseId, kind, draft.written[kind]);
    return { saved: { id: saved.id, text: saved.text, salt: saved.salt, digest: saved.digest } };
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS), code: codeOf(err) ?? "internal" };
  }
}

/** The codes after which the case, or its snapshot, is no longer what the page shows: the refusal's words say to read or to take a snapshot again. */
const STALE_CODES: readonly string[] = ["case_changed", "profile_changed", "snapshot_erased", "snapshot_mismatch"];

/**
 * What the page does about a refused confirmation, beside wording it in place with the draft kept: it reads the case
 * again when the refusal says that the case or its snapshot changed, so that "take a fresh snapshot and decide again" can
 * be followed on the spot; and it forgets which texts it saved when one of them is gone or was used, so that the next
 * Confirm saves them again.
 */
export function afterRefusal(code: string): { readAgain: boolean; saveAgain: boolean } {
  return { readAgain: STALE_CODES.includes(code), saveAgain: code === "text_not_found" };
}

/**
 * The page's words after a decision was recorded: on a final decision, which reports the range left open for later, and
 * how many items arrived since the page read the case, which stay open too.
 */
export function decidedNotice(before: CaseView, now: CaseView, wasFinal: boolean): string {
  const words: string[] = [COMPOSER.recorded];
  if (!wasFinal) return words.join(" ");
  const left = leftOpen(before).length;
  const open = now.items.filter((item) => item.outcome === null).length;
  if (left > 0) words.push(COMPOSER.leftForLater(left));
  if (open > left) words.push(COMPOSER.arrivedSince(open - left));
  // The page showed a decision that closes the case and ends what was done while deciding; an item that arrived meanwhile
  // kept the case open, and with it those measures.
  const staying = left === 0 && open > 0 && now.closedAt === null ? interimInForce(now).map(({ action }) => MEASURES[action.kind].label) : [];
  if (staying.length > 0) words.push(COMPOSER.interimStays(staying.join(", ")));
  return words.join(" ");
}

/** What a confirmation needs of the page that runs it: whether it is still open, what it shows and holds now, the saves of texts on their way, and its busy flag. */
export interface ConfirmingPage {
  alive(): boolean;
  /** The case the page shows, or null when it shows none (a read failed for good). */
  shown(): CaseView | null;
  draft(): CaseDraft | null;
  saving(): readonly Promise<unknown>[];
  setBusy(busy: boolean): void;
}

/**
 * One confirmation with the page's busy flag around it. The flag goes up before anything is awaited and comes down on
 * every way out while the page is still open: when `run` has ended, when it threw, and when the page shows no case or
 * holds no draft any more after the wait, so that the composer is never left switched off. The click that confirms also
 * takes the focus from a text's field: that save ends first, so that its text is not saved twice, and `run` gets the
 * case and the draft as they stand after it.
 */
export async function confirmWhileBusy(page: ConfirmingPage, run: (view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  if (page.shown() === null || page.draft() === null) return;
  page.setBusy(true);
  try {
    await Promise.allSettled(page.saving());
    const [view, draft] = [page.shown(), page.draft()];
    if (!page.alive() || view === null || draft === null) return;
    await run(view, draft);
  } finally {
    if (page.alive()) page.setBusy(false);
  }
}

/**
 * What "Confirm with your staff key" comes to: the case as it now stands; or a fresh snapshot that the page must show
 * before anything is confirmed; or the console's words for the step that failed, with its code, the draft kept.
 */
export type ConfirmOutcome = { view: CaseView } | { fresh: CaseView; notice: string } | { error: string; code: string };

/**
 * The decision as the page runs it (3c design, section 7.5, step 1). `caseId` is the case of the page's address: the
 * texts are saved on it and the key confirms a decision on it, never on whatever case an answer named. In this order:
 *   1. a view of another case than the page's, or a draft that lacks a measure or a text it needs, is not sent at all;
 *   2. when the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown (withheld, erased, or none), a fresh one is taken and the case
 *      read again, and nothing is confirmed: the page shows it first, so no decision names a snapshot nobody was shown;
 *   3. each text that is written is saved, without the key, unless the same text was saved before (when its field lost
 *      focus, or at an earlier try); the digest is the one computed here (saveStaffText refuses an answer that carries
 *      another), and `remember` is told of each save;
 *   4. the snapshot's digest is computed from what the page displayed;
 *   5. the params are built and checked, and the key confirms exactly them; the answer is the case as it now stands. A
 *      review is confirmed as its own action, on the decision whose appeal it answers.
 * Nothing is thrown: a refusal comes back as the console's words for its code.
 */
export async function confirmDecision(
  // 3f Task 6: `gap`, the restore gap a decision takes again after a restore, which the decide or review route closes.
  deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; random?: RandomBytes; gap?: string | null },
  caseId: CaseId,
  view: CaseView,
  draft: CaseDraft,
  remember: (kind: DraftTextKind, saved: SavedText) => void = () => undefined,
): Promise<ConfirmOutcome> {
  const refusal = (err: unknown): ConfirmOutcome => ({ error: describeError(err), code: codeOf(err) ?? "internal" });
  if (view.id !== caseId) return { error: messageFor("invalid_answer"), code: "invalid_answer" };
  if (!complete(view, draft)) return { error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" };
  // 3d Task 7 (8.4): an answer without a seal on an acting match is refused before the key without its reason.
  if (answerReasonNeeded(view, draft) && (draft.matchAnswerReason ?? null) === null) return { error: AUTOMATION_WORDS.answerReason.choose, code: "incomplete" };

  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  // 3f (design, section 8.6): on a post preserved for an order every copy is withheld from staff, a fresh one too; the
  // decision then signs the newest copy's stored digest, which the database compares as it always does.
  if (!newest || (newest.withheld && !view.preserved)) {
    try {
      await deps.api.takeSnapshot(caseId, { activity: true });
      return { fresh: await deps.api.caseView(caseId, { activity: true }), notice: COMPOSER.freshSnapshot };
    } catch (err) {
      return refusal(err);
    }
  }

  const digests: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>> = {};
  for (const kind of textsOffered(draft)) {
    const outcome = await saveDraftText(deps, caseId, draft, kind);
    if (outcome !== null && "error" in outcome) return outcome;
    if (outcome !== null) remember(kind, outcome.saved);
    // Saved just now, saved before, or left empty: an empty text has no digest.
    const digest = outcome?.saved.digest ?? (normalised(draft.written[kind]) === "" ? undefined : draft.texts[kind]?.digest);
    if (digest !== undefined) digests[kind] = digest;
  }

  if (draft.kind === "review") {
    // A review is confirmed as the action of its own: on the decision it reviews, with its appeal among the params.
    let reviewed: AppealsReviewedParams;
    try {
      reviewed = reviewParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: await signedSnapshotDigest(newest), reason: digests.review_reason ?? null });
    } catch {
      return { error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" };
    }
    try {
      return { view: await reviewWithKey(deps, caseId, draft.reviewsDecisionId ?? "", reviewed, deps.gap ?? null) };
    } catch (err) {
      return refusal(err);
    }
  }

  let params: CaseDecidedParams;
  try {
    params = decisionParamsOf(view, draft, {
      snapshot: await signedSnapshotDigest(newest),
      facts: digests.facts ?? null,
      reason: draft.kind === "correction" ? (digests.review_reason ?? null) : (digests.reason ?? null),
      legalReference: digests.legal_reference ?? null,
    });
  } catch {
    return { error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" };
  }
  try {
    return { view: await decideWithKey(deps, caseId, params, deps.gap ?? null) };
  } catch (err) {
    return refusal(err);
  }
}

    /** [lists.finding] */
    finding: "Opening the case is a finding of your own, so you cannot review an appeal in it.",
    openCase: "Open a case on this account",
    reportingTitle: "Reporting records",
    reportingRow: (handle: string, unfounded: number, reports: number) => `@${handle}: ${unfounded} of the ${reports} rule reports sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days hold a mark manifestly unfounded.`,
    /** Task 5: after a reporting record's row, whether the account is at the warning's threshold or was warned. */
    reportingThreshold: "At the warning threshold.",
    reportingWarned: (warnedOn: string, marksSince: number) => `Warned on ${warnedOn}; ${marksSince} of the reports sent since then are marked.`,
    noticesTitle: "Notices not sent",
    noticesRow: (handle: string, decidedOn: string, startsAt: string) =>
      `@${handle}: korbat's mail service could not send the notice of ${decidedOn}: it refused the address, or the mail was given up after ${RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays} days. Only the app carries the notice, so it starts on ${startsAt}, ${STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours} hours after the decision.`,
    terminationsTitle: "Terminations waiting",
    terminatedOn: (handle: string, decidedOn: string) => `@${handle}: terminated on ${decidedOn}.`,
    finalOn: (finalOn: string) => `Final on ${finalOn}; the account is deleted in the first round after that.`,
    appealHolds: "An appeal is pending: nothing is deleted before it is answered.",
    replyHoldsStart: "A reply is unanswered: it has not started.",
    replyHolds: "A reply is unanswered: nothing is deleted before it is answered.",
    empty: "None.",
    more: (total: number, shown: number) => `${total - shown} more not listed here.`,
  },
  /** 8.8: the home screen's two lines. */
  home: {
    replies: (n: number, age: string) =>
      `Replies waiting: ${n}, the oldest for ${age}. A held suspension does not start until its reply is answered, and a terminated account is not deleted before its reply is.`,
    strikes: (n: number) => `Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: ${n}.`,
  },
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 5 (design, sections 8.3, 8.4 and 8.7)
  /** 8.3: the warning about reporting and the restriction of it. Both cite R6; the composer sets it. */
  reporting: {
    warnLabel: "Warn about reporting",
    restrictLabel: "Restrict reporting",
    /** Beside both controls. */
    rule: "Both measures cite R6; the composer sets it.",
    /** [warn.what], with the account's counts as this page read them. */
    warnWhat: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `A warning restricts nothing. It tells the account that ${unfounded} of the ${reports} reports it sent under the rules in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days were marked manifestly unfounded, lists them, and says that ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports among those it sends after the warning may lead to a restriction. A report counts once, however many of its items were marked, and by the day it was sent. A notice of illegal content is never counted.`,
    /** [warn.short] */
    warnShort: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `Not open: a warning needs at least ${STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks} marked reports among those the account sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days, and they must be at least half of its rule reports sent in that time. This account has ${unfounded} of ${reports}. One report never reaches the number alone.`,
    /** [warn.standing] */
    warnStanding: (warnedOn: string) => `Not open: the warning of ${warnedOn} still counts.`,
    /** [restrict.what], with the days chosen. */
    restrictWhat: (days: number) =>
      `This stops the account's reports under korbat's rules for ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, from the moment you confirm; the warning was its notice, and the restriction ends with it if the warning is lifted. At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days. Notices of illegal content, reports of child sexual abuse material and requests for re-examination stay open to it.`,
    /** [restrict.noWarning] */
    restrictNoWarning: "Not open: the account has no warning that still counts. Warn first.",
    /** [restrict.short] */
    restrictShort: (marksSince: number, warnedOn: string) => `Not open: ${marksSince} of the reports the account sent since the warning of ${warnedOn} were marked; a restriction needs ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks}.`,
    /** [restrict.running] */
    restrictRunning: (restrictedUntil: string) => `Not open: a restriction runs until ${restrictedUntil}.`,
    /** How many days, at most the restriction's own number. */
    daysLabel: `Days (1 to ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays})`,
    /** 8.7: the reversal of each reporting measure, named by what it lifts. */
    liftWarning: "Lift the warning about reporting",
    liftRestriction: "Lift the restriction of reporting",
  },
  /** 8.4: the mark "manifestly unfounded" beside the items a "No breach" decision answers, and its withdrawal. */
  mark: {
    /** [mark.label] */
    label: "Manifestly unfounded",
    /** [mark.rule] */
    rule: `Tick only a report that anyone could see was unfounded without weighing it: it names nothing the rule could cover. A report you had to think about is not manifestly unfounded, also when you found no breach. Your key signs the mark. What counts toward a warning about reporting is the report, once, for ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days from the day it was sent, however many of its items are ticked. The person who sent it sees the mark on their own list of reports once this answer is released to them, and can ask for a re-examination.`,
    /** [mark.never], once, when an item the decision answers cannot be marked. */
    never: "Only a signed-in person's report under a rule can be marked: never a notice of illegal content, a report on the path for child sexual abuse material, or a report sent without an account.",
    /** [mark.undone] */
    undone: "A mark stops counting when a re-examination of its report ends in a restriction, and when a correction of the decision that set it withdraws it.",
    /** [mark.withdraw]: the control, and what it does. */
    withdrawLabel: "Withdraw this decision's marks",
    withdrawWhat:
      "Use this when the reports were arguable after all: it was wrong to call them manifestly unfounded, also if no rule was broken. All marks this decision set are withdrawn together. The outcome of each report stays. The marks stop counting when you confirm, so a warning lifted because its marks were wrong cannot be given again on them.",
    /** On the case page, beside an item whose mark stands and one whose mark was withdrawn (CaseItem.markWithdrawn). */
    marked: "Marked manifestly unfounded",
    withdrawn: "Mark withdrawn",
    /** In place of the preview: the withdrawal sends the author nothing. */
    noStatement: "No statement is sent: withdrawing marks changes nothing for the author of what was reported, and the people who reported see it on their own lists.",
    /** The fieldset's legend. */
    legend: "Reports this decision answers",
  },
  /** 8.7: [review.warning], when a restriction of reporting rests on the reviewed decision's warning. */
  reviewWarning: "A restriction of this account's reports rests on this warning. If you lift the warning, the restriction ends when you confirm, and this decision's statement says so.",
  /** 8.5: [appeals.order] */
  appealsOrder: "Appeals of a running suspension or of a termination come first.",
  /** 8.5: the mark of an appeal listed first. */
  appealsFirst: "a running suspension or a termination",
} as const;

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
  // 3f (design, section 8.9): a message at the contact point that someone else closed meanwhile; and the refusals of
  // Task 2's order routes.
  "message_handled",
  "order_needs_message",
  "order_exists",
  "order_closed",
  "order_event_refused",
  "already_released",
  // 3f Task 3 (design, sections 8.5 and 8.9): the refusals of giving effect to an order.
  "order_changed",
  "order_not_verified",
  "order_cap",
  // 3f Task 6 (design, sections 8.7 to 8.9): a gap that is closed or that a decision does not fit, and a copy mark the
  // database did not take.
  "gap_mismatch",
  "copy_mismatch",
  // 3d Task 2 (design, section 8.8): the release's refusals and its check at commit.
  "release_not_open",
  "release_not_reported",
  "release_not_quarantined",
  "release_preserved",
  "release_no_leave",
  "release_period_unset",
  "release_period_running",
  "release_mismatch",
  // 3d Task 7 (design, section 8.8): an end of a hold its state does not allow or without its reason, and an image that a
  // match names, which staff are never served.
  "hold_not_open",
  "invalid_hold_end",
  "image_matched",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** 3f Task 6 [copy.broken] (8.7): a download that broke off, whose mark the database refused or the console never sent. */
const COPY_BROKEN = "The download broke off, or its lines do not continue each other. Nothing was recorded as copied: press again.";

/** 3f [open.duplicate]: an order of this state, authority and reference is recorded already (order_exists). */
const OPEN_DUPLICATE =
  "An order of this authority with this reference is already recorded. If that record is wrong, correct it on its screen; if it is closed, an admin reopens it there. Do not open the order a second time under a changed reference.";

/** 3d Task 7 [case.image.matched] (8.4): in the place of an image that an unerased match record names, with no reveal control. */
const IMAGE_MATCHED = "Not opened: this image matched a list of known material. Nobody at korbat opens it, also after an answer without a seal.";

/** A small number as a word, as the design's sentences write it; a larger one in digits. */
const inWords = (n: number): string => ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"][n] ?? String(n);

/** A removal order's hour (ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes) in the words the console's sentences use. */
const HOUR_WORDS = ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes === 60 ? "one hour" : `${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes`;
/** The last choice of the form "Open an order" (Task 2), which every sentence that sends a person there names. */
const NOT_LISTED = '"The message is not listed"';

 * 3f (design, sections 8.2, 8.3 and 18): the console's sentences of authorities' orders, each under the design's key

 * every time is the database's instant, printed by bothTimes. Later tasks of 3f add their keys here.
 */

/**
 * 3d (design, sections 8.1, 8.2 and 8.4): the words of sealed files and their custody, the quarantine, the release and
 * held uploads, each under its key. Every number is printed from the answer or from a constant (QUARANTINE_RULES), never
 * typed; every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. Task 1 has the quarantine's.
 */
export const CUSTODY_WORDS = {
  /** The home screen's block below "Authorities", each line only while it applies. */
  homeTitle: "Sealed files and programs",
  /** [home.quarantine], while a move into the quarantine or back is due. */
  homeQuarantine: (dueIn: number, dueOut: number, oldest: string) =>
    `Files to move or return: ${dueIn} images to move into the quarantine, ${dueOut} to return to the image store, the oldest due since ${oldest}. Whoever has the server runs the README's steps under Quarantine (staff.js quarantine-list). Until then a sealed image's files are still in the image store, and an image whose seal was lifted is not shown.`,
  /** Its addition once the oldest due move is older than the alert's threshold. */
  homeQuarantineLate: `More than ${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours} hours: every staff account is alerted daily until the move is recorded.`,
  /** [case.custody.in], on a seal for good in force. */
  custodyIn: (moved: number, files: number, movedAt: string | null) => (moved > 0 && movedAt !== null ? `Files: ${moved} of ${files} are in the quarantine, since ${movedAt}.` : "Files: not moved to the quarantine yet."),
  custodyInRest: "The others are still in the image store until whoever has the server moves them (the README, Quarantine).",
  /** [case.custody.return], while files of a lifted seal are still in the quarantine. */
  custodyReturn: (toReturn: number) =>
    `Files to return: the seal was lifted and ${toReturn} files of its images are still in the quarantine. The images are shown again once whoever has the server has returned them (the README, Quarantine).`,
  /** [case.custody.lost], under a seal for good in force, and after a lifted seal. */
  custodyLost: (lost: number, inForce: boolean) =>
    inForce
      ? `Files lost: ${lost}. They were found in neither the image store nor the quarantine and are recorded as lost; there is nothing to move, hand over or destroy for them.`
      : `Files lost: ${lost}. Their images cannot be shown again; their author was told so.`,
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 8.2 and 8.6): Held uploads. No sentence names a handle, an image, a hash or a file's name;
   * the two ends are worded as what each does, neither is preselected and no sentence says which to take (rule 4 of
   * section 8). Every number is printed from the answer or from AUTOMATION_RULES and ORDER_RULES.
   */
  uploads: {
    title: "Held uploads",
    /** [uploads.what]. */
    what: "An upload was not accepted because its source reports its fingerprint as an exact match with an entry that the source classifies as child sexual abuse material. It is on no post, nothing serves it, no data export holds it, and nobody at korbat opens it: this screen shows no image. It is held, with no end by a timer, until an admin ends the hold one of the two ways below.",
    empty: "No upload is held, and none was released or ended in the last 30 days.",
    more: "Show more",
    refusedAt: (at: string) => `Refused at ${at}`,
    /** [uploads.others]: counted over the refusals whose hold has not ended or ended as "Report". */
    others: (n: number) => `Other held uploads of the same uploader: ${n}.`,
    /** [uploads.gone], while the uploader's account no longer exists. */
    gone: `The uploader's account no longer exists. A report can carry the file's facts and times, and the account's address only while korbat still holds it for a report: up to ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days from the refusal, as after a seal. After that a report can carry the file's facts and times alone.`,
    objection: { lead: (at: string) => `The uploader objected on ${at}:`, by: "Written by the uploader" },
    /** [uploads.unseen], above the two controls, which stand side by side with the same weight. */
    unseen:
      "You decide without seeing the image, and this screen does not tell you which way. What you have is the record above: the source, the kind of match, the time, what the uploader wrote, and how many other uploads of the same uploader are held. Whether a match obliges korbat to report is a question of law that this screen does not answer: read the README's section A held upload, which holds what counsel has advised korbat, decide with whoever has the server, and write your ground into the operator's notes.",
    /** The two ends, each its label and [uploads.report] or [uploads.noReport]. */
    report: {
      label: "Report",
      what: 'The upload stays held and its files move to the quarantine, kept for the authority alone. Whoever has the server opens the record of the report (staff.js upload-report) and reports. The uploader reads on the notice that korbat reports the file. The hold then ends by a release on a recorded leave to destroy, or by "No report" later, with a reason.',
    },
    noReport: {
      label: "No report",
      what: `The hold ends. korbat deletes the upload ${AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours} hours from now; until then an admin can still end it as "Report" instead. Every staff account is mailed now that a hold ended without a report; the uploader is told that the hold was lifted only once the upload is deleted.`,
      reason: "The reason",
    },
    /** The choice before the key: which end, and for "No report" which reason. Nothing is chosen when the page loads. */
    choose: "Choose one of the two ends.",
    chooseReason: 'Choose the reason of "No report".',
    sign: 'You confirm with your staff key: this upload, the end you chose and, for "No report", its reason.',
    confirm: "Confirm with your staff key",
    adminOnly: "Only an admin can end a hold or release a held upload.",
    /** The state lines. */
    state: {
      open: "Held, waiting for an admin.",
      report: (endedAt: string, reported: boolean, quarantined: boolean) =>
        `Held for a report since ${endedAt}. Report recorded: ${reported ? "yes" : "no"}. Files in the quarantine: ${quarantined ? "yes" : "no"}.`,
      noReport: (endedAt: string, reason: string, deletesAt: string) => `Hold ended at ${endedAt}: ${reason}. The upload is deleted after ${deletesAt}; until then it can still be ended as "Report".`,
      released: (releasedAt: string) => `Released at ${releasedAt}. Home counts the released files that are left to destroy.`,
    },
    /** The release block of a held upload: 8.5's, with "this upload" in place of "this seal, its posts". */
    releaseSign: "You confirm with your staff key: this upload, the ground, and the leave with its reference as shown above.",
    releaseDone: (releasedAt: string, held: boolean, backupsClearAt: string) =>
      `Released at ${releasedAt}. Its files are in the quarantine until whoever has the server destroys them (the README, Quarantine), and every staff account is alerted daily while one is still recorded there. The uploader's notice: ${held ? "held until the person may be told" : "sent at once"}. No backup that is deleted on time holds these files after ${backupsClearAt}; a backup kept for an authority is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups).`,
  },
  /** [home.uploads] (8.2): a link to Held uploads; `oldest` printed by the screen. */
  homeUploads: (open: number, oldest: string | null, objected: number) =>
    `Held uploads: ${open} matched uploads wait for an admin${oldest === null ? "" : `, the oldest since ${oldest}`}; ${objected} uploaders objected and have no answer.`,
  homeUploadsCapped: (capped: number) =>
    `${capped} uploads matched over the limit of refusals an hour and are neither refused nor accepted: the operator looks at the comparison first (the alert says so).`,
  homeUploadsLink: "Open Held uploads",
  /** [home.released] (8.2) for a held upload: one line a release, newest first. */
  homeReleasedUpload: (at: string) => `Released in the last 30 days, each by an admin's key: ${at}, a held upload.`,
  /** [home.unreported] (8.2): one line an end, newest first. */
  homeUnreported: (at: string) => `Holds ended without a report in the last 30 days, each by an admin's key: ${at}.`,

/**
 * 3d (design, sections 8 and 8.4): the console's words of what a program does and of the edge's purge, each under the
 * design's key. Task 3 brings the four lines of the edge's purge; every number is EDGE_WORDS', never typed, and the time
 * is the answer's, printed by the screen with bothTimes.
 */
export const AUTOMATION_WORDS = {
  /**
   * [case.purge.accepted], [case.purge.failed], [case.purge.off] and [case.purge.pending]: beside each image of a case
   * that stopped being public, and for each image of an order's disabled item, from the newest outbox row's outcome.
   */
  purge: (outcome: EdgePurgeView["outcome"], at: string): string => {
    switch (outcome) {
      case "accepted":
        return `Edge copy: purge accepted at ${at}.`;
      case "failed":
        return `Edge copy: purge failed. A copy may have been served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes after the measure; the operator is alerted.`;
      case "off":
        return `Edge copy: no purge (off): a copy may be served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes.`;
      case "pending":
        return "Edge copy: purge not sent yet.";
    }
  },
  /**
   * Task 6 (8.3): the queue's three chips, [queue.found], [queue.taken] and [queue.objected]. Only the last moves a case:
   * the API sorts it first inside its lane.
   */
  queue: { found: "Found by a program", taken: "Taken by a program", objected: "The author asked for a person" },
  /** Task 6 (8.4): the chip in the place of a staff handle, on a decision without a decider and on Home's lists. */
  byProgram: "Taken by a program",
  /** Task 6: a program's finding as the case's history names its item. */
  historyItem: "a program's finding",
  /** [home.automated] (8.2): the measures of a program in force, which wait for a person; `oldestAt` printed by the screen. */
  homeAutomated: (waiting: number, oldestAt: string) =>
    `Measures a program took, waiting for a person: ${waiting}, the oldest since ${oldestAt}. A moderator decides a hidden image; an admin answers sealed images.`,
  /** [home.objected] (8.2): the cases whose author asked for a person; the target is the contracts' constant. */
  homeObjected: (objected: number, oldestObjectionAt: string) =>
    `The author asked for a person: ${objected} ${objected === 1 ? "case" : "cases"}, the oldest request of ${oldestObjectionAt}. korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours.`,
  /** [case.r1] (8.4), on an item a score opened: the threshold's version and never the score, which would read as a verdict. */
  caseR1: (thresholdVersion: number) =>
    `A program rated this image as likely within rule R1: over the threshold (version ${thresholdVersion}). That is a reason to look, not a finding. Look at the image and decide as for any report. The statement will say that a moderator looked at the image only if you opened it on this case before you decided; otherwise it says that you decided without opening it.`,
  /** [case.auto] (8.4), on a decision without a decider, before the statement's preview its author was sent. */
  caseAuto: (decidedAt: string, measure: string) =>
    `A program took this measure at ${decidedAt}, with no person involved: ${measure}. It lasts until a person decides this case. Its author was told at once, with these words:`,
  /** [case.autoR1] (8.4), for a program's withhold of an image. */
  caseAutoR1: 'Any moderator may lift it now ("Lift what was done while deciding", with your reason), or decide the case. A final decision ends it either way.',
  /** [case.autoRecord] (8.4), beside "Decide the case" while an unanswered item of the case is a program's finding. */
  caseAutoRecord: "Your decision is recorded as found by automated means.",
  /** [case.objection] (8.4), at the top of the case while its measure is in force: the lead, the frame's label, the end. */
  objection: {
    lead: (createdAt: string) => `The author asked for a person on ${createdAt}:`,
    by: "Written by the author",
    tail: `korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours. Lift the measure or decide the case; either way the author gets that decision's statement, and nothing else answers this.`,
  },
  /** 3d Task 7 [queue.matchFlag] (8.3): a match that only flags; it moves nothing. */
  queueMatchFlag: "A match that only flags",
  /** [home.flags] (8.2). */
  homeFlags: (flags: number) =>
    `Matches that only flag: ${flags} open cases hold one, a match with an entry that its source does not class as child sexual abuse material. Each stands in the queue where its lane and age put it.`,
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 [case.match] (8.4): a match's record as a list of label and value. The source, the list version and the
   * classification are a source's strings, drawn framed under `frame`, never in a label's place (rule 3 of section 8).
   */
  match: {
    title: "The match's record",
    frame: "As the source returned it",
    source: "Source",
    listVersion: "List version",
    hashType: "Hash type",
    matchKind: "Kind of match, as the source reported it",
    classification: "Classification, as the source returned it",
    queriedAt: "Compared at",
    none: "not returned",
    /** [case.matchWeak]: under the record for a hash that can be made to collide on purpose, or a perceptual one. */
    weak: (hashType: "sha256" | "sha1" | "md5" | "pdq"): string | null =>
      hashType === "md5"
        ? "A file with the same MD5 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files."
        : hashType === "sha1"
          ? "A file with the same SHA-1 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files."
          : hashType === "pdq"
            ? "A perceptual hash describes how a picture looks. Two different pictures can have the same one, by accident or on purpose."
            : null,
    /** [case.matchActing]. */
    acting:
      "The source reports this as an exact match with an entry that it classifies as child sexual abuse material. That is the one kind of match on which korbat's program refuses an upload or, where the owner has switched that on, seals a post's images. It is the source's word about a fingerprint: nobody at korbat has checked it, and nobody can.",
    /** [case.matchNear]. */
    near: "The source reports this as a match with an entry that it classifies as child sexual abuse material, but it is not a match on which korbat's program acts: the source does not report it as exact (the kind of match is shown above), or the entry is outside the part of its list that korbat acts on. The program refused and sealed nothing on it, and the author was told nothing. It opened this finding under rule R2, so the post is frozen as after any such finding: korbat keeps its images, also against the author's deletion, until an admin has answered, and the urgent alert went out. A similar fingerprint can be made on purpose for a harmless image. Only an admin answers: seal for good, or answer without a seal, without seeing the images.",
    /** [case.matchFlag]. */
    flag: "This match is a flag and nothing more: the source does not class the entry as child sexual abuse material. The program refused, sealed and froze nothing and cited no rule, nobody was alerted, and the author was told nothing. Decide the case on what you can read: this record, the post's text and alt texts, and the account's conduct. If they give you a ground of your own, decide on that rule or the law; if they do not, decide that nothing breaks a rule, which answers the flag.",
    /** [case.matchWhat], under either. */
    what: "What a match shows: a file has the same, or a similar, fingerprint as one that the source classified. It does not show what the image is. Nobody at korbat opens an image that a match names, before an answer or after it. Decide as for a report: on this record, the post's text and alt texts, and the account's conduct. Never write that the image is child sexual abuse material or that korbat confirmed it.",
  },
  /** [case.image.matched] (8.4). */
  imageMatched: IMAGE_MATCHED,
  /** [case.autoR2] (8.4), for a program's seal of a post's images. */
  caseAutoR2:
    "Only an admin answers a seal: seal for good, or answer without a seal. You answer without seeing the images, and nobody at korbat opens them afterwards either. An answer without a seal puts them before everyone again: it needs one of the reasons below.",
  /** [case.liftedMatch] (8.4), in the place of 3c's sentence after an answer without a seal, on a case that holds a match. */
  liftedMatch: "After an answer without a seal the images are served again as before. They stay closed to staff: nobody at korbat opens an image that a match names, on this case or on any other. No person will have looked at them.",
  /** [case.autoRecord]'s second sentence, for an admin who restricts on a match's finding citing R2. */
  caseAutoRecordPartly: "It is recorded as taken partly by automated means: you cannot view the images, so the comparison is a fact your decision rests on.",
  /** The reason an answer without a seal on an acting match asks for, before the key (8.4). */
  answerReason: { legend: "The reason of this answer without a seal", choose: "Choose the reason of this answer without a seal: it is part of what your key signs." },
  /** [restore.program] (8.7), beside a gap whose lost row is a program's decision. */
  restoreProgram: "A program took this measure, not a person. Take it again as your own decision while you decide; the author is sent your decision's statement.",
} as const;

/**

 * every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. An authority's reference and a leave's are
 * an outsider's text, drawn framed, never in a label's place.
 */
export const RELEASE_WORDS = {
  title: "Release",
  /** The block's labels and values (8.5's table). */
  facts: {
    reported: { label: "Reported to an authority", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
    theirReference: { label: "The authority's reference", frame: "As recorded from the authority", none: "not recorded" },
    answer: {
      label: "The authority's assessment",
      values: { illegal: "illegal", not_illegal: "not illegal", no_assessment: "no assessment", other: "another answer" } as Record<string, string>,
      none: "none recorded",
    },
    answeredAt: { label: "Assessed on", none: "no answer" },
    handedOverAt: { label: "Files handed over on", none: "nothing was handed over" },
    leave: { label: "Leave or instruction to destroy", none: "none recorded", from: { authority: "from the authority", court: "from a court" } as Record<string, string> },
    leaveReference: { label: "Its reference", none: "none recorded" },
    leaveDay: { label: "Its day", none: "none recorded" },
    tell: {
      label: "The author may be told",
      atOnce: "at once",
      untold: (until: string | null) => `not yet: the leave is recorded as not to be told to the person, ${until === null ? "with no end recorded" : `until ${until}`}`,
      record: "not yet: the record of the report, or an authority's order about one of these posts, says that the person is not to be told",
    },
    quarantined: { label: "Files in the quarantine", yes: "all of them, by the record", no: "not all: the move is not recorded" },
    preserved: { label: "Preserved for an order", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
  },
  what: "A release ends korbat's keeping of these sealed images for good. It marks the posts as released and erases their image rows now. Whoever has the server then destroys the files in the quarantine, and the digest of each destroyed file is recorded as the proof. It cannot be undone: nothing brings a destroyed file back. The seal stays in the record as a measure, and the post's text is not touched.",
  tells:
    `The author is told what korbat did: that it released the images, and that an authority's or a court's leave or instruction is its ground. The notice names no authority and no reference and says nothing of what any authority found. It is sent at once, or, while the leave, the record of the report or an authority's order says that the person is not to be told, when the last of these has ended and never before. If an authority has asked korbat not to tell the person and the line above still reads "at once", do not release: whoever has the server records the authority's request first (with the leave when the leave is recorded, staff.js release-leave --untold; for a leave that is recorded already, notification-event on the record of the report).`,
  backups: (backupDays: number) =>
    `A backup of the image store taken before the files moved may still hold them: korbat's backups are deleted ${backupDays} days after they were taken, except a backup kept for an authority, which is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups). The release's record prints the day after which no backup that is deleted on time holds these files.`,
  leave: (from: string) => `Ground: leave to destroy. The record holds a leave or an instruction to destroy these images, ${from}, of the day and with the reference shown above.`,
  assessed:
    "The authority assessed these images as illegal. An assessment is not leave to destroy: it is a reason an authority may want them kept. The images stay sealed and kept until the authority or a court gives korbat leave or an instruction to destroy them and whoever has the server has recorded it (staff.js release-leave).",
  notIllegal:
    "The authority answered that the images are not illegal. That is no ground for a release. Lift the seal instead (Correct this decision, Lift the seal): the images are shown again once their files are returned.",
  conflict:
    'The record holds an assessment "not illegal" and a leave to destroy. The two do not fit. Ask whoever has the server which is wrong before you do either: lifting the seal returns the images, a release destroys them.',
  nothing: "This ends nothing by itself. The images stay sealed and kept.",
  periodUnset: "korbat has set no period after which sealed images are released when an authority stays silent. Until counsel has set one and the terms publish it, nothing is released by time.",
  more: (max: number, remaining: number) =>
    `This seal lists more posts than one confirmation can release. This one releases the first ${max} of them, in the order of their ids; ${remaining} more remain. Read the case again and confirm again for the rest.`,
  sign: (posts: number) => `You confirm with your staff key: this seal, its ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}, the ground, and the leave with its reference as shown above.`,
  done: (releasedAt: string, posts: number, images: number, filesLeft: number, held: boolean, backupsClearAt: string) =>
    `Released at ${releasedAt}: ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}, ${images} image rows erased. Files left to destroy: ${filesLeft}. They are in the quarantine until whoever has the server destroys them (the README, Quarantine), and every staff account is alerted daily while one is still recorded there. The author's notice: ${held ? "held until the person may be told" : "sent at once"}. No backup that is deleted on time holds these files after ${backupsClearAt}; a backup kept for an authority is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups).`,
  button: "Release and destroy",
  /** The block greyed for a moderator: admin_required's words. */

  /** [appeals.released] (8.7). */
  appealReleased: (releasedAt: string, basis: "leave" | "period") =>

"a recorded leave to destroy" : "the period's end"}. korbat has released them: it will not show them again or give them back.   /** [home.released] (8.2): one line a release, newest first. */
  homeReleased: (at: string) => `Released in the last 30 days, each by an admin's key: ${at}, sealed images of a case.`,

 */
export const RECOVERY_WORDS = {
  // The audit log's download (8.7).
  downloadTitle: "Download since my last copy",

  key: "The file holds more than this page: confirm with your staff key.",
  downloadButton: "Download since my last copy",
  done: (from: number, to: number, rows: number) => `Downloaded places ${from} to ${to}: ${rows} rows. The copy is recorded.`,
  none: (lastPlace: number) => `Nothing is newer than place ${lastPlace}.`,
  broken: COPY_BROKEN,
  // "What one key confirmed" (8.7).
  keyTitle: "What one key confirmed",
  keyWhat:
    "Use this when a key may have been in someone else's hands. Each decision listed is undone by an admin's correction on its case; there is no batch. An order's disabling is reinstated only on one of its grounds: a stolen key is not one, so check the order itself.",

  keyFrom: "From (UTC, for example 2026-10-10T01:00:00Z)",
  keyTo: "To (UTC)",

  thisKey: "This key",

  // Home (8.2).
  homeCopy: (days: number) => `The copy is ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"} old. The keeper downloads the audit log's tail on the daily visit: Audit log, "Download since my last copy".`,
  /** [home.copy] before any copy was taken: the design's sentence has no age to print then. */
  homeCopyNone: `No copy of the audit log's tail has been taken yet. The keeper downloads it on the daily visit: Audit log, "Download since my last copy".`,
  homeRestore: (open: number, measures: number) =>
    `After a restore: ${open} ${open === 1 ? "gap is" : "gaps are"} open, ${measures} of them measures to take again. Keep the app's site closed (APP_SITE=closed, Caddy recreated) until every order disabling and seal among them is back.`,
  // After a restore (8.8).
  title: "After a restore",
  what: "The database was restored from a backup, and the keeper's copy names what the backup lacks. Nothing below is in force until a person takes it again under a key: korbat imports no measure. Work from the top.",
  // 3f's review (operations1): the operator's step closes the site, which korbat cannot see; the screen says what to keep.
  site: "Keep the app's site closed (APP_SITE=closed, Caddy recreated) until no order disabling and no seal is open here.",
  siteOpen: "No order disabling and no seal is open. The operator may open the app's site (APP_SITE=open, Caddy recreated).",
  retention: "No measure is open. The operator may switch retention and the image sweep back on.",
  lost: "What no import brings back: the texts of the lost decisions, everything after the keeper's last download, and anything the keeper's files do not hold (the import printed every place it found missing in them). For those, the contact-point mailbox and the operator's notes are the record.",
  holds:
    "Before you disable anything again for an order: whoever has the server compares each held notice below with the contact-point mailbox since the keeper's last download. An extension or a later time that was recorded after that download is lost, and a disabling taken again under the old end would tell the author early.",
  holdUntil: (until: string | null) => (until === null ? "Held with no end recorded" : `Held until ${until}`),
  importedAt: (at: string) => `The newest import ran at ${at}.`,
  nothingOpen: "Every gap is closed.",
  classes: {
    order_effect: { heading: "Orders: disable again", line: (n: number, actedAt: string) => `Lost: the disabling of ${n} ${n === 1 ? "post" : "posts"} for an order, first done at ${actedAt}.` },
    seal_final: { heading: "Seals for good", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a seal for good, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    seal_interim: { heading: "Seals taken while deciding", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a seal taken while deciding, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    standing: { heading: "Suspensions and terminations", line: (measure: string, actedAt: string) => `Lost: ${measure}, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    restriction: { heading: "Other restrictions", line: (measure: string, actedAt: string) => `Lost: ${measure}, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    reversal: { heading: "Reversals", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a reversal, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    no_measure: { heading: "Decisions without a measure", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a decision without a measure, of ${actedAt}. Listed for reference.` },
    // 3d Task 2 (8.7): a lost release, a lost leave, a lost withdrawal of a leave; no key closes any of them.
    release: {
      heading: "Releases and held uploads to replay",
      line: (action: string, actedAt: string) =>
        action === "release_leave_recorded"
          ? `Lost: a leave or an instruction to destroy, recorded on ${actedAt}. The database no longer holds it, so nothing can be released on it.`
          : action === "release_leave_withdrawn"
            ? `Lost: the withdrawal, on ${actedAt}, of a leave that had been recorded by mistake. The database shows that leave as standing again. Do not release on it.`
            : `Lost: a release of ${actedAt}. The database again treats its images as sealed and kept.`,
      /** [restore.release], [restore.leave] and [restore.withdrawn], in place of a control. */
      /** 3d Task 7: a lost end of a held upload's hold, with the way it ended. */
      holdLine: (actedAt: string, endAs: "report" | "no_report") =>
        `Lost: the end of a held upload's hold, of ${actedAt}, as ${endAs === "report" ? "Report" : "No report"}. The database again shows the hold as open, or does not hold the refusal at all.`,
      /** [restore.holdEnd]: when the refusal is there, beside a link to Held uploads; when it is gone, in place of a control. */
      holdEnd: (present: boolean) =>
        present
          ? "End this hold again the same way; your key closes this gap. Do not run upload-report a second time: whoever has the server checks the keeper's files for the record of the report first."
          : "No key closes this. Whoever has the server replays it (staff.js release-replay), which keeps the image's row from being posted and lists its files.",
      holdLink: "Open Held uploads",
      control: (action: string) =>
        action === "release_leave_recorded"
          ? "No key closes this. Whoever has the server records the leave again from what korbat holds in writing (staff.js release-leave, naming this gap); that closes it."
          : action === "release_leave_withdrawn"
            ? "No key closes this. Whoever has the server withdraws the leave again (staff.js release-leave --withdraw, naming this gap); that closes it."
            : "No key closes this. Whoever has the server replays it from the keeper's files (staff.js release-replay), then destroys again what a restored store or the quarantine holds.",
    },
    record: {
      heading: "Records to enter again",
      line: (actedAt: string, what: string) =>
        `Lost: a record of ${actedAt} that the copy names and cannot write again (${what}). Whoever has the server enters it again from the authority's letters and their own notes, with the command that wrote it, naming this gap (--gap).`,
    },
  },
  /** {what} of a gap of the class record: the words of its lost row's action. */
  recordWhat: (action: string) =>
    action === "notification_recorded"
      ? "a step of a notification to an authority"
      : action === "production_recorded"
        ? "a production to an authority"
        : action === "preserved_accessed"
          ? "an access to preserved content for an authority"
          : "a record",
  orderLine: "Open the order, then Disable for an order: the preservation's end, the hold and the clock keep their imported values. Read the held notices above first.",
  openOrder: "Open the order",
  openCase: "Open the case",
  noTarget: "The restored database no longer holds what this names.",
  notNeeded: "Not needed",
  notNeededWhat: "Use this when the measure had ended, or was reversed, before the restore, or when the target no longer exists. It is recorded with your key and cannot be undone here.",
  notNeededDone: "Closed as not needed.",
  closed: (disposition: "reapplied" | "not_needed" | "imported", at: string) =>
    `${disposition === "reapplied" ? "Taken again" : disposition === "not_needed" ? "Not needed" : "Entered again"} at ${at}.`,
  /** 3d Task 2 [restore.sealAgain] (8.7): beside a lost seal for good whose post is released. */
  sealAgain: "This seal's post was released. Take the seal again all the same, so that the record is whole: it freezes nothing and brings nothing back.",
  /** [restore.again] (8.8): the composer's line when a decision takes a lost one again. */
  again: (actedAt: string) => `This takes again a decision of ${actedAt} that was lost with a restore. Its statement says so. Write the facts and the reason again: the lost texts are gone.`,
  /** [effect.preserve] for a disabling taken again after a restore (8.5): the end it had stays. */
  effectPreserveAgain: (preserveUntil: string) => `Each post, its images and a copy of its text are preserved until ${preserveUntil}, as before the restore.`,

 */

export const APPEAL_WORDS = {

/** What a decision that lifted the protection of reported images did, as the home screen's list words it. */
export const PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS: Record<"unsealed" | "dismissed", string> = {
  unsealed: "Lifted a seal",
  dismissed: "Answered a report of child sexual abuse material without a seal",
};

/** The two kinds of decision the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_KINDS: Record<"interim" | "final", string> = {
  interim: "While deciding",
  final: "Decide the case",
};

/** The three outcomes the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_OUTCOMES: Record<"restricted" | "no_violation" | "not_evident", string> = {
  restricted: "Restrict",
  no_violation: "No breach",
  not_evident: "Illegality not evident",
};

/**
 * The composer's sentences beside its texts and its preview. The rule on personal data is the design's sentence in three
 * parts, so that each part is written once: the rule itself, and where the text goes, which differs for a decision
 * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",
  staysInRecord: "The author never receives this text: a decision without a measure tells them at most that what korbat did while deciding has ended. It stays in the case's record, for staff.",
  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}
