```tsx
  }
  if (alerts.channel === "down") lines.push(<p key="channel" className="error">{W.channel(since)}</p>);
  if (alerts.channel === "mailbox") lines.push(<p key="mailbox" className="error">{W.mailbox(since)}</p>);
  if (alerts.channel === "off") lines.push(<p key="off" className="notice">{W.off}</p>);
  // Task 6 (8.2): [home.copy] while the newest copy of the audit log's tail is older than copyOverdueHours, by its days;
  // and [home.restore] while gaps a restore left are open, a link to After a restore.
  if (overview.copy.overdue) {
    const days = overview.copy.newestAt === null ? null : Math.floor((now - Date.parse(overview.copy.newestAt)) / 86_400_000);
    lines.push(
      <p key="copy" className="notice">
        {days === null ? RECOVERY_WORDS.homeCopyNone : RECOVERY_WORDS.homeCopy(days)}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  if (overview.restore.open > 0) {
    const words = RECOVERY_WORDS.homeRestore(overview.restore.open, overview.restore.measures);
    lines.push(
      <p key="restore" className="error">
        {onNavigate ? (
          <NavLink to="/restore" onNavigate={onNavigate}>
            {words}
          </NavLink>
        ) : (
          words
        )}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div role="status" className="authorities">
      <h3>{W.title}</h3>
      {lines}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 3d (design, section 8.2): the block "Sealed files and programs" below "Authorities", each line only while it applies,
 * in the design's order. Task 1: [home.quarantine], while a move of sealed files into the quarantine or back to the image
 * store is due, from the four values of quarantine_counts(); once the oldest due move is older than the alert's threshold
 * it says that every staff account is alerted daily. Task 7 adds [home.flags], [home.uploads], a held upload's release and
 * [home.unreported], and puts [home.released] after the lines of programs, as 8.2 orders them.
 */
export function CustodyLines({
  overview,
  now = Date.now(),
  onOpenCase,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  overview: StaffOverview;
  now?: number;
  onOpenCase?: (id: CaseId) => void;
  /** 3d Task 7: the links to Held uploads. */
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
}) {
  const { quarantine } = overview;
  const lines: ReactNode[] = [];
  if ((quarantine.dueIn > 0 || quarantine.dueOut > 0) && quarantine.oldest !== null) {
    const late = now - Date.parse(quarantine.oldest) > QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours * 3_600_000;
    lines.push(
      <p key="quarantine" className={late ? "error" : "notice"}>
        {CUSTODY_WORDS.homeQuarantine(quarantine.dueIn, quarantine.dueOut, bothTimes(quarantine.oldest))}
        {late ? ` ${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeQuarantineLate}` : ""}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  // 3d Task 2 (8.2): [home.undestroyed] while released files are still in the quarantine, and [home.released], one line
  // a release of the last 30 days, newest first, each linking its case.
  if (quarantine.undestroyed > 0) lines.push(<p key="undestroyed" className="notice">{RELEASE_WORDS.homeUndestroyed(quarantine.undestroyed)}</p>);
  // 3d Task 6 (8.2): [home.automated] while a program's measures wait for a person, and [home.objected] while an author's
  // request for a person waits, each with a link to each of its cases.
  const { automated } = overview;
  const caseLinks = (ids: readonly string[]) =>
    onOpenCase === undefined
      ? null
      : ids.map((raw, index) => {
          const id = parseCaseId(raw);
          return id === null ? null : (
            <span key={raw}>
              {index === 0 ? " " : ", "}
              <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                {`case ${index + 1}`}
              </CaseLink>
            </span>
          );
        });
  if (automated.waiting > 0 && automated.oldestAt !== null) {
    lines.push(
      <p key="automated" className="notice">
        {AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeAutomated(automated.waiting, bothTimes(automated.oldestAt))}
        {caseLinks(automated.cases)}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  if (automated.objected > 0 && automated.oldestObjectionAt !== null) {
    lines.push(
      <p key="objected" className="notice">
        {AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeObjected(automated.objected, bothTimes(automated.oldestObjectionAt))}
        {caseLinks(automated.objectedCases)}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  // 3d Task 7 (8.2): [home.flags] while open cases hold a match that only flags; [home.uploads] while held uploads wait,
  // objections are unanswered or uploads wait over the limit of refusals an hour, with a link to Held uploads.
  if (automated.flags > 0) lines.push(<p key="flags" className="notice">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.homeFlags(automated.flags)}</p>);
  const held = overview.heldUploads;
  const uploadsLink = (words: string) =>
    onNavigate === undefined ? (
      words
    ) : (
      <NavLink to="/uploads" onNavigate={onNavigate}>
        {words}
      </NavLink>
    );
  if (held.open > 0 || held.objected > 0 || held.capped > 0) {
    lines.push(
      <p key="uploads" className="notice">
        {CUSTODY_WORDS.homeUploads(held.open, held.oldest === null ? null : bothTimes(held.oldest), held.objected)}
        {held.capped > 0 ? ` ${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeUploadsCapped(held.capped)}` : ""} {uploadsLink(CUSTODY_WORDS.homeUploadsLink)}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  // [home.released], one line a release of the last 30 days, newest first: a seal's links its case, a held upload's Held
  // uploads; then [home.unreported], one line a hold ended without a report.
  for (const [index, entry] of overview.destructive.filter((act) => act.kind === "seal_released" || act.kind === "upload_released").entries()) {
    if (entry.kind === "upload_released") {
      lines.push(
        <p key={`released-${index}`} className="notice">
          {uploadsLink(CUSTODY_WORDS.homeReleasedUpload(bothTimes(entry.at)))}
        </p>,
      );
      continue;
    }
    const id = entry.caseId === null ? null : parseCaseId(entry.caseId);
    const words = RELEASE_WORDS.homeReleased(bothTimes(entry.at));
    lines.push(
      <p key={`released-${index}`} className="notice">
        {id !== null && onOpenCase !== undefined ? (
          <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
            {words}
          </CaseLink>
        ) : (
          words
        )}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  for (const [index, entry] of overview.destructive.filter((act) => act.kind === "hold_ended_unreported").entries()) {
    lines.push(
      <p key={`unreported-${index}`} className="notice">
        {uploadsLink(CUSTODY_WORDS.homeUnreported(bothTimes(entry.at)))}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div role="status" className="authorities">
      <h3>{CUSTODY_WORDS.homeTitle}</h3>
      {lines}
    </div>
  );
}

export function OverviewView({
  overview,
  now,
  onOpenCase,
  onNavigate,
  onOpenOrder,
}: {
  overview: StaffOverview;
  now: number;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
  onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void;
}) {
  const { reveals, mailsWaiting, mailsFailed } = overview;
  const lateErasures = erasureOverdue(overview.erasureOverdue);
  const waiting = mailsWaiting.receipts + mailsWaiting.authorMails + mailsWaiting.outcomes;
  const failed = mailsFailed.receipts + mailsFailed.authorMails + mailsFailed.outcomes;
  const mails = (m: StaffOverview["mailsWaiting"]) => `${counted(m.receipts, "receipt", "receipts")}, ${counted(m.authorMails, "statement to an author", "statements to authors")}, ${counted(m.outcomes, "outcome", "outcomes")}`;
  return (
    <>
      <AuthoritiesLines overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} {...(onNavigate === undefined ? {} : { onNavigate })} {...(onOpenOrder === undefined ? {} : { onOpenOrder })} />
      <CustodyLines overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      <h3>Cases</h3>
      <ul className="lanes">
        {overview.lanes.map((lane) => (
          <li key={lane.lane}>{`${LANE_NAMES[lane.lane]}: ${lane.open === 0 || lane.oldestAt === null ? "no open case" : `${counted(lane.open, "case", "cases")}, oldest ${waited(lane.oldestAt, now)}`}`}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p>{appealsLine(overview)}</p>
      {overview.appealsWaiting > 0 ? <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.reviewerRule}</p> : null}
      <StandingLines overview={overview} now={now} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      <p>{overview.deferUnproven ? "The emergency switch is on: cases whose unanswered items all come from unproven sources are listed after the others of their lane." : "The emergency switch is off."}</p>
      {overview.releaseOverdue > 0 ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {releaseOverdue(overview.releaseOverdue)}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {lateErasures !== null ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {lateErasures}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {waiting > 0 ? <p className="notice">{`Mails waiting for more than an hour: ${mails(mailsWaiting)}.`}</p> : null}
      {failed > 0 ? <p className="notice">{`Mails given up in the last 30 days: ${mails(mailsFailed)}.`}</p> : null}

      <h3>Sources revealed in the last 30 days</h3>
      <p className="hint">Every staff account's. A reveal nobody expected means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator.</p>
      {reveals.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p>No source was revealed in the last 30 days.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="reveals">
          {reveals.items.map((item, index) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(item.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${item.at} ${item.caseId} ${index}`}>
                <time dateTime={item.at}>{dateTime(item.at)}</time> <UserText>{item.handle}</UserText>{" "}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {reveals.total > reveals.items.length ? <p>{`Showing the newest ${OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX} of ${reveals.total}.`}</p> : null}

      <StaffList
        title="Protection of reported images lifted in the last 30 days"
        hint="Every staff account's: each lifted seal, and each admin's answer to a report or finding of child sexual abuse material without a seal. One nobody expected means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator."
        empty="No decision lifted the protection of reported images in the last 30 days."
        list={overview.protectionLifted}
        words={(item) => PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS[item.kind]}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />
      <StaffList
        title="Choices not to seal in the last 30 days"
        hint="Every staff account's: each recorded choice not to seal reported images, whose reason is on its case."
        empty="Nobody recorded a choice not to seal in the last 30 days."
        list={overview.sealsDeclined}
        words={() => "Chose not to seal"}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />
      <StaffList
        title="Seals taken while deciding that are in force"
        hint="Which images stand sealed until an admin answers, and by whom."
        empty="No seal taken while deciding is in force."
        list={overview.interimSeals}
        words={(item) => `${counted(item.images, "image", "images")} on ${counted(item.posts, "post", "posts")}`}
        onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      />

      <h3>Today, by staff account</h3>
      {overview.imagesToday.length === 0 && overview.findingsToday.length === 0 ? (
        <p>No image was viewed and no finding opened today.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="today">
          {overview.imagesToday.map((row) => (
            <li key={`images ${row.handle}`}>
              <UserText>{row.handle}</UserText>
              {`: ${counted(row.count, "image", "images")} viewed`}
            </li>
          ))}
          {overview.findingsToday.map((row) => (
            <li key={`findings ${row.handle}`}>
              <UserText>{row.handle}</UserText>
              {`: ${counted(row.count, "finding", "findings")} opened`}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The home screen (3a design, section 9; 3c design, section 8): who is signed in and with which role, the session's
 * absolute end, the cases' overview, every staff account's sign-ins of the last 7 days, the person's own staff sessions
 * with "Sign out that session" confirmed by the key, and the person's keys. Keys are added and revoked only with the
 * command line, so no button here touches them.
 */
export interface HomeViewProps {
  me: StaffMe;
  overview: Loadable<StaffOverview>;
  /** The time the overview's waiting times are counted to. */
  now: number;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  /** 3e: a move to one of the console's pages, which the home screen's lines of Task 4 link to. */
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
  /** 3f Task 3: the orders of [home.unverified] link to their pages. */
  onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void;
  signIns: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>;
  sessions: Loadable<StaffSession[]>;
  keys: Loadable<StaffKey[]>;
  /** The handle of the session whose revocation is under way. */
  revoking: string | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  onRevoke(handle: string): void;
}

export function HomeView({ me, overview, now, onOpenCase, onNavigate, onOpenOrder, signIns, sessions, keys, revoking, notice, error, onRevoke }: HomeViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="home-title">
      <h2 id="home-title">Home</h2>
      <p>
        Signed in as <UserText>{me.handle}</UserText>, {me.role}.
      </p>
      <p>{`Signed in until ${clockTime(me.absoluteExpiresAt)}.`}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Loaded
        value={overview}
        render={(value) => <OverviewView overview={value} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} {...(onNavigate === undefined ? {} : { onNavigate })} {...(onOpenOrder === undefined ? {} : { onOpenOrder })} />}
      />

      <h3>Staff sign-ins in the last 7 days</h3>
      <p className="hint">Every staff account's, newest first. A sign-in nobody recognises means someone else holds a staff key: tell the operator.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={signIns}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No staff sign-ins in the last 7 days.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="signins">
              {list.map((entry) => (
                <li key={entry.seq}>
                  <time dateTime={entry.createdAt}>{dateTime(entry.createdAt)}</time> <UserText>{entry.actorHandle ?? "no handle"}</UserText>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )
        }
      />

      <h3>Your staff sessions</h3>
      <p className="hint">Signing out another session asks your staff key to confirm it.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={sessions}
        render={(list) => (
          <table>
            <caption className="visually-hidden">Your staff sessions</caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Browser</th>
                <th scope="col">Started</th>
                <th scope="col">Last used</th>
                <th scope="col">
                  <span className="visually-hidden">Sign out</span>
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {list.map((session) => (
                <tr key={session.handle}>
                  <td>
                    <UserText>{session.browser}</UserText>
                  </td>
                  <td>{dateTime(session.createdAt)}</td>
                  <td>{dateTime(session.lastUsedAt)}</td>
                  <td>
                    {session.current ? (
                      "This session"
                    ) : (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => onRevoke(session.handle)} disabled={revoking !== null} aria-busy={revoking === session.handle}>
                        Sign out that session
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      />

      <h3>Your staff keys</h3>
      <p className="hint">The operator adds and revokes staff keys with the staff command line.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={keys}
        render={(list) => (
          <ul className="keys">
            {list.map((key) => (
              <li key={key.id}>
                <UserText>{key.name}</UserText>
                {`: added ${dateTime(key.createdAt)}, ${key.lastUsedAt === null ? "never used" : `last used ${dateTime(key.lastUsedAt)}`}`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Runs one read and hands its outcome to `set`, unless the screen has gone meanwhile. */
function load<T>(alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<T>) => void, read: () => Promise<T>): void {
  read().then(
    (value) => alive.current && set({ state: "ready", value }),
    (err: unknown) => alive.current && set({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
  );
}

/** The person's staff sessions, marked: the screen reads them when it opens and after a revocation the person asked for. */
function readSessions(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>) => void): void {
  load(alive, set, async () => (await api.sessions({ activity: true })).sessions);
}

/** Where the screen's lists go as each read finishes. */
export interface HomeLists {
  overview(value: Loadable<StaffOverview>): void;
  signIns(value: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>): void;
  sessions(value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>): void;
  keys(value: Loadable<StaffKey[]>): void;
}

/**
 * What the screen reads when it opens, every read marked, since opening the screen is its person's action. It takes no
 * session: the sign-ins' 7 days are counted from a /me read now (readSignInsAtOpening), never from the session the page
 * holds, which can be hours old.
 */
export function openHome(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: HomeLists): void {
  load(alive, set.signIns, () => readSignInsAtOpening(api));
  load(alive, set.overview, () => api.overview({ activity: true }));
  readSessions(api, alive, set.sessions);
  load(alive, set.keys, async () => (await api.keys({ activity: true })).keys);
}

export function Home({
  me,
  api,
  credentials,
  onOpenCase,
  onNavigate,
  onOpenOrder,
}: {
  me: StaffMe;
  api: StaffApi;
  credentials: CredentialsLike;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
  onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void;
}) {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Loadable<StaffOverview>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [signIns, setSignIns] = useState<Loadable<AuditEntry[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Loadable<StaffSession[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<Loadable<StaffKey[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    openHome(api, alive, {
      overview: (value) => {
        setNow(Date.now());
        setOverview(value);
      },
      signIns: setSignIns,
      sessions: setSessions,
      keys: setKeys,
    });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen, never again when the idle timer's reads change `me`; the API client never
    // changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const revoke = async (handle: string) => {
    setRevoking(handle);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const outcome = await revokeSessionWithKey({ api, credentials }, handle);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNotice(outcome === "revoked" ? "That session is signed out." : "That session had already ended.");
      readSessions(api, alive, setSessions);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setRevoking(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <HomeView me={me} overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} {...(onOpenOrder === undefined ? {} : { onOpenOrder })} signIns={signIns} sessions={sessions} keys={keys} revoking={revoking} notice={notice} error={error} onRevoke={(handle) => void revoke(handle)} />
  );
}
```

### Replace `apps/admin/src/screens/Queue.tsx` (whole file)

```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, FindingRequest, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, RULE_IDS, type QueueReply, type QueueRow, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { getRule } from "@korbat/rules";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { systemClock, type Clock } from "../idle";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS, describeError, FINDING_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "../router";
import { dateTime, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel, counted, LANE_NAMES, waited } from "../words";

/**
 * The queue (3c design, sections 7.3 and 8): open cases by lane and then by age, as the API orders them. Nothing here
 * weighs a case: no count of reports, no standing of a reporter. The page reads the queue again every 60 seconds without
 * the activity mark, so a queue left open never keeps a staff session alive. Beside it, "Open a case" takes a korbat link
 * on the moderator's own finding.
 */

/** How often the queue reads itself again. */
export const QUEUE_REFRESH_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * The screen's reads of the queue, on a clock that is the page's or a test's (as the idle timer's is): one now, marked,
 * since opening the screen is its person's action, and one every QUEUE_REFRESH_MS after it, unmarked, since those are the
 * page's own and must never move the session's idle end. Answers what ends them, for when the screen is left.
 */
export function startQueueReads(clock: Clock, read: (activity: boolean) => void): () => void {
  let handle: unknown = null;
  let ended = false;
  const refresh = () => {
    if (ended) return;
    read(false);
    handle = clock.setTimeout(refresh, QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
  };
  read(true);
  handle = clock.setTimeout(refresh, QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
  return () => {
    ended = true;
    clock.clearTimeout(handle);
  };
}

/** What marks a row beyond its lane and age: the console's own words for what its unanswered items are. */
export function marksOf(row: QueueRow): string[] {
  const marks: string[] = [];
  if (row.allegesIllegal) marks.push("notice under Art. 16");
  if (row.suspect) marks.push("CSAM: no images");
  if (row.reexamination) marks.push("re-examination");
  if (row.deferred) marks.push("deferred");
  // 3d Task 6 (section 8.3): what a program found and took on the case, and whether its author asked for a person. The
  // last is why such a case stands first in its lane; the API's order says so, and the page keeps that order.
  if (row.foundByProgram) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.found);
  if (row.takenByProgram) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.taken);
  // 3d Task 7 [queue.matchFlag]: a match that only flags, which moves nothing.
  if (row.matchFlag) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueMatchFlag);
  if (row.objected) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.objected);
  return marks;
}

export interface FindingFormState {
  link: string;
  ruleId: RuleId;
  category: TdbCategory;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface QueueViewProps {
  rows: Loadable<QueueRow[]>;
  /** 3e Task 4: the replies no decision answered, oldest first, which lead the queue's first page; never their text. */
  replies?: QueueReply[];
  /** Whether the API named a further page. */
  more: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  /** The time the ages are counted to. */
  now: number;
  finding: FindingFormState;
  onLoadMore(): void;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onFindingChange(change: Partial<Pick<FindingFormState, "link" | "ruleId" | "category">>): void;
  onFindingSubmit(): void;
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.5): one reply in "Replies to answer": how long it has waited; before the start (the
 * suspension is held) or after it, until or since its end; the measure; and whether it has waited longer than korbat's
 * aim. The reply's text is read on the case page, where the access log and the recusal apply.
 */
export function replyWords(reply: QueueReply, now: number): string[] {
  const where = reply.onTime
    ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.before
    : reply.endsAt !== null && Date.parse(reply.endsAt) <= now
      ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterEnded(dateTime(reply.endsAt))
      : // A termination has no end: its row names none (3e's review, people9).
        reply.kind === "terminate" || reply.endsAt === null
        ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterTermination
        : STANDING_WORDS.reply.after(dateTime(reply.endsAt));
  const what = reply.kind === "terminate" ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination : STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(reply.days ?? 1);
  const late = now - Date.parse(reply.filedAt) > REPLY_AIM_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000 ? [STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim] : [];
  return [where, what, ...late];
}

function Replies({ replies, now, onOpenCase }: { replies: QueueReply[]; now: number; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  return (
    <>
      <h3 id="replies-title">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.title}</h3>
      {replies.length === 0 ? (
        <p>{STANDING_WORDS.reply.none}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="plain replies" aria-labelledby="replies-title">
          {replies.map((reply) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(reply.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${reply.decisionId} ${reply.filedAt}`}>
                <time dateTime={reply.filedAt} title={dateTime(reply.filedAt)}>
                  {waited(reply.filedAt, now)}
                </time>
                {`: ${replyWords(reply, now).join("; ")}. `}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    Open the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function QueueView({ rows, replies = [], more, loadingMore, now, finding, onLoadMore, onOpenCase, onFindingChange, onFindingSubmit }: QueueViewProps) {
  const submit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    onFindingSubmit();
  };
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="queue-title">
      <h2 id="queue-title">Queue</h2>
      {/* 3e Task 4: the replies to answer come first. */}
      <Replies replies={replies} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} />
      <p className="hint">Open cases by lane, then by how long their oldest unanswered item has waited. Nothing else orders them.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={rows}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No case is open.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="scroll">
              <table className="queue">
                <caption className="visually-hidden">Open cases</caption>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Lane</th>
                    <th scope="col">Waiting</th>
                    <th scope="col">About</th>
                    <th scope="col">Cites</th>
                    <th scope="col">Marks</th>
                    <th scope="col">
                      <span className="visually-hidden">Open</span>
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {list.map((row) => {
                    const id = parseCaseId(row.id);
                    return (
                      <tr key={row.id}>
                        <td>{LANE_NAMES[row.lane]}</td>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={row.oldestOpenAt} title={dateTime(row.oldestOpenAt)}>
                            {waited(row.oldestOpenAt, now)}
                          </time>
                          {`, ${counted(row.openItems, "item", "items")}`}
                        </td>
                        <td>{row.targetType === "post" ? "a post" : "an account"}</td>
                        <td>{[...row.rules, ...row.categories.map(categoryLabel)].join(", ")}</td>
                        <td>{marksOf(row).join(", ")}</td>
                        <td>
                          {id ? (
                            <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                              Open the case
                            </CaseLink>
                          ) : null}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )
        }
      />
      {more ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={onLoadMore} disabled={loadingMore} aria-busy={loadingMore}>
          Load more
        </button>
      ) : null}

      <h3 id="finding-title">Open a case</h3>
      <p className="hint">
        On your own finding: give the korbat link of a post or a profile, the rule it breaks and the category. What you write about it is saved as a text on the case. A finding citing R2 freezes
        the images its case reaches until an admin answers.
      </p>
      <form className="panel" onSubmit={submit} aria-labelledby="finding-title">
        <label htmlFor="finding-link">Link on korbat</label>
        <input id="finding-link" type="text" value={finding.link} maxLength={300} autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} onChange={(event) => onFindingChange({ link: event.target.value })} />
        <label htmlFor="finding-rule">Rule</label>
        <select id="finding-rule" value={finding.ruleId} onChange={(event) => onFindingChange({ ruleId: event.target.value as RuleId })}>
          {/* Each rule with its title, as the rulebook in force words it. */}
          {RULE_IDS.map((rule) => (
            <option key={rule} value={rule}>
              {`${rule}: ${getRule(rule)?.title ?? ""}`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <label htmlFor="finding-category">Category</label>
        <select id="finding-category" value={finding.category} onChange={(event) => onFindingChange({ category: event.target.value as TdbCategory })}>
          {FINDING_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
            <option key={category} value={category}>
              {categoryLabel(category)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {finding.error ? (
          <p role="alert" className="error">
            {finding.error}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="submit" className="primary" disabled={finding.busy} aria-busy={finding.busy}>
            Open a case
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}

/** The finding a form's values make, or null when the link is no web address of at most 300 characters: the contracts' schema decides. */
export function findingOf(form: Pick<FindingFormState, "link" | "ruleId" | "category">): FindingRequest | null {
  const parsed = FindingRequest.safeParse({ target: { kind: "link", url: form.link.trim() }, ground: "rule", ruleId: form.ruleId, category: form.category });
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
}

/**
 * Reads the queue from its start through as many pages as the screen shows, one after the other. `activity` says whether
 * a person's action started the read: the screen's opening and "Load more" do, its own refresh every minute does not.
 */
export async function readQueue(api: StaffApi, pages: number, activity: boolean): Promise<{ rows: QueueRow[]; next: string | null; replies: QueueReply[] }> {
  const rows: QueueRow[] = [];
  const replies: QueueReply[] = [];
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  for (let page = 0; page < Math.max(1, pages); page++) {
    const answer = await api.queue(cursor, { activity });
    rows.push(...answer.cases);
    // Only the first page carries the replies.
    replies.push(...answer.replies);
    cursor = answer.nextCursor;
    if (cursor === null) break;
  }
  return { rows, next: cursor, replies };
}

export function Queue({ api, onOpenCase, clock = systemClock }: { api: StaffApi; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; clock?: Clock }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Loadable<QueueRow[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [replies, setReplies] = useState<QueueReply[]>([]);
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [finding, setFinding] = useState<FindingFormState>({ link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1, busy: false, error: null });
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const shown = useRef(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    const read = (activity: boolean) =>
      readQueue(api, shown.current, activity).then(
        (answer) => {
          if (!alive.current) return;
          setRows({ state: "ready", value: answer.rows });
          setReplies(answer.replies);
          setNext(answer.next);
          setNow(Date.now());
        },
        // A refresh that fails leaves the list as it was; only the first read shows its failure.
        (err: unknown) => alive.current && activity && setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
      );
    const stop = startQueueReads(clock, (activity) => void read(activity));
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      stop();
    };
    // Read from the opening of the screen on; neither the API client nor the clock changes while the page lives.
  }, [api, clock]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (next === null || rows.state !== "ready") return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const answer = await api.queue(next, { activity: true });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      shown.current = pages + 1;
      setPages(pages + 1);
      setRows({ state: "ready", value: [...rows.value, ...answer.cases] });
      setNext(answer.nextCursor);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  const openFinding = async () => {
    const request = findingOf(finding);
    if (request === null) {
      setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, error: FINDING_WORDS.invalid_request }));
      return;
    }
    setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: true, error: null }));
    try {
      const answer = await api.openFinding(request, { activity: true });
      const id = parseCaseId(answer.caseId);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: false, link: "" }));
      if (id) onOpenCase(id);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: false, error: describeError(err, FINDING_WORDS) }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <QueueView
      rows={rows}
      replies={replies}
      more={next !== null}
      loadingMore={loadingMore}
      now={now}
      finding={finding}
      onLoadMore={() => void loadMore()}
      onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      // Choosing a rule presets its category; the moderator may still choose another.
      onFindingChange={(change) => setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, ...change, ...(change.ruleId ? { category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[change.ruleId] } : {}), error: null }))}
      onFindingSubmit={() => void openFinding()}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { GAP_CLASSES, MEASURES, type GapClass, type RestoreGap, type RestoreView, type StaffRole } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS, describeError, RECOVERY_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink, NavLink, OrderLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, parseOrderId, type CaseId, type ConsolePath, type OrderId } from "../router";
import { closeGapWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";

/**
 * After a restore (3f design, sections 7.17 and 8.8): what the import found lost, in the order in which a person takes it
 * again, from GET /api/staff/restore. Nothing here is in force: each lost measure is taken again under a key, on the
 * order's or the case's own screen, which "Open the order" and "Open the case" lead to with the gap (the decision then
 * confirmed names it and closes it). An admin closes a gap that needs nothing as "Not needed", with the key. The page
 * shows a gap's members and nothing of its lost row; every list is a list of blocks, usable at a phone's width.
 */

const W = RECOVERY_WORDS;

/** A gap the person is about to take again: its id and when the lost decision was made, which the composer's line names. */
export interface GapToTake {
  id: string;
  actedAt: string;
}

/** {measure}: the words of a lost decision's measures, the labels of MEASURES, each quoted. */
const measureWords = (gap: RestoreGap) => (gap.kinds.length === 0 ? "a decision" : gap.kinds.map((kind) => `"${MEASURES[kind].label}"`).join(", "));

/** A gap's line in its class's words (8.8): `n` counts the open gaps of one order, one a lost item. */
function lineOf(gap: RestoreGap, n: number): string {
  const at = bothTimes(gap.actedAt);
  const c = W.classes;
  switch (gap.class) {
    case "order_effect":
      return c.order_effect.line(n, at);
    case "seal_final":
      return c.seal_final.line(at);
    case "seal_interim":
      return c.seal_interim.line(at);
    case "standing":
      return c.standing.line(measureWords(gap), at);
    case "restriction":
      return c.restriction.line(measureWords(gap), at);
    case "reversal":
      return c.reversal.line(at);
    case "no_measure":
      return c.no_measure.line(at);
    case "record":
      return c.record.line(at, W.recordWhat(gap.action));
    case "release":
      // 3d Task 7: a lost end of a held upload's hold says how it ended.
      return gap.action === "upload_hold_ended" && gap.hold !== undefined ? c.release.holdLine(at, gap.hold.endAs) : c.release.line(gap.action, at);
  }
}

export interface RestoreScreenProps {
  view: RestoreView;
  role: StaffRole;
  busy: string | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId, gap: GapToTake): void;
  onOpenOrder(id: OrderId): void;
  onNotNeeded(gap: RestoreGap): void;
  /** 3d Task 7: the link to Held uploads beside a lost end of a hold whose refusal is there. */
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
}

/** One class's gaps: the open ones with their controls, and the closed ones of the newest import with how they closed. */
function ClassBlock({ cls, gaps, props }: { cls: GapClass; gaps: RestoreGap[]; props: RestoreScreenProps }) {
  const open = gaps.filter((gap) => gap.closedAt === null);
  const closed = gaps.filter((gap) => gap.closedAt !== null);
  // An order's lost disabling is one gap an item: the line counts them and links once to the order.
  const shown = cls === "order_effect" ? open.filter((gap, index) => gap.orderId === null || open.findIndex((other) => other.orderId === gap.orderId) === index) : open;
  return (
    <section className="block" aria-labelledby={`gaps-${cls}`}>
      <h3 id={`gaps-${cls}`}>{W.classes[cls].heading}</h3>
      {cls === "order_effect" && open.length > 0 ? <p className="hint">{W.orderLine}</p> : null}
      <ul className="blocks">
        {shown.map((gap) => {
          const n = cls === "order_effect" && gap.orderId !== null ? open.filter((other) => other.orderId === gap.orderId).length : 1;
          const orderId = gap.orderId === null ? null : parseOrderId(gap.orderId);
          const caseId = gap.caseId === null ? null : parseCaseId(gap.caseId);
          return (
            <li key={gap.id}>
              <p>{lineOf(gap, n)}</p>
              {/* 3d Task 2: [restore.sealAgain] beside a lost seal for good whose post is released. */}
              {gap.released === true ? <p className="hint">{W.sealAgain}</p> : null}
              {/* 3d Task 6 (8.7): [restore.program] beside a lost measure a program took, which a person takes again as theirs. */}
              {gap.action === "automated_decided" ? <p className="hint">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.restoreProgram}</p> : null}
              {/* 3d Task 2 (8.7): no key closes a gap of the class release: the line says who does, and nothing else is offered. */}
              {/* 3d Task 7 [restore.holdEnd]: a lost end of a hold is closed by an admin's end again while the refusal is there. */}
              {cls === "release" && gap.hold !== undefined ? (
                <>
                  {gap.hold.present && props.onNavigate !== undefined ? (
                    <p>
                      <NavLink to="/uploads" onNavigate={props.onNavigate}>
                        {W.classes.release.holdLink}
                      </NavLink>
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                  <p className="hint">{W.classes.release.holdEnd(gap.hold.present)}</p>
                </>
              ) : cls === "release" ? (
                <p className="hint">{W.classes.release.control(gap.action)}</p>
              ) : null}
              {cls === "record" || cls === "release" ? null : cls === "order_effect" ? (
                orderId !== null ? (
                  <p>
                    <OrderLink id={orderId} onOpen={props.onOpenOrder}>
                      {W.openOrder}
                    </OrderLink>
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <p className="hint">{W.noTarget}</p>
                )
              ) : caseId !== null ? (
                <p>
                  <CaseLink id={caseId} onOpen={(id) => props.onOpenCase(id, { id: gap.id, actedAt: gap.actedAt })}>
                    {W.openCase}
                  </CaseLink>
                </p>
              ) : (
                <p className="hint">{W.noTarget}</p>
              )}
              {props.role === "admin" && cls !== "release" ? (
                <div className="actions">
                  <button type="button" disabled={props.busy !== null} aria-busy={props.busy === gap.id} onClick={() => props.onNotNeeded(gap)}>
                    {W.notNeeded}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
        {closed.map((gap) => (
          <li key={gap.id} className="quiet">
            <p>{lineOf(gap, 1)}</p>
            <p>{W.closed(gap.disposition!, bothTimes(gap.closedAt!))}</p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

export function RestoreScreen(props: RestoreScreenProps) {
  const { view } = props;
  const open = view.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.closedAt === null);
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="restore-title">
      <h2 id="restore-title">{W.title}</h2>
      {props.notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {props.notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {props.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {props.error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {view.importedAt === null ? null : <p className="quiet">{W.importedAt(bothTimes(view.importedAt))}</p>}
      <p>{W.what}</p>
      <p className={view.mayOpen ? "notice" : "error"}>{view.mayOpen ? W.siteOpen : W.site}</p>
      {view.retentionMay ? <p className="notice">{W.retention}</p> : null}
      <p className="hint">{W.lost}</p>
      {view.holds.length === 0 ? null : (
        <section className="block" aria-labelledby="restore-holds">
          <p id="restore-holds" className="notice">
            {W.holds}
          </p>
          <ul className="blocks">
            {view.holds.map((hold) => {
              const id = parseOrderId(hold.orderId);
              const words = W.holdUntil(hold.holdUntil === null ? null : bothTimes(hold.holdUntil));
              return <li key={hold.orderId}>{id === null ? <p>{words}</p> : <p><OrderLink id={id} onOpen={props.onOpenOrder}>{words}</OrderLink></p>}</li>;
            })}
          </ul>
        </section>
      )}
      {open.length === 0 ? <p className="notice">{W.nothingOpen}</p> : null}
      {props.role === "admin" && open.length > 0 ? <p className="hint">{W.notNeededWhat}</p> : null}
      {GAP_CLASSES.map((cls) => {
        const gaps = view.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.class === cls);
        return gaps.length === 0 ? null : <ClassBlock key={cls} cls={cls} gaps={gaps} props={props} />;
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

export function Restore({
  api,
  credentials,
  role,
  onOpenCase,
  onOpenOrder,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  api: StaffApi;
  credentials: CredentialsLike;
  role: StaffRole;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId, gap: GapToTake): void;
  onOpenOrder(id: OrderId): void;
  onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void;
}) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<Loadable<RestoreView>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void api.restore({ activity: true }).then(
      (value) => alive.current && setView({ state: "ready", value }),
      (err: unknown) => alive.current && setView({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
    );
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, [api]);

  const notNeeded = async (gap: RestoreGap) => {
    if (busy !== null) return;
    setBusy(gap.id);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const fresh = await closeGapWithKey({ api, credentials }, gap.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setView({ state: "ready", value: fresh });
      setNotice(W.notNeededDone);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Loaded
      value={view}
      render={(value) => (
        <RestoreScreen view={value} role={role} busy={busy} notice={notice} error={error} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onOpenOrder={onOpenOrder} onNotNeeded={(gap) => void notNeeded(gap)} onNavigate={onNavigate} />
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
import {
  STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE,
  StaffStepUpOptionsRequest,
  stepUpActionHash,
  stepUpBinding,
  type AppealsReviewedParams,
  type AuditExportedParams,
  type AuthenticationResponseJSON,
  type CaseDecidedParams,
  type IdentityRevealedParams,
  type OrderCorrectFacts,
  type OrderEffectedParams,
  type OrderEventRecordedParams,
  type SealReleasedParams,
  type UploadHoldEndedParams,
  type UploadReleasedParams,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ApiError, type StaffApi } from "./api";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { authenticationResponseToJSON, ceremonyFailure, fromBase64url, requestOptionsFromJSON, type CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The step-up as the console runs it (3a design, sections 7 and 9). Before it asks the key to confirm an action, the page
 * checks the options the API gave it: the challenge must be the 74 bytes of the contracts' step-up layout with the
 * staff_step_up purpose, bound to the sha256 of this session's handle and the hash of exactly the `{ action, target,
 * params }` the page chose, and the allow list must hold one key. Otherwise the key is never asked, so an API under an
 * attacker's control cannot have it sign an action the person did not choose. The check trusts the page, which Caddy
 * serves from its image, not the API.
 */

/** Options that bind something other than the action the person chose; the key was not asked. */
export class StepUpMismatch extends Error {
  readonly code = "step_up_mismatch";
  readonly status = 0;
  constructor() {
    super(messageFor("step_up_mismatch"));
    this.name = "StepUpMismatch";
  }
}

const sameBytes = (a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): boolean => a.length === b.length && a.every((byte, i) => byte === b[i]);

/**
 * Checks step-up options against this session's handle and the action the page is about to confirm, with the contracts'
 * layout, purpose code, sorted-JSON text and hash, never a copy of them. Throws StepUpMismatch on any difference.
 */
export async function checkStepUpOptions(options: { challenge: string; allowCredentials?: unknown }, sessionHandle: string, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest): Promise<void> {
  const layout = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
  let challenge: Uint8Array;
  try {
    challenge = fromBase64url(options.challenge);
  } catch {
    throw new StepUpMismatch();
  }
  if (challenge.length !== layout.bytes) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  if (challenge[layout.versionAt] !== layout.version || challenge[layout.purposeAt] !== layout.purpose) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // The binding is recomputed here from what the page chose, so a challenge bound to another action, target, params or
  // session never reaches the key.
  const expected = await stepUpBinding(sessionHandle, await stepUpActionHash(action));
  if (!sameBytes(challenge.subarray(layout.bindingAt, layout.bindingAt + layout.bindingBytes), expected)) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // Exactly one key, the session's own: an empty list would let the browser offer any key the person holds.
  if (!Array.isArray(options.allowCredentials) || options.allowCredentials.length !== 1) throw new StepUpMismatch();
}

/**
 * The action that revokes one of the person's staff sessions: its handle as the target, in lower case, the one spelling
 * the API accepts for a step-up target (it hashes the id exactly as sent), and no params.
 */
export function sessionRevokeAction(handle: string): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: handle.toLowerCase() }, params: {} });
}

/**
 * The action that reveals who sent an item: the item's id as the target and, as params, the reason's category and the
 * digest of the reason the person saved. The console builds it from what it shows, with the contracts' schema, so the
 * binding it checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function revealAction(itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "identity_revealed", target: { type: "intake_item", id: itemId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that decides a case: the case's id as the target and, as params, the decision as the composer built it from
 * what the page shows: ids, enums, whole numbers and the digests the console computed, never a text. The contracts'
 * schema refuses anything else, so the binding the console checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function decisionAction(caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: caseId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that reviews an appeal: the appealed decision's id as the target and, as params, the review as the review
 * composer built it from what the page shows: the appeal, ids, enums, whole numbers and digests, never a text.
 */
export function reviewAction(decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params });
}

/**
 * One action confirmed by the key (3c design, section 8): the session's handle read from a marked /me right before,
 * since the API binds the challenge to the session the request's cookie names, which another tab's sign-in may have
 * replaced since the page read its session; then options for exactly this action, asked right before the key (the API
 * reads a step-up challenge only while more than a minute of its ten is left), checked against what the page chose,
 * signed, and handed to `send`, which sends the action's own request with the assertion. The only place the console asks
 * a key to confirm anything: the revocation of a session, a decision, a review and a reveal all go through it. Every
 * request is marked: the person clicked.
 */
export async function confirmWithKey<T>(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, send: (stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const { sessionHandle } = await deps.api.me({ activity: true });
  const { options } = await deps.api.stepUpOptions(action, { activity: true });
  await checkStepUpOptions(options, sessionHandle, action);
  let credential: unknown;
  try {
    credential = await deps.credentials.get({ publicKey: requestOptionsFromJSON(options) });
  } catch (err) {
    throw ceremonyFailure(err);
  }
  return send(authenticationResponseToJSON(credential));
}

/** "Sign out that session", confirmed by the key. "gone" when the session had already ended. */
export async function revokeSessionWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, targetHandle: string): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> {
  const action = sessionRevokeAction(targetHandle);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, async (stepUp): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> => {
    try {
      await deps.api.revokeSession(action.target.id, { stepUp }, { activity: true });
      return "revoked";
    } catch (err) {
      // The API answers a handle that names no live session of the person's as the app does: 404.
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404 && err.code === "not_found") return "gone";
      throw err;
    }
  });
}

/**
 * "Reveal who sent this", confirmed by the key: the reveal of the item with the category and the digest of the saved
 * reason. Answers the reporter's handle or the notifier's given name; both are null when the name was forgotten.
 */
export function revealWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams) {
  const action = revealAction(itemId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.reveal(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the decision composer: the decision on the case, with exactly the params the page
 * built. Answers the case as it stands after the decision, which the page then shows.
 */
export function decideWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams, gap: string | null = null) {
  const action = decisionAction(caseId, params);
  // 3f Task 6: a decision that takes a lost one again names its restore gap; the key signs the decision as always.
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.decide(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }, gap));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the review composer: the review of the decision's appeal, with exactly the params the
 * page built. Answers the decision's case as it stands after the review, which must be the case the page shows.
 */
export function reviewWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams, gap: string | null = null) {
  const action = reviewAction(decisionId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.review(caseId, action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }, gap));
}

/**
 * 3f Task 6 (7.16): the audit log's download, confirmed by the key: the places after `after` up to `through`, the target
 * being `through` as decimal digits. Answers the text of the JSON lines, which the page checks before it saves or marks.
 */
export function exportAuditWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, params: AuditExportedParams) {
  const action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest = { action: "audit_exported", target: { type: "audit", id: String(params.through) }, params };
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.exportAudit({ ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (sections 7.2, 8.5 and 10.4): the action of a release of a seal for good: the seal's ledger row as the target,
 * and as params the posts, the ground, and the recorded leave with its reference, as the page showed them. checkStepUpOptions
 * compares the options the server answers with exactly this before the key is asked.
 */
export function releaseAction(actionId: string, params: SealReleasedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return { action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: actionId }, params };
}

/** "Release and destroy": the release confirmed by the key. Answers the seal's case as it now stands, which the page shows. */
export function releaseWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, actionId: string, params: SealReleasedParams) {
  const action = releaseAction(actionId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.releaseSeal(caseId, actionId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (sections 7.12, 8.6 and 10.4): the action of an end of a held upload's hold: the refusal as the target, and as
 * params the end and its reason exactly as the person chose them; neither end is a default.
 */
export function holdEndAction(refusalId: string, params: UploadHoldEndedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return { action: "upload_hold_ended", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: refusalId }, params };
}

/** "Report" or "No report" on Held uploads, confirmed by the key. Answers the refusal as it now shows. */
export function endHoldWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, refusalId: string, params: UploadHoldEndedParams) {
  const action = holdEndAction(refusalId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.endHold(refusalId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** 3d Task 7 (8.6): the action of a held upload's release: the refusal as the target, the ground and the recorded leave with its reference. */
export function uploadReleaseAction(refusalId: string, params: UploadReleasedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return { action: "upload_released", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: refusalId }, params };
}

/** "Release and destroy" on Held uploads, confirmed by the key. Answers the refusal as it now shows. */
export function releaseUploadWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, refusalId: string, params: UploadReleasedParams) {
  const action = uploadReleaseAction(refusalId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.releaseUpload(refusalId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** 3f Task 6 (8.8): an admin's "Not needed" on a gap, confirmed by the key. Answers After a restore as it now stands. */
export function closeGapWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, gapId: string) {
  const params = { disposition: "not_needed" as const };
  const action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest = { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id: gapId }, params };
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.closeGap(gapId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3f: the action that records a clock event, a closing, a reopening or an extension on an order: the order's id as the
 * target and the event's kind, ground and message as params, as the page chose them.
 */
export function orderEventAction(orderId: string, params: OrderEventRecordedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_event_recorded", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params });
}

/** 3f: the action that corrects an order under the rule admin: the order's id and, as params, the facts to change. */
export function orderCorrectAction(orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_corrected", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params: { facts } });
}

/**
 * 3f Task 3: the action of "Disable for an order": the order's id as the target and, as params, the order's facts as the
 * page showed them, `urgent`, and the ticked items with their posts, sorted by post. The schema refuses any other order,
 * so one action has one hash and its order is the lock order.
 */
export function orderEffectAction(orderId: string, params: OrderEffectedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_effected", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params });
}

/** "Disable {n} posts: confirm with your staff key"; answers the order as it stands after the effect. */
export function effectOrderWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, params: OrderEffectedParams) {
  const action = orderEffectAction(orderId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.effectOrder(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** "Confirm with your staff key" on an order's event; answers the order as it stands after it. */
export function recordOrderEventWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, params: OrderEventRecordedParams) {
  const action = orderEventAction(orderId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.recordOrderEvent(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** "Confirm with your staff key" on an admin's correction; answers the order as it stands after it. */
export function correctOrderWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts) {
  const action = orderCorrectAction(orderId, facts);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.correctOrder(action.target.id, { facts, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}
```
