```tsx
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { MEASURES, type AccountStanding, type AuthorCaseRow, type AuthorNoticesPage, type ReportItem, type ReportsPage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Button, ErrorText } from "@/components/ui";
import { utcMinute } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { AUTO_WORDS, CASES_WORDS, RELEASE_TEXTS, UPLOAD_TEXTS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { ORDER_TEXTS } from "@/lib/orders";
import { CASE_ROW_WORDS, bannerSentences, reportingLine, rowStrike, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";
import { ItemLines } from "./ItemLines";

/** 3e: the kinds whose words in a row are the row's own (9.4), not the measure's label. */
const ROW_KINDS: Partial<Record<AuthorCaseRow["actions"][number], string>> = {
  overrule: CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule,
  retire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.retired,
  unretire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.unretired,
  suspend: CASE_ROW_WORDS.suspended,
  lift_suspension: CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted,
  // Task 5: a warning about the account's reports, and the lift of either reporting measure.
  warn_reporting: CASE_ROW_WORDS.warned,
  lift_reporting: CASE_ROW_WORDS.reportingLifted,
};

/**
 * 3e's review (people7; design, section 9.4): a suspension's or a termination's row and a lift's, in the row's own words
 * when the row says what they were: a suspension with its days and kind, a termination, a withdrawal for another measure,
 * the lift of a termination.
 */
function standingWords(row: AuthorCaseRow, kind: AuthorCaseRow["actions"][number]): string | null {
  const measure = row.standingMeasure;
  if ((kind === "suspend" || kind === "terminate") && measure !== undefined) {
    return measure.kind === "terminate" || measure.days === null ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.terminated : CASE_ROW_WORDS.suspendedFor(measure.days, measure.announced);
  }
  const lifted = row.liftedStanding;
  if (kind === "lift_suspension" && lifted !== undefined) return lifted.replaced ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.withdrawn : lifted.kind === "terminate" ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.terminationLifted : CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted;
  return null;
}

/**
 * What a decision did, in the measures' own labels; a decision without a measure ended what was done while deciding, or
 * took no action. A review that kept the decision is worded by its outcome first: it lifts nothing, and the restriction
 * it answered stands; and so is a kept correction (3e's review, people3), korbat's answer to a reply that kept the
 * suspension or termination, which holds no row of its own.
 */
function done(row: AuthorCaseRow, now: Date): string {
  // 3f (design, section 9.3): an order's notice and the reinstatement after one, in the row's own words.
  if (row.order !== undefined) return ORDER_TEXTS.row[row.order];
  if ((row.kind === "review" || row.kind === "correction") && row.outcome === "kept") return CASES_WORDS.keptDecision;
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): a strike is named with where it stands, its overruling, a retirement and its reversal in
  // the row's own words.
  const labels: string[] = row.actions.map((kind) =>
    kind === "strike" && row.strike
      ? rowStrike(row.strike, now)
      : kind === "restrict_reporting" && row.reportingDays !== undefined
        ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.restricted(row.reportingDays)
        : (standingWords(row, kind) ?? ROW_KINDS[kind] ?? MEASURES[kind].label),
  );
  // Task 5: a reversal that ended a restriction of reporting resting on the decision it reversed says so; and (3e's
  // review, people7) one that ended a suspension or a termination.
  for (const ended of ["suspend", "terminate"] as const) if ((row.endedStanding ?? []).includes(ended)) labels.push(CASE_ROW_WORDS.standingEnded[ended]);
  if ((row.endedStanding ?? []).includes("restrict_reporting")) labels.push(CASE_ROW_WORDS.restrictionEnded);
  if (row.endedInterim) labels.push(CASES_WORDS.ended);
  return labels.length > 0 ? labels.join(", ") : CASES_WORDS.noAction;
}

/** Which kind of decision it is, where that is not plain from what it did. */
function kindWords(row: AuthorCaseRow): string | null {
  if (row.kind === "interim") return CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding;
  if (row.kind === "review") return CASES_WORDS.review;
  if (row.kind === "correction") return CASES_WORDS.correction;
  return null;
}

/**
 * "About you" (3c design, section 9): the decisions about the account that its holder was told of, newest first. Each
 * row is a link to the decision's screen and says what it is about (the post, by its creation time, or the profile), the
 * decision's day, what was done, the rule or the law, and where its appeal stands.
 */
export function DecisionsList({ decisions, now = new Date() }: { decisions: readonly AuthorCaseRow[]; now?: Date }) {
  if (decisions.length === 0) return <Text className="px-4 py-8 text-base text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.noDecisions}</Text>;
  return (
    <View>
      {decisions.map((row) => {
        const kind = kindWords(row);
        return (
          <Link key={row.id} href={`/settings/cases/${row.id}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{row.post ? CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(row.post.createdAt)) : CASES_WORDS.profile}</Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                {/* 3f's review (people9): an order's row shows the day its author was told, which the list sorts it by. */}
                {row.toldOn !== undefined ? ORDER_TEXTS.row.toldOn(row.toldOn) : CASES_WORDS.decidedOn(row.decidedOn)}
                {kind ? ` (${kind})` : ""}
              </Text>
              {/* 3d Task 6 (section 9.6): a decision a program took says so; a person's later decision is its own row. */}
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{row.byProgram === true ? AUTO_WORDS.row(done(row, now)) : done(row, now)}</Text>
              {/* 3f: an order's row names no rule and no law of korbat's judgement. */}
              {row.order === undefined && (row.ruleId || row.legal) ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{row.ruleId ? CASES_WORDS.rule(row.ruleId) : CASES_WORDS.law}</Text> : null}
              {row.appealUntil ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute(row.appealUntil))}</Text> : null}
              {row.appeal ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealState[row.appeal]}</Text> : null}
              {row.reversedOn ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.reversed(row.reversedOn)}</Text> : null}
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, section 9.6): the notices about the account's posts that are not decisions, in "About you" above
 * its decisions, newest first: "Sealed images released", each with its day and a link to its notice; 3d Task 7: "An
 * upload was not accepted" for a refused upload. A release whose
 * notice may not be told yet is in no answer, so it is in no list. Nothing is shown while there is none.
 */
export function NoticesList({ notices }: { notices: AuthorNoticesPage["notices"] }) {
  if (notices.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <View className="border-b border-zinc-800">
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="px-4 pt-3 text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {RELEASE_TEXTS.noticesTitle}
      </Text>
      {notices.map((notice) =>
        // 3d Task 7 (9.6): a refused upload's entry leads to its notice, a release's to its own.
        notice.kind === "upload_refused" ? (
          <Link key={notice.id} href={`/settings/cases/uploads/${notice.id}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{UPLOAD_TEXTS.entry}</Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">{UPLOAD_TEXTS.entryOn(notice.at.slice(0, 10))}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ) : (
          <Link key={notice.id} href={`/settings/cases/releases/${notice.id}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{RELEASE_TEXTS.entry}</Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">{RELEASE_TEXTS.entryOn(notice.at.slice(0, 10))}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ),
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * "Your standing" (3e design, section 9.4), above "About you": how many of the account's strikes count now, and what that
 * many leads to; then the line of a suspension or a termination that /me carries, not fixed yet, announced, held by a
 * reply or running, in the banner's words (3e's review, people7); and (Task 5) [cases.reporting]: a restriction of the
 * account's reports that runs, or a warning about them that counts.
 */
export function StandingBlock({ activeStrikes, standing = null }: { activeStrikes: number; standing?: AccountStanding | null }) {
  const measure = bannerSentences(standing);
  const reporting = reportingLine(standing);
  return (
    <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {STANDING_TEXTS.cases.title}
      </Text>
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Text, View } from "react-native";
import { STATEMENT_MAX, itemOutcomeWords, type NoticeItemStatus } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS } from "@korbat/rules";
import { Button, ErrorText, Field } from "@/components/ui";
import { externalLink } from "@/lib/links";
import { dailyLimitFailure, itemRedress, quotedExaminedToo, utcMinute } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { STATUS_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";

/**
 * "Ask for a re-examination" (3c design, section 9): an optional statement, free of form, and the button. The request
 * is a POST its caller sends; a refusal is worded under the button, and what was typed stays. Once it is taken the list
 * is read again, and the item no longer offers the control.
 */
function ReexamineControl({ both, onAsk }: { both: boolean; onAsk: (statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const [statement, setStatement] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function ask() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onAsk(statement);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(dailyLimitFailure(err, "reexaminations"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <View>
      {/* A report of child sexual abuse material about a post that quotes another: korbat examines both posts again. */}
      {both ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.reexamineBoth}</Text> : null}
      <Field label={STATUS_WORDS.reexamineStatement} value={statement} onChangeText={setStatement} multiline maxLength={STATEMENT_MAX} />
      <Button label={STATUS_WORDS.reexamine} onPress={() => void ask()} busy={busy} tone="secondary" />
      <ErrorText message={error} />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * One item of a report as its sender reads it, on the notice status page and in Your reports alike (3c design, section
 * 9). Its link is the address the report named, an account's under the handle as named. Once its outcome is released it
 * reads the words the mail reads (the contracts' one composition, from the item's own facts), and beside them what the
 * sender can still do: ask for a re-examination while that is open, with the control when the screen can send one, or go
 * to court; a changed outcome and a re-examination's answer are final within korbat. Until then it says only that it is
 * not decided. 3e Task 5 (design, section 9.4): on the sender's own list, an item a moderator marked "manifestly
 * unfounded" says so while the mark counts, once its outcome is released; the status page's items carry no mark.
 */
function ItemLine({ item, both, onAsk }: { item: NoticeItemStatus & { unfounded?: boolean }; both: boolean; onAsk?: (statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const words = itemOutcomeWords(item);
  const redress = itemRedress(item);
  return (
    <View className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
      {item.quotedBy !== null ? (
        // An item korbat added for the post a named post quotes: its heading says so, with the quoted post's address.
        <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-100">{STATUS_WORDS.added(item.quotedBy, item.link)}</Text>
      ) : (
        <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-100">
          {STATUS_WORDS.item(item.position)}
          {item.reexamines ? ` (${STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel})` : ""}:{" "}
          <Text {...externalLink(item.link)} className="font-normal text-sky-400 underline">
            {item.link}
          </Text>
        </Text>
      )}
      {words === null || item.decidedOn === null ? (
        <Text className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.waiting}</Text>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">
            {STATUS_WORDS.decided(item.decidedOn)} {words}
          </Text>
          {/* 3d Task 7 (9.6, W.3): a decision recorded as partly automated says so, as the mail does. */}
          {item.automatedDecision === "partially" ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{STATEMENT_WORDS.update.automated.partly}</Text> : null}
          {item.unfounded === true ? (
            // "You can ask for a re-examination" only while one is open (3e's review, people8).
            <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-amber-300">{redress === "reexamination" ? STANDING_TEXTS.reports.marked : STANDING_TEXTS.reports.markedClosed}</Text>
          ) : null}
          {redress === "reexamination" && item.reexamination ? (
            <>
              <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(item.reexamination.until))}</Text>
              {onAsk ? <ReexamineControl both={both} onAsk={onAsk} /> : null}
            </>
          ) : null}
          {redress === "final" ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.final}</Text> : null}
          {redress === "courts" ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.courts}</Text> : null}
        </>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * A report's items in the order the API lists them: by position, an added item directly after the item it was added for.
 * With `onReexamine` each item whose answer can still be examined again carries the control; the caller sends the
 * request for the item it is handed (by its position on the status page, by its id in Your reports).
 */
export function ItemLines<T extends NoticeItemStatus>({ items, onReexamine }: { items: readonly T[]; onReexamine?: (item: T, statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  return (
    <View>
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        // A re-examination shares its item's position, so the place in the list is the key.
        <ItemLine key={index} item={item} both={quotedExaminedToo(items, index)} onAsk={onReexamine ? (statement) => onReexamine(item, statement) : undefined} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ALT_MAX_LENGTH, MEDIA_ACCEPTED_TYPES, MEDIA_MAX_BYTES, MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST, altLength, normalizeAltText, type MediaFailure } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { social } from "@/lib/social";

export interface ComposerImage {
  /** Stable for the life of the row; the upload id only exists once the server answered. */
  key: string;
  /** A blob: URL of the chosen file, so the preview shows at once and nothing has to be downloaded. */
  previewUrl: string;
  alt: string;
  status: "uploading" | "processing" | "ready" | "failed" | "refused";
  id: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  /** 3d Task 7: the refusal's id, whose notice the tile's "Why" opens; null for every other status. */
  refusalId?: string | null;
}

const FAILURES: Record<MediaFailure, string> = {
  unsupported_format: "That file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF image.",
  animated_not_supported: "Animated images are not supported yet. Use a still image.",
  image_too_large: "That image has too many pixels. Make it smaller and try again.",
  corrupt_image: "That file could not be read as an image.",
  processing_failed: "We could not process that image. Try again.",
};

const POLL_MS = 1000;
/** A little longer than the server waits before it fails an upload itself. */
const GIVE_UP_MS = 6 * 60_000;

/**
 * Why a file is refused before it is sent, or null when it may go. The server checks again. Browsers on
 * Windows often report no type at all for a .heic file, so its name is checked too: an iPhone photo
 * should get the advice that helps, not the generic refusal.
 */
export function refusal(file: { name: string; type: string; size: number }): string | null {
  if (file.type === "image/heic" || file.type === "image/heif" || /\.hei[cf]$/i.test(file.name)) return "HEIC photos are not supported. Export the photo as JPEG and try again.";
  if (!(MEDIA_ACCEPTED_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(file.type)) return FAILURES.unsupported_format;
  if (file.size > MEDIA_MAX_BYTES) return "Images can be at most 20 MB.";
  return null;
}

/** What still stands between these images and posting them. */
export function describeState(images: ComposerImage[]): { waiting: boolean; failed: boolean; undescribed: boolean } {
  return {
    waiting: images.some((image) => image.status === "uploading" || image.status === "processing"),
    // 3d Task 7: a refused upload is never posted: the composer holds it back as it holds back a failed one.
    failed: images.some((image) => image.status === "failed" || image.status === "refused"),
    undescribed: images.some((image) => {
      const length = altLength(normalizeAltText(image.alt));
      return length < 1 || length > ALT_MAX_LENGTH;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * The images of one composer: uploads each chosen file, follows its processing, and keeps the
 * descriptions. Removing an image also removes the upload on the server (a refused upload, and one whose check has not
 * answered, only from the composer: korbat keeps it as its hold or its check needs). Blob URLs are released
 * when an image goes and when the composer closes.
 */
export function useImageUploads() {
  const [images, setImages] = useState<ComposerImage[]>([]);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  /** The same list as `images`, readable by callbacks without waiting for a render. */
  const list = useRef<ComposerImage[]>([]);
  const closed = useRef(false);

  const commit = useCallback((next: ComposerImage[]) => {
    list.current = next;
    setImages(next);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    closed.current = false;
    return () => {
      closed.current = true;
      for (const image of list.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(image.previewUrl);
    };
  }, []);

  const patch = useCallback(
    (key: string, change: Partial<ComposerImage>) => commit(list.current.map((image) => (image.key === key ? { ...image, ...change } : image))),
    [commit],
  );
  const present = (key: string) => !closed.current && list.current.some((image) => image.key === key);

  const follow = useCallback(
    async (key: string, file: File) => {
      try {
        const sent = await social.uploadMedia(file);
        if (!present(key)) {
          await social.removeMedia(sent.id).catch(() => undefined);
          return;
        }
        patch(key, { id: sent.id, status: "processing" });
        const deadline = Date.now() + GIVE_UP_MS;
        while (present(key) && Date.now() < deadline) {
          const state = await social.mediaStatus(sent.id);
          if (!present(key)) return;
          if (state.status === "ready") return patch(key, { status: "ready" });
          if (state.status === "failed") return patch(key, { status: "failed", error: FAILURES[state.error] });
          // 3d Task 7 (9.5): an upload the comparison refused: the tile says so and links its notice.
          if (state.status === "refused") return patch(key, { status: "refused", refusalId: state.refusalId });
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, POLL_MS));
        }
        if (present(key)) patch(key, { status: "failed", error: FAILURES.processing_failed });
      } catch (err) {
        if (present(key)) patch(key, { status: "failed", error: errorMessage(err) });
      }
    },
    [patch],
  );

  const add = useCallback(
    (files: File[]) => {
      const room = Math.max(0, MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST - list.current.length);
      let message: string | null = files.length > room ? `A post can have at most ${MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST} images.` : null;
      const added: ComposerImage[] = [];
      const started: [string, File][] = [];
      for (const file of files.slice(0, room)) {
        const why = refusal(file);
        if (why) {
          message = why;
          continue;
        }
        const key = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
        added.push({ key, previewUrl: URL.createObjectURL(file), alt: "", status: "uploading", id: null, error: null });
        started.push([key, file]);
      }
      setNotice(message);
      commit([...list.current, ...added]);
      for (const [key, file] of started) void follow(key, file);
    },
    [commit, follow],
  );

  const remove = useCallback(
    (key: string) => {
      const image = list.current.find((candidate) => candidate.key === key);
      if (!image) return;
      URL.revokeObjectURL(image.previewUrl);
      commit(list.current.filter((candidate) => candidate.key !== key));
      if (image.id) void social.removeMedia(image.id).catch(() => undefined);
    },
    [commit],
  );

  /** After posting: the uploads now belong to the post, so only the previews are released. */
  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    for (const image of list.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(image.previewUrl);
    commit([]);
    setNotice(null);
  }, [commit]);

  const setAlt = useCallback((key: string, alt: string) => patch(key, { alt }), [patch]);

  return { images, notice, add, remove, clear, setAlt };
}
```

```ts
  // 3f (design, section 9.4): an appeal sent against an order's notice by hand; the screen offers none.
  not_appealable: NOT_APPEALABLE,
  // 3e (design, section 9.8): the fallback when /me cannot be read; with it the screens say until when (9.4).
  account_suspended: "Your account is suspended, so you cannot do this now.",
  // 3e Task 5 (design, section 9.8): [report.restricted] without its date, which the report form adds from /me (9.6).
  reporting_restricted:
    'korbat has restricted your reports under its rules, after a warning, because several of them were plainly unfounded. The decision is under Settings, Cases, where you can appeal it. You can still report illegal content: choose "It is illegal". For the sexual abuse or exploitation of a child, choose the third answer.',
  unauthenticated: "Sign in to continue.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on our side. Try again.",
  network: "Cannot reach korbat. Check your connection.",
};

/** The daily passkey bound as the API details it: 5 added in a day, and the seconds until the day has a slot again. */
function dailyPasskeyBound(details: unknown): number | null {
  const bound = details as { reason?: unknown; retryAfter?: unknown } | null;
  return bound && typeof bound === "object" && bound.reason === "daily" && typeof bound.retryAfter === "number" && bound.retryAfter > 0 ? bound.retryAfter : null;
}

/** The message for a code; `details` is what the server sent beside it, which turns the daily passkey bound into its wait in hours. */
export function messageFor(code: string, fallback?: string, details?: unknown): string {
  const wait = code === "passkey_limit" ? dailyPasskeyBound(details) : null;
  if (wait !== null) {
    const hours = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wait / 3600));
    return `You added 5 passkeys today. You can add another in about ${hours === 1 ? "1 hour" : `${hours} hours`}.`;
  }
  return MESSAGES[code as keyof typeof MESSAGES] ?? fallback ?? "Something went wrong. Try again.";
}

/**
 * The codes worded here rather than by the server: validation and internal errors, whose server messages are technical;
 * the passkey bounds, whose daily wait is worded from the details; and (3e's review, people7) a report refused for the
 * restriction of reporting and a reply that is not open, whose screens print the app's own sentences of the design.
 */
function localWording(code: string): boolean {
  return code === "invalid_request" || code === "internal" || code === "passkey_limit" || code === "reporting_restricted" || code === "reply_not_open" || code === "objection_not_open" || code === "upload_refused";
}

/** The message to show for any thrown value. */
export function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  return err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Something went wrong. Try again.";
}

function readCookie(name: string): string | undefined {
  const cookies = web.document?.cookie;
  if (!cookies) return undefined;
  for (const part of cookies.split("; ")) {
    const separator = part.indexOf("=");
    if (part.slice(0, separator) === name) return decodeURIComponent(part.slice(separator + 1));
  }
  return undefined;
}

const BASE64URL = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

/** 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url (43 characters). */
function randomDeviceId(): string {
  const bytes = web.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(33));
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const n = (bytes[i]! << 16) | (bytes[i + 1]! << 8) | bytes[i + 2]!;
    out += BASE64URL[(n >> 18) & 63]! + BASE64URL[(n >> 12) & 63]! + BASE64URL[(n >> 6) & 63]! + BASE64URL[n & 63]!;
  }
  return out.slice(0, 43);
}

/** A random id created once per browser. The server stores only a keyed hash of it. */
export function deviceId(): string {
  try {
    const existing = web.localStorage?.getItem(DEVICE_KEY);
    if (existing && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22,64}$/.test(existing)) return existing;
    const created = randomDeviceId();
    web.localStorage?.setItem(DEVICE_KEY, created);
    return created;
  } catch {
    return randomDeviceId();
  }
}

export const platform: "web" | "ios" | "android" = Platform.OS === "ios" || Platform.OS === "android" ? Platform.OS : "web";

interface RequestOptions<T> {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
  json?: unknown;
  /** A raw body sent as it is, with its declared type: how an image is uploaded. */
  raw?: { type: string; body: Blob };
  /** Schema for a JSON response body. Omit for 204 responses. */
  schema?: z.ZodType<T>;
}

/**
 * Calls the API with the session cookie and answers with the raw response, for a body that is not
 * JSON (the account export's ZIP). State-changing requests echo the CSRF cookie in X-CSRF-Token; the
 * session cookie itself is HttpOnly and never readable here. A failed call throws an ApiError.
 */
export async function apiResponse(path: string, options: Omit<RequestOptions<unknown>, "schema"> = {}): Promise<Response> {
  const method = options.method ?? (options.json === undefined && options.raw === undefined ? "GET" : "POST");
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (options.json !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
  if (options.raw) headers["content-type"] = options.raw.type;
  if (method !== "GET") {
    const csrf = readCookie(CSRF_COOKIE);
    if (csrf) headers["x-csrf-token"] = csrf;
  }

  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      method,
      headers,
      credentials: "include",
      body: options.raw ? options.raw.body : options.json === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.json),
    });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(0, "network", messageFor("network"));
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    if (res.status === 401 && !path.startsWith("/api/auth/") && path !== "/api/me") onUnauthenticated?.();
    const parsed = ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await res.json().catch(() => null));
    const code = parsed.success ? parsed.data.error.code : "internal";
    const details = parsed.success ? parsed.data.error.details : undefined;
    // 3e: a write refused for a running suspension: /me is read again, so the screens say until when.
    if (res.status === 403 && code === "account_suspended") onSuspended?.();
    // The server's message is written for people and can be more specific than the generic text for
    // its code ("Two-factor setup expired. Start again."). Only the codes localWording names use the
    // local wording.
    const local = localWording(code) || !parsed.success;
    // Retry-After is whole seconds: on a rate limit, and on the handle cooldown, where it says when the next change is allowed.
    const retryAfter = Number(res.headers.get("retry-after"));
    throw new ApiError(res.status, code, local ? messageFor(code, undefined, details) : parsed.data.error.message, Number.isFinite(retryAfter) && retryAfter > 0 ? retryAfter : undefined, details);
  }
  return res;
}

/** Calls the API as `apiResponse` does and parses the JSON answer with `schema`; omit it for a 204 response. */
export async function api<T = void>(path: string, options: RequestOptions<T> = {}): Promise<T> {
  const res = await apiResponse(path, options);
  if (!options.schema) return undefined as T;
  return options.schema.parse(await res.json());
}

export async function fetchHealth(): Promise<HealthResponse> {
  return api("/api/health", { schema: HealthResponse });
}
```

```ts
export function statementOf(written: string): { statement?: string } {
  const statement = written.trim();
  return statement.length > 0 ? { statement } : {};
}

/** The moderation endpoints the app calls, typed by the shared contracts. Cookies and CSRF are handled by `api`. */

  /** The status page's buttons, for which only the token of a mail's link works. */

  /** 3d Task 2: the notices about the account's posts that are not decisions, newest first: the releases of its sealed images. */
  notices: (cursor?: string) => api(`/api/moderation/notices${query(cursor)}`, { schema: AuthorNoticesPage }),
  /** 3d Task 2: one release's notice, for its author alone; not_found for anyone else, and while it may not be told yet. */
  release: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/releases/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: ReleaseNoticeView }),
  /** 3d Task 7: a refused upload's notice, for its uploader alone; not_found for anyone else. */
  upload: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/uploads/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: UploadRefusalView }),
  /** 3d Task 7: "Object" on a refused upload, with the one message its uploader writes; the answer is the notice as it now reads. */
  objectToUpload: (id: string, text: string) => api(`/api/moderation/uploads/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/objection`, { json: { text }, schema: UploadRefusalView }),
  resumeReportMail: () => api("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST" }),
  /** The author's appeal of a decision about them. The answer is the decision as it now reads, with the appeal waiting. */

  /**

  /**

  reexamineNotice: (ref: string, token: string, position: number, statement: string) => api("/api/notices/reexamine", { json: { ref, token, position, ...statementOf(statement) }, schema: ReexamineResponse }),
  /** A re-examination of an item of a report the signed-in account sent, named by the id its list carries. */
  reexamineOwn: (itemId: string, statement: string) => api(`/api/moderation/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/reexamine`, { json: statementOf(statement), schema: ReexamineResponse }),
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what a report is opened on

/** A post, optionally with the one of its images that is meant, or a profile: what "Report" was pressed on. */
export type GivenTarget = Extract<NoticeTarget, { kind: "post" | "account" }>;

/** The report form's address: on its own, or opened on a post, on one image of a post, or on a profile. */
export function reportHref(on?: { post: string; media?: string } | { account: string }): string {
  if (!on) return "/report";
  if ("account" in on) return `/report?account=${encodeURIComponent(on.account)}`;
  return `/report?post=${encodeURIComponent(on.post)}${on.media ? `&media=${encodeURIComponent(on.media)}` : ""}`;
}

const one = (value: unknown): string | undefined => (typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 ? value : undefined);

/** What the form's address names, or null when it names nothing the API would take: the form then asks for a link. */
export function givenTarget(params: { post?: unknown; media?: unknown; account?: unknown }): GivenTarget | null {
  const [post, media, account] = [one(params.post), one(params.media), one(params.account)];
  const parsed = post !== undefined ? NoticeTarget.safeParse({ kind: "post", id: post, ...(media !== undefined ? { mediaId: media } : {}) }) : account !== undefined ? NoticeTarget.safeParse({ kind: "account", handle: account }) : null;
  return parsed?.success && parsed.data.kind !== "link" ? parsed.data : null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the form

export type Ground = "rule" | "illegal" | "csam";

/** The category of an illegal-ground notice: one of the 14 the form shows, or "not specified" for someone who is not sure. */
export type NoticeCategoryChoice = TdbFormCategory | "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE";

/** What the person has filled in so far. */
export interface ReportDraft {
  ground: Ground | null;
  /** The rule of the rule ground; on the illegal ground, a rule it also breaks. */
  ruleId: ReportRuleId | null;
  explanation: string;
  category: NoticeCategoryChoice;
  citedLaw: string;
  bonaFide: boolean;
  keyword: CsamKeywordChoice | null;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  /** The item's link, when the form was opened without an item. */
  link: string;
  /** Up to nine more korbat links. */
  others: string[];
}

export const EMPTY_DRAFT: ReportDraft = {
  ground: null,
  ruleId: null,
  explanation: "",
  category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE",
  citedLaw: "",
  bonaFide: false,
  keyword: null,
  name: "",
  email: "",
  link: "",
  others: [],
};

/** How many more links "Other items" takes. */
export const OTHER_LINKS_MAX = NOTICE_LIMITS.maxTargets - 1;

/** What the draft names, in order: the item the form was opened on or its link, then the other links that hold something. */
export function draftTargets(draft: ReportDraft, given: GivenTarget | null): NoticeTarget[] {
  const links = [...(given ? [] : [draft.link]), ...draft.others].map((url) => url.trim()).filter((url) => url.length > 0);
  return [...(given ? [given] : []), ...links.map((url) => ({ kind: "link" as const, url }))];
}

/** The handle a target names when it is a profile: an account, or a link to /u/<handle>. Null for anything else. */
function profileOf(target: NoticeTarget): string | null {
  if (target.kind === "account") return target.handle.toLowerCase();
  if (target.kind !== "link") return null;
  try {
    const match = /^[/]u[/]@?([A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20})[/]?$/.exec(new URL(target.url).pathname);
    return match ? match[1]!.toLowerCase() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** How many different profiles the targets name. */
export function profilesNamed(targets: readonly NoticeTarget[]): number {
  return new Set(targets.map(profileOf).filter((handle) => handle !== null)).size;
}

/**
 * Whether the form asks for the post or the image itself: on the anonymous path, for images, when the only item is a
 * profile. From a profile alone korbat cannot tell which image is meant. The form says so and never refuses the profile.
 */
export function profileOnly(draft: ReportDraft, given: GivenTarget | null): boolean {
  const targets = draftTargets(draft, given);
  return draft.ground === "csam" && (draft.keyword === "csam" || draft.keyword === "deepfake") && targets.length === 1 && profileOf(targets[0]!) !== null;
}

/** Whether the anonymous path's report names more profiles than one report may: the form says so before anything is sent. */
export function tooManyProfiles(draft: ReportDraft, given: GivenTarget | null): boolean {
  return draft.ground === "csam" && profilesNamed(draftTargets(draft, given)) > CSAM_NOTICE_MAX_ACCOUNTS;
}

const text = (value: string): string | undefined => (value.trim().length > 0 ? value.trim() : undefined);

/**
 * The request the draft makes, or the sentence that says what is still missing. A signed-out sender needs the human
 * check's token on every ground; a name and an address are sent only signed out and only on the illegal ground, since a
 * signed-in sender's contact is their account and the anonymous path asks for neither.
 */
export function noticeFrom(draft: ReportDraft, given: GivenTarget | null, sender: { signedIn: boolean; turnstileToken: string | null }): { request: NoticeRequest } | { problem: string } {
  const missing = REPORT_WORDS.missing;
  if (draft.ground === null) return { problem: missing.ground };
  const targets = draftTargets(draft, given);
  if (targets.length === 0) return { problem: missing.link };
  if (targets.some((target) => target.kind === "link" && !/^https?:[/][/]/i.test(target.url))) return { problem: missing.linkInvalid };
  const human = sender.signedIn ? {} : { turnstileToken: sender.turnstileToken ?? undefined };
  const explanation = text(draft.explanation);
  let request: unknown;
  if (draft.ground === "rule") {
    if (draft.ruleId === null) return { problem: missing.rule };
    request = { ground: "rule", ruleId: draft.ruleId, targets, ...(explanation ? { explanation } : {}), ...human };
  } else if (draft.ground === "illegal") {
    if (!explanation) return { problem: missing.whyIllegal };
    if (!draft.bonaFide) return { problem: missing.bonaFide };
    const [citedLaw, name, email] = [text(draft.citedLaw), text(draft.name), text(draft.email)];
    request = {
      ground: "illegal",
      targets,
      category: draft.category,
      ...(citedLaw ? { citedLaw } : {}),
      explanation,
      bonaFide: true,
      ...(draft.ruleId ? { ruleId: draft.ruleId } : {}),
      ...(!sender.signedIn && name ? { name } : {}),
      ...(!sender.signedIn && email ? { email } : {}),
      ...human,
    };
  } else {
    if (draft.keyword === null) return { problem: missing.keyword };
    if (tooManyProfiles(draft, given)) return { problem: REPORT_WORDS.oneProfile };
    request = { ground: "csam", targets, keyword: draft.keyword, ...(explanation ? { explanation } : {}), ...(draft.bonaFide ? { bonaFide: true } : {}), ...human };
  }
  if (!sender.signedIn && !sender.turnstileToken) return { problem: missing.human };
  const parsed = NoticeRequest.safeParse(request);
  return parsed.success ? { request: parsed.data } : { problem: missing.details };
}

/** The first sentence of a rule's text: the one line the form shows under its title. */
export function ruleLine(rule: Pick<Rule, "text">): string {
  const end = rule.text.indexOf(". ");
  return end === -1 ? rule.text : rule.text.slice(0, end + 1);
}

/** A wait as the form words it, from the answer's Retry-After: in minutes under an hour, in hours otherwise. */
export function waitWords(seconds: number | undefined): string {
  if (seconds === undefined || seconds >= 3600) {
    const hours = seconds === undefined ? 1 : Math.ceil(seconds / 3600);
    return hours === 1 ? "1 hour" : `${hours} hours`;
  }
  const minutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(seconds / 60));
  return minutes === 1 ? "1 minute" : `${minutes} minutes`;
}

/**
 * What the form shows for a failed send. Three failures get the form's own words, which name the users' contact address,
 * since for each the form itself is what does not work: the human check, the limits and an API that cannot take reports.
 * On the anonymous path each is followed by what a mail gives away. Anything else is the server's message, as elsewhere.
 */
export function reportFailure(err: unknown, anonymous: boolean, contact: string = CONTACT_EMAIL): string {
  if (!(err instanceof ApiError)) return errorMessage(err);
  let words: string | null = null;
  if (err.code === "human_check_failed") words = REPORT_WORDS.humanCheckFailed(contact);
  if (err.code === "rate_limited") words = REPORT_WORDS.rateLimited(waitWords(err.retryAfter), contact);
  if (err.code === "service_unavailable") words = REPORT_WORDS.unavailable(contact);
  if (words === null) return errorMessage(err);
  return anonymous ? `${words} ${REPORT_WORDS.mailShowsAddress}` : words;
}

/** What the appeal form and the re-examination control show for a failed request: the day's limit in words of its own, with the wait; anything else as elsewhere. */
export function dailyLimitFailure(err: unknown, limit: keyof typeof DAILY_LIMIT_WORDS): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === "rate_limited") return DAILY_LIMIT_WORDS[limit](waitWords(err.retryAfter));
  return errorMessage(err);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the status page

/** The status page's address for a notice, its token in the fragment, which no server is sent. */
export function statusLink(origin: string, ref: string, token: string): string {
  return `${origin}/notice/${ref}#t=${token}`;
}

/** The token a status page's address carries in its fragment, or null when the fragment holds none. */
export function fragmentToken(hash: string): string | null {
  return /^#t=([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/.exec(hash)?.[1] ?? null;
}

/**
 * What stands beside one item on the status page and in Your reports (3c design, section 9, and the rule of 7.8 step 4):
 *   - `waiting`: nothing is released yet;
 *   - `final`: the outcome was changed on review or by a correction, or answers a re-examination: it is final within
 *     korbat. An answer given while nobody could open the post's images is never final: it leaves the re-examination
 *     unspent;
 *   - `reexamination`: the answer can still be examined again, until the item's date;
 *   - `courts`: any other decided outcome, which cannot be examined again.
 */
export function itemRedress(item: NoticeItemStatus): "waiting" | "final" | "reexamination" | "courts" {
  if (item.outcome === null) return "waiting";
  const unseenAnswer = item.unseen && (item.outcome === "no_violation" || item.outcome === "not_evident");
  if (item.changed || (item.reexamines && !unseenAnswer)) return "final";
  if (item.reexamination?.open) return "reexamination";
  return "courts";
}

/**
 * Whether asking for a re-examination of the item at `index` examines another item too (3c design, section 7.2): the
 * item is a report of child sexual abuse material that the sender named, and the item korbat added for the post it
 * quotes can be examined again as well. korbat then examines both, and the page says so beside the control.
 */
export function quotedExaminedToo(items: readonly NoticeItemStatus[], index: number): boolean {
  const item = items[index];
  if (!item || !item.suspect || item.quotedBy !== null || !item.reexamination?.open) return false;
  return items.some((other) => other.quotedBy === item.position && !other.reexamines && other.reexamination?.open === true);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the appeal's state

/**
 * What a pending appeal's line says on the decision's screen (3c design, section 7.7), from the decision's own data and
 * the API's two answers about its review, which name nobody:
 *   - an appeal of a decision that sealed images waits for the authorities' assessment, whoever could review it;
 *   - otherwise, while someone at korbat may review it, it waits for a reviewer;
 *   - when nobody may: for a review that is an admin's, that it waits for an admin, and that korbat has one while it
 *     has one; else that korbat has one moderator, or that none who took no part in the case is available now. The last
 *     gives no reason: a moderator may be unable to review through a relation to someone in the case.
 */
export function appealWaitWords(view: Pick<DecisionView, "measures" | "appeal">): string | null {
  const appeal = view.appeal;
  if (appeal === null || appeal.state !== "pending") return null;
  const waits = DECISION_WORDS.appealWaits;
  if (view.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media")) return waits.sealed;
  if (appeal.reviewer === "available") return DECISION_WORDS.appealWaiting;
  if (appeal.needsAdmin) return appeal.reviewer === "none_single_staff" ? `${waits.admin} ${waits.oneAdmin}` : waits.admin;
  return waits[appeal.reviewer];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- chips and times

/** The chip of the author's own withheld or removed post: "Under review: R4", "Removed: illegal content". */
export function chipText(decision: PostModeration): string {
  // 3f (design, section 9.1): [chip.order], a post a DSA order removed without withholding it from its author.
  if (decision.order === true) return ORDER_TEXTS.chip.order;
  const state = decision.interim ? CHIP_WORDS.underReview : CHIP_WORDS.removed;
  const ground = decision.legal ? CHIP_WORDS.illegal : decision.ruleId;
  const chip = ground ? `${state}: ${ground}` : state;
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): a removed post's chip names its strike while the strike stands and counts.
  return decision.strikeUntil ? STANDING_TEXTS.chip(chip, decision.strikeUntil) : chip;
}

/** A time as korbat's statements print it: the date and the minute in UTC. */
export function utcMinute(at: string): string {
  const iso = new Date(at).toISOString();
  return `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 16)} UTC`;
}
```

```ts
      "Rating images against rule R1: on. A program rates every uploaded image and korbat keeps the rating with the image. The program hides nothing, and the image's author hears of it only if the moderator's decision restricts the post.",
    withholds:
      "Rating images against rule R1: on. A program rates every uploaded image and korbat keeps the rating with the image. An image it rates at or above the threshold is put before a moderator, and korbat hides that one image from other people until the moderator has decided. The post's text stays, and its author still sees the image, is told at once and can ask for a person.",
    facts: (f: R1Facts) =>
      `The model: ${f.model}. SHA-256 of its weights: ${f.digest}. Threshold: ${f.threshold}, version ${f.thresholdVersion}. Its publisher states: "${f.publisherClaim}". korbat has not measured its error rate and claims none. The publisher does not disclose the training data, and korbat found no outside evaluation of bias. A rating says nothing about rule R2.`,
  },
  match: {
    off: "Comparing uploads with known child sexual abuse material: off. korbat computes no fingerprint of any upload, compares nothing, and keeps no fingerprint from a time when it did, except the one in the record of a match (Terms, Your data). A match found while it was on is still put before korbat's staff. Otherwise rule R2 is applied on reports and on moderators' findings.",
    alerts: (source: string) =>
      `${matchAlerts(source)} A match with such an entry, exact or not, on an image that is already on a post is put before an admin at once; the program seals nothing, and from then on korbat keeps that post's images, also if their author deletes the post or the account, until the admin has answered. A match with an entry of any other class only flags the image for a person: no upload is refused and no image is held, sealed or kept because of it. korbat's staff do not open an image that a match names.`,
    seals: (source: string) =>
      `${matchAlerts(source)} When an image that is already on a post matches in that way, korbat seals that post's images at once, for everyone, until an admin has answered; it keeps them until then, also if their author deletes the post or the account. The author is told at once and can ask for a person. A match with such an entry that ${source} does not report as exact is put before an admin at once too: the program seals nothing on it, and korbat keeps that post's images until the admin has answered. A match with an entry of any other class only flags the image for a person: no upload is refused and no image is held, sealed or kept because of it. korbat's staff do not open an image that a match names, before the admin's answer or after it, and the admin's answer is a person's decision.`,
  },
  edge: {
    off: `Dropping cached copies: off. When an image stops being public, a copy at korbat's network provider can be served for up to ${minutes(EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes)}, and a copy in a browser for up to ${minutes(EDGE_CACHE.browserSeconds / 60)}.`,
    on: `Dropping cached copies: on. When an image stops being public, korbat asks its network provider to drop its copy at once. The request can fail, so the bound korbat states is the same: up to ${minutes(EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes)} at the provider, up to ${minutes(EDGE_CACHE.browserSeconds / 60)} in a browser.`,
  },
  witness: {
    off: "Outside timestamp for the audit log's daily value: off. The value stands on korbat's Transparency page and in a mail to a person who does not run the server.",
    on: "Outside timestamp for the audit log's daily value: on. The Transparency page offers each day's proof and says how to check it.",
  },
} as const;

/** "(test adapter)" after a tool's "on": a test adapter can run only while the app's site is closed (W.1). */
const testAdapter = (text: string) => text.replace(": on", ": on (test adapter)");

/** One tool's block on the rules page, as the facts give it: its paragraphs, in order. */
export interface ToolBlock {
  tool: "r1" | "match" | "edge" | "witness";
  on: boolean;
  paragraphs: string[];
}

/**
 * The automation section's four blocks, in the state the facts route gives each tool (9.2 item 4): a tool's text, its
 * model's facts while the R1 check is on, and inside the block of each of the two tools that rate or compare images,
 * while it is on, its own impact assessment's day and, while its measure is on, the day of the one that covers it. A date
 * is never printed over a tool it was not set for.
 */
export function toolBlocks(facts: PublicFacts): ToolBlock[] {
  const dates = (tool: { dpia: string | null; dpiaActs: string | null }, acts: boolean) => [
    ...(tool.dpia === null ? [] : [RULES_PAGE.dpia(tool.dpia)]),
    ...(acts && tool.dpiaActs !== null ? [RULES_PAGE.dpiaActs(tool.dpiaActs)] : []),
  ];
  const marked = (text: string, test: boolean) => (test ? testAdapter(text) : text);
  const { r1, match, edge, witness } = facts;
  const r1On = r1.state !== "off";
  const matchOn = match.state !== "off";
  const source = match.source ?? "its source";
  return [
    {
      tool: "r1",
      on: r1On,
      paragraphs: r1On
        ? [marked(TOOL_TEXTS.r1[r1.state === "withholds" ? "withholds" : "flags"], r1.test), ...(r1.model === null ? [] : [TOOL_TEXTS.r1.facts(r1)]), ...dates(r1, r1.state === "withholds")]
        : [TOOL_TEXTS.r1.off],
    },
    {
      tool: "match",
      on: matchOn,
      paragraphs: matchOn ? [marked(match.state === "seals" ? TOOL_TEXTS.match.seals(source) : TOOL_TEXTS.match.alerts(source), match.test), ...dates(match, match.state === "seals")] : [TOOL_TEXTS.match.off],
    },
    { tool: "edge", on: edge.on, paragraphs: [edge.on ? marked(TOOL_TEXTS.edge.on, edge.test) : TOOL_TEXTS.edge.off] },
    { tool: "witness", on: witness.on, paragraphs: [witness.on ? marked(TOOL_TEXTS.witness.on, witness.test) : TOOL_TEXTS.witness.off] },
  ];
}

/** The six full months before an edition's due day end with this month (yyyy-mm), the same in every version of the year. */
export function recipientsMonth(year: number): string {
  return new Date(Date.UTC(year + 1, TRANSPARENCY_RULES.dueMonth - 1, 0)).toISOString().slice(0, 7);
}

const MONTHS = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
/** The day a year's edition is due, as a sentence names it: 1 March, from TRANSPARENCY_RULES. */
const DUE = `${TRANSPARENCY_RULES.dueDay} ${MONTHS[TRANSPARENCY_RULES.dueMonth - 1]}`;
/** The floor and the rounding of a banded count, as a sentence names them. */
const FLOOR = numberWord(TRANSPARENCY_RULES.floor);
const UNDER_FLOOR = `1 to ${TRANSPARENCY_RULES.floor - 1}`;
const ROUND_TO = numberWord(TRANSPARENCY_RULES.roundTo);

/** Who witnessed a day's value, as its row says it. */
const HEAD_WITNESS_WORDS: Record<HeadWitness, string> = {
  rfc3161: "with an outside timestamp",
  test: "with a test adapter's timestamp, which proves nothing",
  none: "without an outside timestamp",
};

/** The labels of a measure in the tables: the ledger's own. */
const measureLabel = (kind: string) => (kind in MEASURES ? MEASURES[kind as MeasureKind].label : kind);
/** A rule's title in force, for the table by ground. */
const ruleTitle = (id: string) => RULES.find((rule) => rule.id === id)?.title ?? id;

/** The transparency page's words (W.2). */
export const TRANSPARENCY_PAGE = {
  title: "Transparency",
  lead: "What korbat's moderators, its programs and authorities' orders did, in numbers. korbat publishes counts and never a decision: on a service this small, a list of decisions would point at people. Whoever a decision concerns gets its full reasons from korbat directly.",
  read: `How to read a figure. korbat prints 0, "${UNDER_FLOOR}", or a number rounded to the nearest ${ROUND_TO} ("about 60"). A line that would show fewer than ${FLOOR} is folded into "other". Each figure is rounded by itself, so the lines of a table need not add up to its total. The one exception is the section on authorities' orders: the law asks for those figures as numbers, so they are printed as numbers, small ones too. korbat publishes one edition for each calendar year, on or after ${DUE} of the next year, and never changes it: a correction is a new version beside it, marked and dated. The running year shows no figure, so nothing on this page moves when korbat takes one decision.`,
  edition: (year: number, version: number, publishedOn: string, method: number) =>
    `Edition ${year}, version ${version}, published ${publishedOn}. It counts what was decided, received or answered from 1 January to 31 December ${year}, UTC. Method ${method}.`,
  versions: "Earlier versions of this year, kept as they were published:",

    correction: (publishedOn: string) => `This version corrects the version before it. Every table of the year was counted again on ${publishedOn}, so a figure can differ for a reason other than the corrected one.`,
  },
  none: `korbat has published no edition yet. The first appears on or after ${DUE} of the year after korbat's first calendar year.`,
  /** A table with no row. */
  tableNone: "None in this year.",
  tables: {
    byGround: "Restrictions, by ground",
    byMeasure: "Restrictions, by kind of measure",
    noBreach: "Decisions that found no breach",
    intakes: "Reports and notices received",
    appeals: "Appeals answered in the year",
    reexaminations: "Re-examinations answered in the year",
    accountMeasures: "Measures on accounts",
    automated: "Programs",
    uploads: "Uploads not accepted",
  },
  labels: {
    ground: (id: string) => `Rule ${id}: ${ruleTitle(id)}`,
    law: "The law",
    otherGrounds: "Other grounds",
    allRestrictions: "All restrictions",
    measure: measureLabel,
    otherMeasures: "Other measures",
    other: "Other",
    noBreach: "Decisions that found no breach",
    intakes: {
      rules: "Reports under korbat's rules",
      illegal: "Notices of illegal content (Article 16 of the Digital Services Act)",
      finding: "Findings by korbat's moderators",
      automated: "Findings by a program",
    } as Record<string, string>,
    appeals: { kept: "Decision kept", partly_reversed: "Reversed in part", reversed: "Reversed" } as Record<string, string>,
    reexaminations: { action: "Action taken", no_action: "No action again" } as Record<string, string>,
    findings: (id: string) => `Findings by a program under rule ${id}`,
    measures: (id: string) => `Measures a program took under rule ${id}`,
    // 3d Task 7: the figures' `open` row, a refusal whose hold no admin had ended by the edition's due day (6.4).
    uploads: { refused: "Uploads refused on a match", report: "Held for a report", no_report: "Hold ended without a report", open: "Held, not yet decided on the due day" } as Record<string, string>,
  },
  autoRate: (base: string, restricted: string) => `Of ${base} findings by a program under rule R1, a person then restricted ${restricted}.`,
  autoFew: "Too few findings to say what became of them.",
  ordersHeading: "Authorities' orders",
  orders:
    "An order is not korbat's decision: korbat gives no reasons of its own for it, publishes no statement of reasons for it, and counts it in none of the tables above. These are the figures that Article 7 of Regulation (EU) 2021/784 asks for, as numbers.",
  /** The headings of the yearly report of authorities' orders (the 3f design's runbook), without the issuing state. */
  orderHeadings: {
    received: "Removal orders received",
    disabled: "Items disabled, and how fast",
    late: "Orders not carried out in time, with the ground",
    scrutiny: "Scrutiny and reinstatements",
    own: "The measures korbat takes against terrorist content",
  },
  orderLines: {
    received: (total: string, crossBorder: string) => `Removal orders received: ${total}, of which from another Member State: ${crossBorder}.`,
    itemsDisabled: (n: string) => `Items disabled following a removal order: ${n}.`,
    minutes: (list: string) => `Minutes from the clock's start to the disabling of an order's last item: ${list}.`,
    outside: (n: string) => `Orders whose last item was disabled outside the hour: ${n}.`,
    open: (n: string) => `Orders with an item still open: ${n}.`,

    reinstated: (list: string) => `Reinstated, by ground: ${list}.`,
```
